\"%40 yağış\" ifadesinin arkasında genel: Behind the expression "40% precipitation", there is usually exactly this count.
\"100 yıllık taşkın bu yıl oldu, 100 yıl: "A 100-year flood occurred this year, it won't happen for another 100 years" is incorrect; the probability is the same every year and is memoryless.
\"27012G22KT 8000 -RA BKN012 09/07 Q1008: "27012G22KT 8000 -RA BKN012 09/07 Q1008" → 12 kt from 270° (gusting to 22 kt), 8 km visibility, light rain, 5-7 oktas cloud at 1200 ft, 9/7 °C, QNH 1008 hPa. Because the spread is 2 K, fog risk is high.
\"50 yıllık yağış\" ifadesi o değerin 50: The expression "50-year rainfall" does not mean that value will occur once in 50 years; it means it has a 1/50 probability of being exceeded each year. It is completely normal for it to occur in two consecutive years.
\"Akışkan paketi\" sonsuz küçük bir nokt: A "fluid parcel" is not an infinitesimal point; it behaves like a point in mathematics, but in physics it is a statistical volume.
\"Alçak basınç = her yerde yağmur\" deği: Not "low pressure = rain everywhere"; precipitation concentrates in specific sectors of the low center (usually east/northeast).
\"Coriolis havayı yavaşlatır\" yanlıştır: "Coriolis slows down the air" is incorrect; because it is perpendicular to velocity, it does not change speed magnitude at all.
\"CurlyVector\": ok yerine akım çizgisi: "CurlyVector": curved arrows resembling streamlines instead of straight arrows. It displays the curvature of the flow much better than straight arrows.
\"En uzak nokta\" coğrafi olarak değil h: The "farthest point" is not geographically but hydraulically the most distant; a short but very slow path can be more decisive.
\"ExplicitLevels\": adım sabit olmak zor: "ExplicitLevels": the step does not have to be constant; you specify the boundaries one by one.
\"Hava sıkıştırılamaz kabul edilir\" ifa: The statement "air is considered incompressible" applies only to horizontal-fast flow; in hydrostatic and thermodynamic calculations, air is strictly compressible.
\"HighRes\" harita veri tabanı NCL ile b: The "HighRes" map database is not installed with NCL; if it has not been downloaded separately, the script does not fall back to "MediumRes" without an error, it stops directly.
\"Kırmızı = sıcak hava\" değil, \"kırmız: It does not mean "red = warm air", but "red = WARMING". The value is not the temperature itself, but the rate of change.
\"ManualLevels\" eşit adım verir; \"Expl: "ManualLevels" provides equal steps; "ExplicitLevels" frees the step; "AutomaticLevels" (default) examines the data and decides on its own, disrupting comparisons.
\"ManualLevels\": alt sınır, üst sınır v: "ManualLevels": YOU provide the lower limit, upper limit, and step. It is essential for comparisons between dates.
\"Ne kadar aynı yöne bakıyorlar\" sayısı: The "how much they point in the same direction" number.
\"Neden S = z?\" sorusunun cevabı: karte: The answer to the question "Why S = z?": in Cartesian coordinates, (∂z/∂x)_z ≡ 0. Write this as the first sentence.
\"Neden bulutlar yağmaz?\" sorusunun yar: This is half of the answer to "Why don't clouds precipitate?": diffusion stalls at 10 µm. The other half is the collision-coalescence (warm cloud) and Bergeron (cold cloud) processes. As droplet count in the cloud increases, supersaturation is shared: in polluted clouds, droplets remain smaller.
\"Neden sadece bu bileşen?\" sorusunun c: The answer to "Why only this component?" is scale analysis. On the synoptic scale, horizontal velocity is U ≈ 10 m/s, vertical velocity is W ≈ 10⁻² m/s, and length scale is L ≈ 10⁶ m. Terms containing vertical velocity are THREE ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE smaller than horizontal ones. Therefore, ζ practically represents the rotation of the horizontal flow on its own; the other two components gain importance at the convective scale (within storms).
\"Negatif eğim\" adı zayıflık çağrıştırı: The name "negative tilt" suggests weakness; in fact, it indicates the most dangerous phase of the system.
\"Rüzgâr kuzeye esiyor\" ile \"kuzey rüz: "The wind is blowing to the north" and "north wind" have opposite meanings.
\"Sabit\" demek, t₁ anındaki değerin t₂: "Constant" means the value at time t₁ is equal to the value at time t₂. The two states of the problem are precisely these two moments. φ is the same on both sides because the ring does not change latitude — this is consistent with the φ = constant assumption in the previous proof.
\"Serbest\" sürtünmesiz demektir, türbül: "Free" means frictionless, not turbulence-free; clear-air turbulence (CAT) occurs right here.
\"Siyah\" görünür renkle ilgili değildir: "Black" is not related to visible color: snow is white in the visible spectrum, but in the infrared it is an almost perfect blackbody.
\"Su 0 °C'de donar\" kabulü bulut fiziği: The assumption that "water freezes at 0 °C" is incorrect in cloud physics; without nuclei, droplets remain liquid even at −35 °C.
\"Sıcaklık sıfırın altındaysa bulut buzl: The assumption that "if temperature is below zero, the cloud is glaciated" is the most costly mistake in icing forecasting.
\"TEMPO 1418 3000 TSRA BKN015CB\" → 14-1: "TEMPO 1418 3000 TSRA BKN015CB" → Between 14-18 UTC, temporarily 3 km visibility, thunderstorm with rain, and cumulonimbus at 1500 ft are expected.
\"Yazın güneşe daha yakınız\" açıklaması: The explanation "we are closer to the sun in summer" is both incorrect and fails to explain why seasons are reversed in the southern hemisphere.
\"asıl, birincil\" demektir. Newton'un i: means "fundamental, primary". Newton's second law for an air parcel on a rotating sphere

#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail TA: #!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail TARIH="${1:-$(date -u -d 'yesterday' +%Y%m%d)}" KOSU="${2:-00}" SAATLER=(000 006 012 018 024) KOK="/work/$USER/gfs/$TARIH$KOSU" TABAN="https://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/gfs/prod" LOG="$KOK/indirme.log" mkdir -p "$KOK" cd "$KOK" kaydet() { echo "[$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)] $*" | tee -a "$LOG"; } indir() { local saat="$1" local ad="gfs.t${KOSU}z.pgrb2.0p25.f$saat" local url="$TABAN/gfs.$TARIH/$KOSU/atmos/$ad" local deneme=1 if [[ -s "$ad" ]] && (( $(stat -c %s "$ad") > 100000000 )); then kaydet "skipped (already exists): $ad" return 0 fi while (( deneme <= 3 )); do kaydet "downloading ($deneme/3): $ad" if curl -sfS --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 900 -o "$ad.parca" "$url"; then mv "$ad.parca" "$ad" kaydet "done: $ad ($(stat -c %s "$ad") bytes)" return 0 fi rm -f "$ad.parca" deneme=$((deneme + 1)) sleep 60 done kaydet "FAILED: $ad" return 1 } HATA=0 for S in "${SAATLER[@]}"; do indir "$S" || HATA=$((HATA + 1)) done kaydet "finished: $(( ${#SAATLER[@]} - HATA )) succeeded, $HATA failed" [[ $HATA -eq 0 ]] || exit 1

100 km genişliğinde bir kuşakta 8 K fark: If there is an 8 K difference across a 100 km wide zone, |∇T| = 8 K/100 km; if the slope is 1/100, at an altitude of 3 km the front is 300 km behind at the surface.

100 km'de 4 hPa basınç düşüşü ve ρ = 1,2: For a 4 hPa pressure drop per 100 km and ρ = 1.2 kg/m³, the force is 400/(1.2·10⁵) = 3.3·10⁻³ m s⁻² — a moderate synoptic gradient.

100 yıllık taşkın, herhangi bir yılda aş: A 100-year flood is an event that has a 1% probability of being exceeded in any given year. It does not mean "it occurs once every hundred years"; it can also occur in two consecutive years.
100 yıllık taşkına göre tasarlanan bir k: For a bridge designed for a 100-year flood, the probability of experiencing that flood during its 50-year lifespan is 39.5%. To reduce the risk to 10%, it must be designed for a ~475-year event.

20·10⁻⁵ s⁻¹ vortisite maksimumu 25 m/s a: If a 20·10⁻⁵ s⁻¹ vorticity maximum is advected by a 25 m/s flow and drops to zero over 500 km, advection ≈ 25·20·10⁻⁵/5·10⁵ = 10⁻⁸ s⁻²; this indicates strong forcing.

25 yıllık taşkın, önümüzdeki 10 yılda %3: A 25-year flood has a 33,5% probability of being exceeded at least once in the next 10 years — this illustrates the misleading nature of the term "once in 25 years".
25 °C = 298,15 K; formüle yanlışlıkla 25: 25 °C = 298,15 K; if 25 is mistakenly entered into the formula, 1/25 = 0,04 results and e_s deviates by millions of times.
25 °C ve 18 g/kg karışım oranındaki yüze: For surface air at 25 °C and a mixing ratio of 18 g/kg, θe is on the order of ≈ 345 K.

Adveksiyon ancak rüzgâr eş değer çizgile: Advection is non-zero only if the wind crosses isolines; there is no transport in parallel flow.
Adveksiyon bir çarpımdır ve bu yüzden ik: Advection is a product and is therefore zeroed in two ways: if the wind is zero or if the wind is PARALLEL to isotherms. The latter is frequently seen on synoptic charts — if strong wind does not cross isotherms, temperature does not change. The observation "there is wind but temperature is constant" is not an error, it is geometry.
Adveksiyon denklemi ∂q/∂t + u·∂q/∂x = 0: The advection equation ∂q/∂t + u·∂q/∂x = 0 is the simplest transport component of a model; temperature, humidity, and pollutants are all transported by this logic.
Adveksiyon okumasında kalınlık çok prati: Thickness is very practical in interpreting advection: the angle between the contour field and the thickness field indicates warm/cold advection. Adveksiyon renk-alanı: kırmızı WAA, mavi: Advection color field: red WAA, blue CAA. Arrows show direction in the frontal layer.

Adveksiyon rüzgâr izotermleri KESTİĞİNDE: Advection occurs WHEN the wind crosses isotherms; it is zero in parallel flow.
Adveksiyon sisi, ılık-nemli havanın soğu: Advection fog forms when warm, moist air is transported over a cold surface; it can persist during the day and survives even in windy conditions (up to 10 m/s). Sea fog is of this type and causes closures for hours at coastal airports.
Adveksiyon sisi: sıcak ve nemli havanın: Advection fog: transport of warm and moist air over a cold surface. It coexists with wind and can last all day; it is a classic problem of coastal aerodromes.
Adveksiyon terimi −V·∇X biçimindedir; ek: The advection term is in the form −V·∇X; the minus sign states: if the wind comes from the direction where the magnitude DECREASES, the value drops. For warm advection, the wind must have a component from the warm side toward the cold side, that is, in the direction of −∇T.
Adveksiyon terimini bileşenleriyle yazma: Writing the advection term in components and establishing its sign geometrically.
Adveksiyon teriminin işareti her zaman g: The sign of the advection term is always read AGAINST the gradient: if the wind blows from high to low values (V·∇ψ < 0), ψ increases at a fixed point. Therefore, in warm advection (wind from warm to cold), the station warms up. The "Advection" layer in the application paints precisely the −V·∇T field.
Adveksiyon yok: ya rüzgâr sıfır ya da rü: No advection: either wind is zero or wind is parallel to isotherms (not crossing the gradient).
Adveksiyon, sinoptik ölçekte yerel sıcak: Advection is the dominant cause of local temperature change on the synoptic scale (more important than solar heating in the short term). Through the thermal wind relationship, it can be diagnosed from the turning of wind with height (veering = WAA). The −V·∇T field in the app is calculated with central differences from Open-Meteo wind and temperature.

Adyabatik süreç izentropiktir: dq = 0 →: An adiabatic process is isentropic: dq = 0 → ds = 0 → θ constant. The dry adiabats on a Skew-T or tephigram are actually lines of constant entropy. Therefore, in meteorology, an isentropic surface and a dry adiabatic surface are the same thing.
Adyabatik süreçte basınç-yoğunluk ilişki: The pressure-density relation in an adiabatic process is in the form p ∝ ρ^γ.

Adım 1'deki iki ifade sağ tarafa konur v: The two expressions from Step 1 are placed on the right-hand side, and common unit vectors are factored out. This is a purely mechanical distribute-and-collect operation; no new physics enters. Its purpose is to write both sides in the SAME basis (î, ĵ) — only then can the coefficients be compared.
Adım 2 ve 3'ün sonuçları Adım 1'e yerleş: The results of Steps 2 and 3 are substituted into Step 1. The Ω × U terms originating from two separate sources come side by side.
Adım 2'deki üç konum terimi Adım 4'teki: When the three position terms in Step 2 are replaced by the dot product in Step 4, the compact form of the operator emerges. The left-hand side is Lagrangian (parcel), the right-hand side is Eulerian (fixed point) language; the equation translates between the two languages.
Adım 3'te bulunan iki türev, Adım 1'deki: The two derivatives found in Step 3 are substituted into their places in the four-term expansion in Step 1. NOTHING ELSE is done in this step — no brackets are expanded, no terms are collected. The goal is to see what the substitution produces on its own: no angle derivatives remain in the expression anymore, everything is in terms of Vr, Vθ, r, and θ.
Adım 3'teki iki türev burada da aynen ku: The two derivatives from Step 3 are used identically here — there is no new math. The distribution of signs is different: because the derivative of sine gives PLUS cosine, the first three terms are positive, with only the last one negative. In the end, the same two parentheses as in the u equation appear; the only change is which parenthesis is multiplied by cos and which by sin.
Adım 4'te yay farkının δβ δn olduğu bulu: In Step 4, the arc difference was found to be δβ δn; this is substituted for d(δs) in the expression. Nothing else is done in this step. As a result, there are no longer any geometric unknowns in the expression: everything is in terms of V, δs, δn, and δβ.
Adım 7'deki hız farkları, Adım 6'daki ba: The velocity differences in Step 7 are placed in the numerators of the relative terms in Step 6; each term reduces to a difference quotient. When the box shrinks infinitesimally, the difference quotients turn into partial derivatives. This limit makes the equation valid not just for a specific box, but for EVERY point in space.

One starts from an initial point and advances step-by-step across the field. The simplest way to step is Euler, but it drifts outward in curvature; in practice, fourth-order Runge-Kutta is used.

Akım çizgisi bir anın fotoğrafı, yörünge: A streamline is a snapshot of an instant, a trajectory is a movie of a parcel; if the field does not change with time, all three coincide.

Akış yolu tek tip değildir: yüzeysel yay: The flow path is not uniform: sheet flow (slow, a few hundred meters), shallow concentrated flow, and channel flow (fast) are computed sequentially and summed. Most of the total travel time is often in the first hundred meters.

Akışın cisme, akış yönüne dik doğrultuda: Force exerted by the flow on a body perpendicular to the flow direction; result of circulation around the airfoil.

Akışın her noktada hangi eksen etrafında: Vector indicating the axis of rotation of the flow at each point.
Akışın kaynağını basınç deseni belirler: The pressure pattern determines the source of the flow

Alanın, basınç sabit tutularak alınan ya: Horizontal partial derivative of the field evaluated holding pressure constant. Because radiosonde network data are mapped on isobaric surfaces, this is the derivative directly read in synoptic analysis.
Alanın, yükseklik sabit tutularak alınan: Horizontal partial derivative of the field evaluated holding height constant. It is the natural derivative of the Cartesian system and represents the change measured by an aircraft flying at a constant altitude.
Albedo 0 ile 1 arasında boyutsuz bir ora: Albedo is a dimensionless ratio between 0 and 1, depending on surface texture, moisture, and solar incidence angle as much as color. The same water surface exhibits an albedo of 0.05 when the sun is overhead, and over 0.3 when the sun is near the horizon.

Atmosfer her dalga boyuna aynı davranmaz: The atmosphere does not treat every wavelength the same. In the 0.4–0.7 μm visible band air is nearly transparent, in the 6–8 μm band water vapor absorbs almost every photon, and in the 8–12 μm range an atmospheric "window" opens again. Therefore, which phenomenon you see at which wavelength is determined by physics, not by preference.
Atmosfer hesaplarında kuru hava için cp: In atmospheric calculations, cp ≈ 1004 J/(kg·K) is used for dry air. The exponent R/cp ≈ 0.286 in potential temperature comes directly from this.
Atmosfer için hesap çarpıcıdır: U = 10 m: The calculation for the atmosphere is striking: U = 10 m/s, L = 1000 m, ν = 1.5·10⁻⁵ m²/s → Re ≈ 7·10⁸. This is hundreds of thousands of times the transition threshold. Thus atmospheric flow is turbulent without exception; there is no such thing as a laminar atmosphere.
Atmosfer için sonucu çarpıcıdır. Su buha: The result for the atmosphere is striking. Water vapor and CO₂ are strong absorbers in longwave (infrared) bands; therefore, they are strong emitters in the same bands. This is precisely what the greenhouse effect is: gases absorb radiation emitted from the ground and re-emit it in all directions — partially back toward the surface — at their own temperatures.
Atmosfer kaotiktir: başlangıçtaki minici: The atmosphere is chaotic: a tiny initial difference changes the entire forecast within days.
Atmosfer olmasaydı yüzey denge sıcaklığı: Without an atmosphere, the surface equilibrium temperature would be approximately −18 °C; the actual mean is +15 °C. The 33 K difference is the natural greenhouse effect.
Atmosfer sürekli bir alandır; bilgisayar: The atmosphere is a continuous field; computer memory is finite. The grid bridges the gap.
Atmosfer tam olarak bu koşulları sağlama: The atmosphere does not strictly satisfy these conditions because it is baroclinic: the horizontal temperature gradient makes ∂V/∂z non-zero. That is, thermal wind is the Taylor-Proudman constraint broken in a baroclinic medium.

Atmosfer, karışım oranları sabit sayılab: The atmosphere consists of gases whose mixing ratios can be considered constant, and under normal atmospheric conditions intermolecular attraction is negligibly rare. Therefore, air behaves like an ideal gas: the margin of error is below one in a thousand in the troposphere.

Atmosferde L büyük olduğu için Re ~ 10⁶-: Because L is large in the atmosphere, Re ~ 10⁶-10⁹: flow is always turbulent.
Atmosferde Re 10⁸ mertebesindedir; bu yü: In the atmosphere, Re is on the order of 10⁸; hence molecular viscosity is completely neglected for the large scale.
Atmosferde dalgalar yalnız salınmaz, ort: In the atmosphere, waves do not merely oscillate; they exchange energy and momentum with the mean flow. The EP flux makes this exchange visible: its horizontal component represents wave momentum transport (⟨u′v′⟩, Reynolds stress), and its vertical component represents heat transport (⟨v′θ′⟩, baroclinic conversion).
Atmosferde dq sıfırdan farklıysa kaynağı: If dq is non-zero in the atmosphere, its source is generally threefold: latent heat release (condensation), radiative heating/cooling, and turbulent heat flux. On the synoptic scale outside clouds, these terms are on the order of 1–2 K per hour, which is why horizontal motion is often considered adiabatic.
Atmosferde düşey hareketler genelde adya: Vertical motions in the atmosphere are generally fast enough to be considered adiabatic: heat conduction and radiation can be neglected over these timescales.
Atmosferde en görünür karşılığı gece jet: Its most visible counterpart in the atmosphere is the nocturnal jet phenomenon: when friction suddenly cuts off at sunset, the boundary layer wind cannot settle into balance and enters an inertial oscillation, reaching a maximum around midnight that exceeds the geostrophic value.
Atmosferde en çok kullanılan biçimi Fr =: Its most widely used form in the atmosphere is Fr = U/(N·h); U is incoming wind, N is stability frequency, and h is obstacle height. The denominator represents the resistance of stable air to vertical displacement.
Atmosferde kullanılan biçim, kararlı tab: The form used in the atmosphere describes the passage of a stably stratified flow over a mountain. Fr is the ratio of inertial force to buoyancy force. If Fr ≪ 1, stability dominates: rather than crossing the mountain, air flows around the flanks, and stagnant zones and vortices form behind the obstacle. If Fr ≳ 1, air crosses the obstacle and mountain waves are triggered.
Atmosferde moleküler viskozite hemen her: Molecular viscosity in the atmosphere is neglected almost everywhere: turbulent "eddy viscosity" is 10⁵–10⁶ times larger. The only place where molecular viscosity is truly decisive is the millimeter-thin neighborhood of the surface and the dissipation scale of turbulence.
Atmosferde moleküler viskozite tamamen ö: Molecular viscosity is completely negligible in the atmosphere; the primary mechanism is the vertical transport of momentum by turbulent eddies. This is why the friction term is generally written as a stress gradient in the form ∂τ/∂z.
Atmosferde moleküler viskozitenin katkıs: The contribution of molecular viscosity in the atmosphere is completely negligible; "friction" in the equation of motion is the large-scale flow losing momentum to turbulent eddies. That is why eddy viscosity K is used instead of μ, and K is a property of the FLOW, not the fluid.
Atmosferde saf ataletsel akış nadirdir (: Pure inertial flow is rare in the atmosphere (pressure gradient is always present), but it is actually observed on the ocean surface and in the nocturnal boundary layer (inertial oscillation of the low-level jet). The "inertia circle" in the Coriolis widget is precisely this solution.
Atmosferde saf inersiyel salınım nadirdi: Pure inertial oscillation is rare in the atmosphere, but its signatures are everywhere. When the boundary layer stabilizes at night and friction suddenly ceases, the wind that was in balance during the day loses its equilibrium and begins an inertial oscillation: the low-level jet that becomes pronounced at 300-500 m after midnight is a product of this.
Atmosferde sürtünme ve ısı alışverişi ol: Since there is friction and heat exchange in the atmosphere, it cannot be applied directly on a large scale; it is useful on local and short scales.
Atmosferde viskoz terim, basınç ve Corio: In the atmosphere, the viscous term is 10⁵–10⁶ times smaller than the pressure and Coriolis terms
Atmosferde yüzey gerilmesi τ₀ = ρ·u∗² il: In the atmosphere, surface stress is defined as τ₀ = ρ·u∗² and is the key to wind energy, wave generation, and dust lifting. Over the sea, τ₀ is the primary forcing driving ocean surface currents.
Atmosferde τ dalga boyuna kuvvetle bağlı: In the atmosphere, τ depends strongly on wavelength. In clear air, vertical τ is on the order of ≈ 0.1 in the visible band; for a thick cumulonimbus, τ can reach several hundred. In satellite products, "cloud optical thickness" is directly this quantity and is associated with precipitation potential.
Atmosferdeki basınç ve sıcaklık aralığın: In the range of atmospheric pressure and temperature, real gas deviations are under one part per thousand; therefore, the ideal gas law is the cornerstone of meteorology.
Atmosferdeki fizik yasaları paket üzerin: The laws of physics in the atmosphere are written for a parcel: conservation of mass, Newton's law, the first law all answer the question "what is happening to this particular air mass". But our observations come from fixed stations. The material derivative translates between these two worlds.
Atmosferdeki toplam su, tüm yağışın yaln: Total water in the atmosphere corresponds to only 8–10 days of global precipitation. This short residence time indicates that the atmosphere is not a water reservoir, but a conveyor belt. The reservoirs are the oceans, glaciers, and groundwater.
Atmosferdeki yatay hareketin kaynağı bud: This is the source of horizontal motion in the atmosphere; Coriolis, centrifugal, and friction terms are merely responding terms. The minus sign indicates the direction opposite to the gradient, that is, toward low pressure.
Atmosferik kırılma ihmal edilmiştir; ufk: Atmospheric refraction is neglected; near the horizon (θz > 85°) it introduces an error of a few tenths of a degree.
Atmosferin büyük ölçekli düşey yapısı bu: The large-scale vertical structure of the atmosphere is explained by this balance: the pressure at the bottom of a layer exceeds that at the top by the weight of the air above it.
Atmosferin kaotik doğası gereği, başlang: Due to the chaotic nature of the atmosphere, small initial differences grow over time, completely changing the forecast.
Atmosferin kısa dalgaya saydam, uzun dal: Because the atmosphere is transparent to shortwave radiation and partially opaque to longwave radiation, the surface is warmer than its radiative equilibrium temperature.
Atmosferin toplam potansiyel enerjisi de: The total potential energy of the atmosphere is massive, but almost entirely unavailable: even if mass is redistributed, no work can be done relative to the reference state. The available portion is proportional only to the departure of isentropic surfaces from the horizontal and represents less than 0.5% of the total.
Atmosferin uzun dalga ışınımı soğurup yü: The atmosphere warms the surface by absorbing longwave radiation and emitting it back toward the surface.
Atmosferin yatay ölçeği ile düşey ölçeği: There is an approximately 100-fold difference between the horizontal scale and the vertical scale of the atmosphere. The troposphere is 12 km thick, whereas a synoptic system is 2000 km wide. If plotted to true scale, the atmosphere looks like a sphere coated with a thin layer of varnish; no structure can be distinguished within it. For this reason, the vertical axis is intentionally exaggerated.

Aynı zincir kuralı basınca uygulanır: ∇p: The same chain rule applies to pressure: ∇p·ds = dp. But here there is a CRITICAL difference — the expression is not dp, but dp/ρ. The factor 1/ρ is inside the integral, and density in general is NOT dependent on pressure alone. Therefore, dp/ρ does not have to be an exact differential, and its vanishing along a closed path CANNOT BE GUARANTEED. This factor is the only reason why this term survives while the gravity term vanishes.

Açık (explicit) şemada dt serbest değild: In an explicit scheme, dt is not arbitrary: if the condition r ≤ 1/4 is violated, the solution blows up in a checkerboard pattern. An implicit scheme removes this limit, but requires solving a matrix.
Açık alanların üstünde gece hızlı soğuma: Rapid nighttime cooling over open areas → fog/inversion is expected.
Açık hava türbülansı düşey rüzgâr kesmes: Clear-air turbulence arises from the competition between vertical wind shear and stability; the Richardson number falling below 0.25 marks the onset of shear-induced instability. Its most frequent locations are the cyclonic side of the jet core, the tropopause folding region, and sharp trough axes.
Açık hava türbülansı neden radarla sapta: Why clear-air turbulence cannot be detected by radar.
Açık hava türbülansı: jet akımının kenar: Clear-air turbulence: vertical shear at the edge of the jet stream; it is cloud-free and does not appear on radar, so it can only be avoided through forecasting.
Açık havada difüz payı %10–20 iken, ince: While the diffuse fraction is 10–20% in clear skies, it rises to 40–60% under thin cloud or haze, and to 100% in overcast skies. Thus, while clouds reduce total energy, they also completely alter its composition.

Açık oturumları listeler. Sunucuya yarın: Lists open sessions. When you connect to the server tomorrow, you see which job is running from here.

Açık ve rüzgârsız gecede yüzey uzun dalg: On a clear, calm night, the surface cools rapidly through longwave radiation; cooling the air from below causes θ to increase with height and suppresses vertical motion. Turbulence does not die out completely, but becomes patchy and intermittent — which is why nocturnal profiles are the most challenging condition to model.

Açılımı D/Dt = ∂/∂t + u·∂/∂x + v·∂/∂y +: Its expansion is of the form D/Dt = ∂/∂t + u·∂/∂x + v·∂/∂y + w·∂/∂z. The first term is the local change over time at a fixed point (local term), while the remaining three terms represent the transport of the quantity by the flow (advection terms). Total change is the sum of local change and advection.

Ağırlık dosyası KAYNAK ve HEDEF ızgara ç: The weight file is specific to the SOURCE and TARGET grid pair. Applying the same weights to a file of different resolution either produces an error or silently remaps incorrectly.
Ağırlık matrisini ayırmak (genbil + rema: Separating the weight matrix (genbil + remap) provides a major gain in batch jobs: the expensive geometric calculation is performed once, and then an inexpensive matrix multiplication is applied to each file.
Ağırlık sürüklemeye eşitlenince düşüş hı: When weight balances drag, fall speed grows with the square of the radius (small drops); for large drops, it turns into a square root.
Ağırlıklandırma hata kovaryanslarına gör: Weighting is performed according to error covariances: if observation error is small, the observation is trusted more; if model error is small, the background (first guess) is trusted more. Covariance matrices also spread information in space — a single sounding observation updates the surrounding area of hundreds of kilometers in a physically consistent manner.
Ağırlıklar gözün üç kanala duyarlılığıdı: The weights are the sensitivity of the eye to the three channels — green is dominant.
Ağırlığı `cos(lat)` yerine `cos(lat*rad): Forgetting to write `cos(lat*rad)` instead of `cos(lat)` for the weight is a classic mistake: NCL trigonometric functions expect RADIANS; if you pass degrees, the result oscillates nonsensically.
Aşan tepeyi yalnız görüntüdeki en soğuk: Searching for an overshooting top solely by the coldest pixel in the image; the primary criterion is its relative difference compared to its surroundings.
Aşağı akımın yere yayılmasıyla oluşan so: The cold air wedge formed by the downdraft spreading across the surface advances ahead of the cell. During its passage, wind shifts abruptly and strengthens, temperature drops, and pressure jumps. Runway direction at the aerodrome may need to change within minutes.
Aşım sıklığı ve ortalama fazlalık birlik: Exceedance frequency and mean excess are reported together; both are fundamental statistics for the Generalized Pareto fit.
Aşırı doygunluğu en büyük değere al: yay: Set supersaturation to the maximum value: even the diffusion curve cannot exceed 30 μm in 40 minutes. Then increase the liquid water content: the collision curve shoots up and crosses the drizzle threshold within minutes. The secret to precipitation is not vapor, but droplets capturing one another.
Aşırı doyma sabit tutulmuştur; gerçekte: Supersaturation is held constant; in reality, as droplets grow, they deplete water vapor and S decreases.
Aşırı soğumuş damlalar çoğunlukta olduğu: Because supercooled droplets are in the majority, they maintain the ambient vapor pressure at water saturation. This represents 13% supersaturation with respect to ice: diffusional growth (r dr/dt = G(S−1)) is 50 times faster than on a droplet. As ice grows, e drops, droplets become subsaturated and evaporate: water is transferred from droplets to ice.
Aşırı soğumuş su damlaları, damla boyu v: Supercooled water droplets, droplet size, and temperature range determine the icing type.
Aşırı soğumuş suyun donmasını ya da buha: Aerosol particles that trigger the freezing of supercooled water or direct deposition of vapor onto ice. They are orders of magnitude rarer than cloud condensation nuclei, and their effectiveness increases rapidly as temperature decreases.
Aşırı soğumuş suyun ya da buharın üzerin: Special, scarce particles capable of initiating ice formation on supercooled water or vapor.
Aşırı soğumuş sıvı su varsa su üstü bağı: If supercooled liquid water is present, the formula over water is used; if crystals are present, over ice.

The sign of B is equal to the sign of (Γ − Γp).
B nin işareti de bilgi taşır. Gece ya da: The sign of B also conveys information. At night or in an irrigated oasis, H can be negative (air transfers heat to the surface) and B turns negative; in this situation, known as the oasis effect, LE can exceed Rn because additional energy comes from horizontal advection.

Around B ≈ −1, the method is invalid.
BECMG ile TEMPO farkını bir örnekle açık: Explain the difference between BECMG and TEMPO with an example.
BECMG sonrası koşullar verilen aralıkta: Conditions following BECMG establish gradually within the given interval and remain until the end.
BECMG, TEMPO, FM ve PROB gruplarının her: Each of the BECMG, TEMPO, FM, and PROB groups describes a different temporal behavior.
BIAS 1'den uzaklaşırsa: sistematik fazla: If BIAS departs from 1: there is a systematic over/under-warning, threshold adjustment is required.
BIAS, tahminin sıklık olarak fazla mı az: BIAS indicates whether the forecast was issued with greater or lesser frequency; if greater than 1, there is over-warning, and if less than 1, under-warning. A good verification report presents all four together, without reducing them to a single number.
BS = 0,08 (iyi). BSS = 0,67: sistem, ikl: BS = 0.08 (good). BSS = 0.67: the system adds distinct skill compared to forecasting the climatological mean.
BSS, iklim ortalamasına göre ne kadar ka: BSS indicates how much gain is achieved relative to climatology: 0 is the same as climatology, 1 is perfect, and negative means forecasting the climatological mean would have been better. The value of ensemble prediction systems is justified precisely by this metric.
BWER ise düşey kesitte görülür: yükselen: BWER, on the other hand, is seen in vertical cross section: the updraft is so strong that hydrometeors are carried upward before having a chance to grow, leaving a "weak echo chimney" in the middle of strong echoes. Because it is capped above by high reflectivity, it is called "bounded".
Bacadan çıkan dumanın kararlılığa göre a: Characteristic plume shapes taken by smoke emitted from a stack according to stability; each produces a different ground-level impact.
Bacadan çıkan kirleticinin rüzgâr yönünd: Transport of pollutants emitted from a stack in the wind direction and their Gaussian dispersion in the lateral and vertical.
Baklava biçimli kutular tropopoz yüksekl: Diamond-shaped boxes give the tropopause height as flight level. H indicates high, L indicates low tropopause; where the tropopause dips, the jet strengthens and the probability of turbulence increases.
Balon hava ile birlikte gider: ölçtüğü d: The balloon moves with the air: the change it measures is the material derivative DT/Dt.
Balon nereye giderse rüzgâr oraya gider;: Wherever the balloon goes, the wind goes; the speed of the balloon = wind.
Balona bir termometre bağla. Onun gördüğ: Attach a thermometer to a balloon. This is the change it observes.
Balonla birlikte gidersen yoğunluğun nas: How density changes if you move along with the balloon.
Balonla yükselen ölçüm cihazının basınç,: The recording of vertical profiles of pressure, temperature, humidity, and wind by an instrument ascending with a balloon.
Balonun ağzını bırak: içerideki fazla ba: Release the balloon's mouth: the excess pressure inside pushes the air out; force arises from the difference.
Balonun gördüğü = istasyonun gördüğü + r: What the balloon observes = what the station observes + what the wind advects.
Balonun kendi üstündeki termometrenin gö: The change observed by the thermometer on the balloon itself.
Bant, 0 °C izoterminin hemen altında yer: The band is located just below the 0 °C isotherm, and its presence in a vertical cross-section directly gives the melting level. However, if not corrected when calculating precipitation amount, the radar systematically overestimates precipitation at that level; this correction is mandatory in winter forecasting.
Baroklinik bir ortamın siklon üretme pot: Reduces the cyclone-generating potential of a baroclinic environment to a single number: as vertical wind shear increases and stability decreases, cyclones develop faster.
Baroklinik dalganın doğuşundan olgunlaşı: The 3–6 day lifecycle of a baroclinic wave from its genesis to maturing, becoming barotropic, and dissipating.
Baroklinik durumda solenoid sayısı, izob: In a baroclinic state, the number of solenoids is measured by the intersection density of isobaric and isosteric surfaces.
Baroklinik durumda solenoid terimi sirkü: In a baroclinic state, the solenoid term generates circulation — the sea breeze arises from this term.
Baroklinik kararsızlık statik (konvektif: Baroclinic instability is often confused with static (convective) instability; one feeds on horizontal temperature differences, while the other feeds on the vertical lapse rate.
Baroklinik kararsızlık, orta enlem siklo: Baroclinic instability is the energy source of mid-latitude cyclones: available potential energy stored in horizontal temperature differences is converted into kinetic energy via slantwise ascending warm and descending cold air. Eady theory provides the fastest-growing mode of this process.
Baroklinik kuşak aynı zamanda enerji dep: The baroclinic zone is also an energy reservoir: the horizontal temperature difference is the available potential energy that feeds cyclones. When the zone weakens (frontolysis), cyclone development also ceases.
Baroklinik terim (basınç ve yoğunluk yüz: The baroclinic term (the intersection of pressure and density surfaces) generates circulation; the sea breeze is a classic example of this.
Baroklinlik yalnız yüzey cephesine bakıl: Baroclinicity is assessed by looking only at the surface front; the true indicator is the layer thickness gradient.
Baroklinlik, kullanılabilir potansiyel e: Baroclinicity is the reservoir of available potential energy. When warm air moves poleward and cold air equatorward, lowering the center of gravity, this energy is converted into kinetic energy; this is the fuel for mid-latitude cyclones.
Baroklinlik, sabit basınç yüzeyi üzerind: Baroclinicity means the presence of a temperature gradient on a constant pressure surface. Because isobaric and isothermal surfaces intersect, slanted quadrilaterals called "solenoids" form between them, and this structure generates circulation.
Barometrenin okuduğu sayı; hareketi yara: The reading of the barometer; what creates motion is the difference between two points.
Barometrenin okuduğu; kuvvet için mutlak: What the barometer reads; for force, it is not the absolute value but the DIFFERENCE that matters.
Barotropik \"rüzgârsız\" sanılır; rüzgâr: Barotropic is mistaken for "windless"; wind can be very strong, it just DOES NOT CHANGE with height.
Barotropik (yoğunluğun yalnız basınca ba: In barotropic flow (where density depends only on pressure), tilting and solenoid terms drop out of the vorticity equation; only the STRETCHING term remains. The change in absolute vorticity is directly proportional to horizontal divergence: if air diverges, rotation weakens; if it converges, rotation strengthens. The conservation law will emerge from this equation.
Barotropik koşulda yatay sıcaklık gradya: Under barotropic conditions, there is no horizontal temperature gradient; thermal wind is zero, and geostrophic wind does not change with height. Analysis at a single level represents the entire troposphere.
Barotropik koşulun anlamı: özgül hacim α: The meaning of the barotropic condition: specific volume α = 1/ρ is a function of p alone ⇒ α dp is an exact differential.
Barotropik ortamda siklon gelişimi için: In a barotropic environment, there is no available potential energy source for cyclone development; systems only redistribute existing kinetic energy. Therefore, no new storms form in a barotropic atmosphere; existing ones decay over time.
Barotropik potansiyel vortisite: mutlak: Barotropic potential vorticity: the ratio of absolute vorticity to column thickness. Conserved following a parcel in frictionless, barotropic flow, it acts as the "memory" of the flow.
Barotropik ve sinoptik yaklaşım: solenoi: Barotropic and synoptic approximation: solenoid and tilting terms are dropped. An incompressible fluid column of thickness h; continuity relates horizontal divergence to the change in column thickness.
Barotropik ve sürtünmesiz durumda mutlak: In the barotropic and frictionless case, absolute circulation is conserved (Kelvin's theorem).
Barotropik vortisite denklemini ortalama: Linearizing the barotropic vorticity equation for mean zonal flow + small perturbation.
Barotropik vortisite denklemini sabit te: Linearize the barotropic vorticity equation with small perturbations on a constant basic flow ū.
Barotropik, sürtünmesiz akışta madde eğr: The theorem stating that absolute circulation remains constant along a material curve in barotropic, frictionless flow.
Barotropik, sürtünmesiz akışta mutlak vo: In barotropic, frictionless flow, the ratio of absolute vorticity to column thickness is conserved following the parcel.
Barotropik, sürtünmesiz akışta vortisite: Combining the vorticity equation with continuity in barotropic, frictionless flow to derive (ζ+f)/h conservation.
Bash betiği: işi bir kez yaz, bin kez ko: Bash script: write once, run a thousand times
Bash dizisi: indirilecek tahmin saatleri: Bash array: forecast hours to download are defined in one place, easy to modify.
Basitliği en büyük gücüdür: taşkın tahmi: Its simplicity is its greatest strength: only temperature forecast is needed in flood forecasting and water supply planning. Its limitation lies here as well — a windy, cloudless day and a calm, cloudy day yield very different melt at the same mean temperature; energy balance models are superior in these cases.
Basitliğine rağmen düzenleyici modelleme: Despite its simplicity, it is still a primary tool in regulatory modeling because it is fast, transparent, and calibratable. Its limitations are clear: it is not valid in calm winds (U < 1 m/s), complex terrain, and at very close distances to the source.
Baskın terimleri tutup jeostrofik dengey: Retaining dominant terms to obtain geostrophic balance.
Basıncı Pa cinsinden vermek: p₀ = 1000 h: Providing pressure in Pa: with p₀ = 1000 hPa, the ratio shifts by a factor of 100, resulting in a very small θ. State the choice of units clearly in the module's documentation.
Basıncın birim uzunluk başına değişimi;: Rate of change of pressure per unit length; in Taylor expansion, it arises from the pressure difference on opposite faces of the box. Its direction points from low to high, while the force is opposite.
Basıncın doğu yönündeki gradyanı; havayı: Eastward gradient of pressure; pushes air from high to low
Basıncın düşey doğrultudaki değişim hızı: Vertical rate of change of pressure. In hydrostatic balance, it equals the weight per unit volume of the overlying air column; its absolute value decreases exponentially with density, and thus with height.
Basıncın en hızlı arttığı yön ve oran; i: Direction and rate of maximum pressure increase; numerical equivalent of isobar spacing.
Basıncın hangi yönde ne hızla değiştiği;: In which direction and how fast pressure changes; this is what actually pushes the air.
Basıncın havayı ileri iten kısmı: hızı d: The component of pressure pushing air forward: the only thing that changes speed.
Basıncın havayı ittiği yön, doğu ve kuze: The direction in which pressure pushes the air, resolved into eastward and northward components.
Basıncın havayı yana iten kısmı: yönü de: The component of pressure pushing air sideways: changes direction, does not accelerate speed.
Basıncın kendisi değil, YATAY farkı hava: Not pressure itself, but its HORIZONTAL difference initiates air motion. Therefore, on a map, one looks at the density of isobars rather than the absolute value.
Basıncın mutlak değeriyle kuvvet ilişkil: Force is often associated with the absolute value of pressure; what determines force is not the value, but the DIFFERENCE divided by distance.
Basıncın x ve y türevlerini zincir kural: Writing the x- and y-derivatives of pressure in terms of r- and θ-derivatives using the chain rule.
Basıncın x-türevini zincir kuralıyla aç: Expand the x-derivative of pressure using the chain rule
Basıncın yükseklikle azalma hızı: Rate of decrease of pressure with height
Basıncın yükseklikle azalma hızının, üst: The balance stating that the rate of decrease of pressure with height equals the weight of the overlying air column. Used in derivation as ∂z/∂p = −1/(ρg), and is the step that allows density to cancel out.
Basıncın yükseklikle değişimi; yukarı do: Variation of pressure with height; upward push
Basıncın, dönüşün dış-iç doğrultusundaki: Variation of pressure along the outward-inward direction of rotation.
Basınç + İzobar’ı aç; derin alçak çevres: Turn on Pressure + Isobars; closely packed isobars around a deep low indicate strong winds.
Basınç 10 hPa düşüyor: dp = −1000 Pa: Pressure drops by 10 hPa: dp = −1000 Pa
Basınç alanındaki kapalı merkezler: A =: Closed centers in the pressure field: L = low (cyclone), H = high (anticyclone) and their tracks.
Basınç alanını çizgilerle oku: 4 hPa’da: Read the pressure field with lines: a line every 4 hPa, thick lines every 20 hPa.
Basınç alanının sabit yükseklik yüzeyind: Horizontal gradient of the pressure field on a constant height surface: vector perpendicular to isobars, pointing from low to high. In geostrophic balance, its magnitude directly determines wind speed.
Basınç alanının uzamsal gradyanı; denkle: Spatial gradient of the pressure field; the source of the only true driving force in the equation. Together with the negative sign, it produces acceleration from high pressure to low pressure.
Basınç değişimi altında akışkan yoğunluğ: Ability of fluid density to change under pressure change.
Basınç dizisi azalan sırada: sondaj yuka: Pressure array in descending order: sounding goes upward.
Basınç dizisinin AZALAN sırada olması be: The pressure array is expected to be in DESCENDING order (from surface upward). Wyoming output is already like this, but verify the ordering in your own generated profile.
Basınç düşerse (yüksek rakım): aynı fark: If pressure drops (high altitude): the same difference means a smaller humidity correction, making Tw measurement more sensitive to humidity differences.
Basınç düşünce buhar da seyrelir; çiy no: When pressure drops, vapor also dilutes; the dew point decreases slightly.
Basınç düşüşü çok küçük yarıçapta gerçek: Because the pressure drop occurs over a very small radius, the gradient becomes immense: a 50 hPa drop within 100 m is typical in a tornado, giving speeds on the order of 70 m/s.
Basınç ekseni ters çevrilmelidir (aşağı: The pressure axis must be inverted (increasing downward) and logarithmically scaled; `gsn_csm_pres_hgt` does both automatically, which is why it is the correct function for cross-sections.
Basınç eksenini logaritmik yapar. Atmosf: Makes the pressure axis logarithmic. Since atmospheric pressure decreases exponentially with height, the log axis displays the upper troposphere without compressing it; without this line, levels above 300 hPa get squeezed into a thin strip of the page.
Basınç eğilimi 0–5 hPa/3 saat · sıcaklık: Pressure tendency 0–5 hPa/3 hours · temperature tendency 3–8 K/3 hours during frontal passage
Basınç farkı yokken parselin yalnız Cori: The radius of the circle traced by a parcel due solely to Coriolis when there is no pressure difference.
Basınç farkının büyüklüğü değil, MESAFEY: Not the magnitude of the pressure difference, but its ratio to DISTANCE (gradient) determines the wind.
Basınç gradyan kuvveti ile Coriolis kuvv: Theoretical wind parallel to isobars where the pressure gradient force and Coriolis force are in exact balance.
Basınç gradyan kuvveti silindirik taband: The pressure gradient force retains the same simple form in cylindrical coordinates; the only difference is the 1/r factor in the tangential component.
Basınç gradyan kuvveti ve sürtünme yoktu: There is no pressure gradient force and friction (or they have suddenly vanished).
Basınç gradyan kuvveti: hacim elemanında: Pressure gradient force: from volume element to −(1/ρ)∇p
Basınç gradyan kuvvetinin Coriolis kuvve: Theoretical horizontal wind assumed frictionless and unaccelerated, where the pressure gradient force is in exact balance with the Coriolis force. It is parallel to isobars and leaves low pressure to its left in the Northern Hemisphere.
Basınç gradyan kuvvetinin akış yönündeki: The component of the pressure gradient force along the flow direction; solely determines the material derivative of wind speed. It is zero when the wind blows perfectly parallel to the isobar, and accelerates or decelerates the parcel when crossing the isobar.
Basınç gradyan kuvvetinin birim kütleye: Cartesian components of the pressure gradient force per unit mass. The negative sign indicates the force is directed from high pressure to low; dividing by ρ converts the expression to acceleration units.
Basınç gradyan kuvvetinin radyal ve teğe: Radial and tangential components of the pressure gradient force

Radial and tangential components of the pressure gradient force. After lengthy algebra, the radial component retains the same form as its Cartesian version; in the tangential component, a 1/r factor remains from converting angle to arc length.
Basınç gradyan kuvvetinin silindirik bil: Deriving the cylindrical components of the pressure gradient force from its Cartesian form.
Basınç gradyan kuvvetinin, hareketin sol: Component of the pressure gradient force along the axis perpendicular and to the left of the motion. It deflects the direction of the flow but does not change speed; it is the sole source term on the right-hand side of the balanced flow equation.
Basınç gradyan kuvvetiyle Coriolis kuvve: Theoretical wind blowing parallel to contours where the pressure gradient force and Coriolis force are in exact balance. In an isobaric coordinate system, it depends only on geopotential slope and latitude; it takes a distinct value at each level.
Basınç gradyanı ile Coriolis tam dengede: What the wind would be if pressure gradient and Coriolis were in exact balance — theoretical speed.
Basınç gradyanı olmadan dengeli akışı çö: Solving balanced flow without a pressure gradient.
Basınç gradyanı ve yerçekimi 10 m/s² mer: Pressure gradient and gravity are on the order of 10 m/s²; the largest of the rest is one-thousandth of these. Scale separation in the vertical equation is much sharper than in the horizontal equation.
Basınç gradyanı yokken yalnız Coriolis e: Circular motion rotating solely under the Coriolis effect in the absence of a pressure gradient, and its period.
Basınç gradyanı yoksa parsel yalnız Cori: If there is no pressure gradient, the parcel traces a closed circle rotating solely with Coriolis. The radius is not arbitrary: R = −V/f. It has been measured in ocean currents.
Basınç gradyanının sıfır olduğu durumda,: Radius of the circular trajectory where Coriolis force alone provides the centripetal acceleration in the absence of a pressure gradient. It is negative in the Northern Hemisphere: motion is in the anticyclonic direction.
Basınç gradyanının, yörüngeye dik ve dön: Component of the pressure gradient taken along the normal axis perpendicular to the trajectory and pointing to the left of the direction of motion. Its sign encodes whether the center is a low or a high and determines the reality of the root.
Basınç haritada üç haneyle yazılır: 1013: Pressure is written with three digits on the map: 1013.4 hPa → 134, 998.6 hPa → 986. The leading 9 or 10 is added by the reader; values less than 500 start with 10, larger values with 9.
Basınç haritası: izobarlar sıksa |∇p| bü: Pressure map: closely spaced isobars mean large |∇p| → strong wind; PGF pushes in the OPPOSITE direction of the gradient.
Basınç hatası: QNH güncellenmezse her 1: Pressure error: if QNH is not updated, every 1 hPa difference means approximately 27 feet of altimeter error. When flying from high pressure to low pressure, the altimeter reads higher than actual; this is the classic warning.

Pressure push = g × slope of the surface.

Basınç için de aynı kural, ama 1/ρ çarpa: Same rule for pressure, but due to the 1/ρ factor this term does not vanish.
Basınç işi, kinetik enerji ve potansiyel: Pressure work, kinetic energy, and potential energy terms are summed.
Basınç işi: paket yükselip genleşince so: Pressure work: cools when the parcel rises and expands, warms when it sinks and compresses
Basınç koordinatlarında biçim çok sadele: The form simplifies greatly in pressure coordinates: −∇ₚΦ. Because density drops out, the spacing of geopotential height contours on a constant pressure map directly indicates the force's magnitude. This is why synoptic analysis favors the 500 hPa map so much.
Basınç koordinatlarında düşey hız, basın: In pressure coordinates, vertical velocity is the material rate of change of pressure: ω = Dp/Dt.
Basınç koordinatlarında en kullanışlı ha: It takes its most useful form in pressure coordinates: ∂u/∂x + ∂v/∂y + ∂ω/∂p = 0. Because density disappears, horizontal divergence and vertical velocity variation are directly linked. This is synoptic meteorology's method of "observing" vertical motion.
Basınç koordinatlarında yoğunluk düşer v: In pressure coordinates, density drops out and only the height gradient remains; it becomes directly applicable to the map.
Basınç koordinatlarında yoğunluk terimi: Because the density term drops out in pressure coordinates, the equation takes this simple form.
Basınç koordinatlarındaki düşey hız; işa: Vertical velocity in pressure coordinates; its sign is OPPOSITE to w, negative ω means rising air.
Basınç koordinatı denklemleri sadeleştir: Pressure coordinates simplify the equations (density is eliminated) but do not follow the terrain: over mountains, lower levels fall below ground. The sigma coordinate σ = p/pₛ resolves this issue; σ = 1 at the surface, 0 at the top, and the lower boundary fits the terrain exactly.
Basınç koordinatı seçilmesinin nedeni sü: The reason pressure coordinates are chosen is that the continuity equation becomes density-free and the lower boundary condition (ω ≈ 0, p = p_yüzey) is simplified. This is the natural coordinate of numerical models and QG theory.
Basınç koordinatına geçilir ve hidrostat: Pressure coordinates are adopted and hydrostatic balance is used.
Basınç koordinatına geçmek için hidrosta: Use hydrostatic + ideal gas to switch to pressure coordinates: g dz = −Rd Tv d(ln p).
Basınç koordinatında kütle korunumu yoğu: Mass conservation in pressure coordinates is density-independent; no incompressibility assumption is required.
Basınç koordinatındaki düşey hız; parsel: Vertical velocity in pressure coordinates; the material derivative of pressure experienced by the parcel. In a stable atmosphere, negative values produce adiabatic cooling, while positive values produce adiabatic warming.
Basınç koordinatındaki düşey hızı, alışı: Converts vertical velocity in pressure coordinates to conventional vertical velocity in m/s.
Basınç kuvveti ile Coriolis birbirini ta: Pressure gradient force and Coriolis balance each other exactly: the parcel stays along the isobar.
Basınç kuvveti ortadan kalkarsa hava pak: If the pressure gradient force vanishes, the air parcel traces a circle solely under the effect of Coriolis; the radius of the circle depends on speed, and the period on latitude.
Basınç kuvvetinin merkeze doğru ve çevre: Components of the pressure force toward the center and along the circumference.
Basınç perturbasyon kuvveti ihmal edilir: The pressure perturbation force is neglected; in supercells, this assumption is weak.
Basınç renk-alanı + İzobar’ı aç; sıkı iz: Enable Pressure color-field + Isobars; closely packed isobars indicate sharp pressure change.
Basınç seviyesi haritalarında çizilen ko: Contours drawn on pressure level maps are geopotential height; wind is parallel to these contours.
Basınç seviyesinde (850/500 hPa) çizgile: At pressure levels (850/500 hPa), the lines are isohypses; their unit is decameters (dam).
Basınç tarafı zaten hazırdı, doğrudan ye: The pressure side was already ready, we substitute directly.
Basınç terimi: (−∂p/∂x sin θ + ∂p/∂y cos: Pressure term: the combination (−∂p/∂x sin θ + ∂p/∂y cos θ)/ρ, when substituting (3.77)–(3.78), yields −(1/ρr)·∂p/∂θ; the 1/r factor comes from the chain rule coefficients ∂θ/∂x, ∂θ/∂y.
Basınç terimi: ∮dp/ρ — integrand ancak ρ: Pressure term: ∮dp/ρ — the integrand becomes an exact differential only if ρ = ρ(p) (barotropic condition).
Basınç terimini gradyan denkleminde fV_g: Replace the pressure term in the gradient equation with fV_g
Basınç terimini tanı: ∇p·ds = dp (Ara İş: Recognize the pressure term: ∇p·ds = dp (Intermediate Step #57)
Basınç terimlerinin tamamen sıfırlandığı: Assuming pressure terms vanish completely: the mixed derivative vanishes, the solenoid REMAINS (nonzero in a baroclinic atmosphere).
Basınç ve karışım oranı sabit tutularak: Cooling is assumed while holding pressure and mixing ratio constant.
Basınç yukarı doğru azaldığı için, yukar: Because pressure decreases upward, the pressure of a rising parcel decreases and Dp/Dt becomes negative. Therefore, on the map, blue (negative) ω indicates ascent and precipitation, while red (positive) ω indicates subsidence and clear skies.
Basınç yükseklikle neden düşer?: Why does pressure decrease with height?
How much the pressure surface is tilted.
Basınç yüzeyleri: ısınan sütunda yüzeyle: Pressure surfaces: surfaces rise in a warming column (hydrostatic + gas law).
Relationship between pressure, density, and temperature.
Basınçla düşünürsen yerçekimi kendiliğin: If you think in pressure coordinates, gravity disappears automatically.
Basınçlı akifer geçirimsiz bir tabaka al: A confined aquifer lies beneath an impermeable layer and the water is under pressure higher than atmospheric pressure. When a well is drilled, water rises above the top of the aquifer; if the piezometric surface exceeds the ground level, artesian flow occurs. Here, gravity does not dewater pores, it only compresses the water and matrix; the storage coefficient is very small, typically 10⁻⁵–10⁻³.
Batıdan doğuya akışı kesintiye uğratıp s: A high-latitude ridge or cut-off low structure that persists for days, disrupting west-to-east flow and deflecting cyclone tracks.
Batıdan rüzgâr u = 20 m/s: Wind from the west u = 20 m/s
Batılı akış Alp Dağları'nı aşarken: dağ: As westerly flow traverses the Alps: over the mountain h decreases → ζ decreases (anticyclonic ridge), on the lee side h increases → ζ increases (cyclonic trough): Genoa cyclogenesis. The permanent trough east of the Rocky Mountains is due to the same reason.
Batıya yayılmayı \"dalga batıya gider\": Reading westward propagation as "the wave travels westward": propagation is RELATIVE to the mean flow; total movement is most often eastward.
Bazı .ctl dosyalarında rüzgâr düğüm (kno: In some .ctl files, wind is in knots; the 30 m/s threshold then becomes meaningless. Verify the order of magnitude once with a `d ugrdprs` after `set lev`.
Bazı analizlerde üçüncü bir harf eklenir: In some analyses, a third letter is added: k (kalt/cold) indicates that the air mass is colder than the underlying surface, w (warm) indicates it is warmer. This letter directly conveys stability: a cPk air mass becomes unstable due to heating from below and produces cumulus, while an mTw air mass remains stable as it cools from below, yielding fog/stratus.
Bazı kaynaklarda 100 kPa yazılır; aynı ş: Some sources write 100 kPa; it is the same thing.
Bazı kaynaklarda γ = A·p olarak hPa/K bi: In some sources, it is given as γ = A·p in units of hPa/K (≈ 0.66 hPa/K).
Bağıl (yüzde) biçimi meteorolojide daha: The relative (percentage) form is more useful in meteorology: (1/es)(des/dT) = Lv/(RvT²). Around 283 K, this is approximately 0.067 K⁻¹, meaning roughly 7% per Kelvin. This "7% rule" is the single number describing how rapidly atmospheric moisture capacity increases in a warming climate.
Bağıl nem %100 iken bile mutlak nem düşü: Even when relative humidity is 100%, absolute humidity can be low (cold air).
Bağıl nem ciddi biçimde düşer; yangın ri: Relative humidity drops significantly; fire risk and snowmelt accelerate.
Bağıl nem ile karıştırılmamalıdır: q hav: Should not be confused with relative humidity: q gives the absolute amount of water in the air, while RH is the ratio of that amount to the capacity. Cold morning air with 100% relative humidity can contain much less water than warm afternoon air with 40% relative humidity.
Bağıl nem sıcaklığa bağlı olduğu için ne: Because relative humidity depends on temperature, anyone wanting to compare the "amount" of moisture looks at mixing ratio or dew point.
Bağıl nem sıcaklığa bağlıdır: gece sıcak: Relative humidity depends on temperature: as temperature drops at night, humidity naturally rises.
Bağıl vortisite ve ıraksama birlikte oku: Relative vorticity and divergence are read together: if there is positive vorticity advection ahead of the trough axis and upper-level divergence, low-level ascent and pressure fall are expected.
Bağıl vortisite ζ = ∂v/∂x − ∂u/∂y akışın: Relative vorticity ζ = ∂v/∂x − ∂u/∂y measures the local rotation of the flow. A positive value is counterclockwise in the Northern Hemisphere, which is cyclonic rotation.
Bağıl vortisite, yatay rüzgârın düşey ek: Relative vorticity is twice the local angular velocity of the horizontal wind about the vertical axis; it is the sum of shear and curvature contributions.
Bağıl vortisitenin düşey bileşeni: hız a: Vertical component of relative vorticity: the vertical projection of the curl of the velocity field. It is the rotation measured RELATIVE to the rotating Earth; positive for cyclonic rotation in the Northern Hemisphere.
Bağıl vortisiteyi mutlak sanmak klasik h: Mistaking relative vorticity for absolute is a classic error: `vor` by itself oscillates around zero in both north and south; conservation interpretations are made with `avor`.
Bağıntı dalga boyuna bağlıdır; C ve S ba: The relationship depends on wavelength; C and S band coefficients differ.
Bağıntı sadeliğine göre şaşırtıcı biçimd: The relationship is surprisingly good given its simplicity: under typical summer conditions, the error is below 10% and agrees with cloud base observations. In aviation, cumulus base height is estimated using this rule; in thousands of feet, the rule of thumb is "400 ft for every 1 °C difference".
Bağıntı yola bağlı değildir: paket 1000: The relationship is path-independent: regardless of how the parcel travels from 1000 hPa to 700 hPa, if there is no heat exchange, the temperature it reaches is the same. This is another expression of the conservation of θ and enables tracking air parcels (trajectory analysis).
Bağıntının en önemli sonucu r·dr/dt = sa: The most important consequence of the relationship is that r·dr/dt = constant: radius increases with the square root of time. While growing from 1 μm to 10 μm takes minutes, growing from 10 μm to 100 μm (the raindrop threshold) takes hours. Yet in real clouds, rain forms in 20-30 minutes.
Bağıntıyı f(x₁, …, xₙ) = 0 biçiminde yaz: Write the relation in the form f(x₁, …, xₙ) = 0.
Başka iş bitmeden başlama: Do not start before other work is finished
Başlaması için birkaç \"iri tohum\" daml: It requires a few "large seed" drops to initiate, typically above 20–25 μm in radius. Giant nuclei such as sea salt provide these seeds; in polluted continental air, the process initiates late because droplets remain small and uniform.
Başlangıç koşulu döngüsü: her ızgara nok: Initial condition loop: physical x-coordinate is being generated for each grid point.
Başlangıç koşulu ve model fiziği hafifçe: Multiple forecasts generated by slightly perturbing initial conditions and model physics.
Başlangıç koşulundaki küçük hata birkaç: Because small errors in initial conditions grow within a few days, data assimilation quality is one of the most critical determinants of forecast quality.
Başlangıç koşulundaki küçük hataların bü: Small errors in initial conditions growing until the forecast becomes unusable after a certain period.
Başlangıç noktası #46'da kurulan teğetse: The starting point is the tangential equation of motion established in #46. The component of the Coriolis force containing vertical velocity (2Ω cosφ · w) is dropped here: on the synoptic scale, while w ≈ 10⁻² m/s, horizontal velocities are on the order of 10¹ m/s, meaning this term is three orders of magnitude smaller than the others. This is a NEGLECT decision, not a result; it is justified by scale analysis and is safe for horizontal ring motion.
Başlangıç noktası barotropik korunum yas: The starting point is the barotropic conservation law: in non-divergent flow, absolute vorticity is conserved following the parcel. The perturbation method divides the field into a large, constant basic state flow (U) and a small perturbation. The Coriolis parameter is also expanded linearly with latitude (β-plane): the very raison d'être of the wave is this β term; had f been assumed constant, the wave would never have originated.
Başlangıç-değer problemi şu demektir: du: An initial-value problem means: of the variables describing the state (wind, temperature, pressure, humidity)
Başlangıç: basınç kuvvetinin doğu-batı v: Initial: east-west and north-south components of the pressure force.
Başlangıçta 0,1 K'lik fark, 2 günde ikiy: An initial difference of 0.1 K increases to ~3.2 K in 10 days, assuming doubling every 2 days.
Başlangıçta Dünya ile birlikte dönen ama: Initially, a ring rotating with the Earth but having no relative rotation of its own is considered. The first term vanishes; only the share inherited from the Earth's rotation remains. If the ring contracts (R₂ < R₁), the bracket is positive and Vθ2 > 0: the ring spontaneously begins to rotate CYCLONICALLY.
Başlangıçta durgun bir halka bile büzülü: Even an initially motionless ring begins to rotate cyclonically upon contraction; this is the effect of convergence in tropical cyclogenesis.
Başlangıçta durgun bir halkanın büzülünc: To show why an initially motionless ring spontaneously begins to rotate upon contraction.
Başlangıçtaki küçük hataların hızla büyü: Small initial errors rapidly growing and limiting the forecast.

Bedeli ağırdır: f sabitken planeter vort: The cost is heavy: when f is constant, planetary vorticity advection is zero, so Rossby waves cannot exist on an f-plane. Large-scale wave motion propagating westward arises entirely from the variation of f.
Bedeli ağırdır: minimizasyon için modeli: The cost is heavy: minimization requires linearized and adjoint versions of the model; their development and maintenance is a major undertaking. For this reason, hybrid approaches combining ensemble-based methods have become widespread.
Bedeli çözünürlük ve kapsamadır: uzaklık: The cost is resolution and coverage: pixels are large due to distance, and latitudes higher than 60° are viewed at very oblique, distorted angles. The poles are practically invisible.
Bedeli: komşuluk ilişkisi artık basit i,: The cost: neighbor relations can no longer be given by a simple i,j index.

Belirlenmesi birkaç yolla yapılır: sonda: Determination is done in several ways: the level where the dry adiabatic lapse rate ends on a sounding, the level where the bulk Richardson number exceeds the critical value, or the sharp drop in the ceilometer/lidar backscatter profile. The three methods typically yield 20–30% different results.
Belirleyici mekanizma konfluenstir: iki: The governing mechanism is confluence: isotherms pack together in the deformation field where two flow branches approach each other. But not every deformation field is frontogenetic; isotherms must make an angle of less than 45° with the STRETCHING axis of the flow. If the angle exceeds this, the same field frontolyzes the front.
Belirli bir ana saat eklemek: geçerlilik: Adding a specific synoptic hour: the core of valid time calculation.
Belirli bir anda her noktasında hız vekt: A curve tangent to the velocity vector at every point at a given instant; it is the geometric snapshot of the instantaneous wind field. If the field changes over time, streamlines also change and do not coincide with parcel trajectories.
Belirli bir basınç seviyesindeki izobari: Isobaric vertical velocity at a given pressure level. Obtained by integrating the continuity equation from the surface to that level, it carries the divergence of the entire layer beneath it, not just of a single level.
Belirli bir kesitten geçen suyu toplayan: The area bounded by a drainage divide that collects water passing through a specific cross-section.
Belirli bir süre için biriken yağışın, o: An index indicating how many standard deviations the accumulated precipitation for a given period deviates from the region's long-term distribution.
Belirli bir sürede (genelde 3 saat) bası: A line connecting points of equal pressure change over a given period (typically 3 hours).
Belirli bir sıcaklıkta havanın taşıyabil: The maximum water vapor pressure air can hold at a given temperature; depends solely on temperature.
Belirli büyüklükteki bir olayın aşılması: The average time elapsed between exceedances of an event of a given magnitude.
Belirli büyüklükteki bir taşkının ortala: Estimates how many years on average a flood of a given magnitude is exceeded, based on its rank in observational records.
How many years on average a flood of a given magnitude is expected to be exceeded.
Belirli sürede düşen 1 birim (genelde 1: The direct runoff hydrograph produced at the watershed outlet by 1 unit (typically 1 mm) of effective precipitation falling in a specified duration.
Belirli sıcaklıktaki bir siyah cismin he: The fundamental function giving how much radiance a blackbody at a given temperature emits at each wavelength.
The curve showing how much radiation a blackbody at a given temperature emits at each wavelength.

Benzetim moleküler difüzyondandır: w'θ': The analogy is from molecular diffusion: w'θ' = −Kₕ·∂θ̄/∂z. That is, the flux flows down-gradient, and the steeper the gradient, the larger the flux. K is the "effective eddy diffusivity" of turbulence and is 10⁵–10⁶ times the molecular value.

Beta düzlemi ayrıca planeter dalga boyun: The beta plane also explains why planetary wavelengths are thousands of kilometers: because the restoring force is weak, the corresponding wave is long and slow.

CAPE'yi sıcaklıkla (T) değil sanal sıcak: CAPE must be calculated using virtual temperature (T_v), not temperature (T); in moist tropical profiles, the difference reaches up to 20%.
CAPE, kaldırma ivmesinin yol boyunca int: CAPE is the path integral of buoyant acceleration; that is, work per unit mass, with units of J/kg. On a Skew-T diagram, this is precisely the "positive area" between the parcel curve and the environmental curve between the LFC and EL. The reason the diagram is designed to be equal-area is to make this reading possible.
CAPE, kaldırma ivmesinin yükseklik boyun: CAPE is the integral of buoyant acceleration over height; in other words, CAPE represents the total work done by buoyancy.
CAPE, parselin çevreden sıcak olduğu böl: CAPE is the area of the region where the parcel is warmer than the environment and gives the convective potential in J/kg. CIN is the negative area the parcel must overcome — this is the "cap".
CAPE, parselin çevreden sıcak olduğu kat: CAPE is the work done by buoyancy across the layer where the parcel is warmer than the environment; its square root gives the upper limit of the storm updraft.
CAPE: kaldırma kuvvetinin integrali ve e: CAPE: integral of buoyancy and maximum updraft velocity

CIN büyükse: CAPE kullanılamaz, enerji \: If CIN is large: CAPE cannot be tapped, energy remains "locked", and it may discharge as an evening outbreak.
CIN in aşılması yalnız ısınmayla olmaz;: Overcoming CIN does not happen through heating alone; moisture increase also lowers the LFC, reducing the threshold. When interpreting model output, CAPE and CIN must be evaluated together, alongside surface convergence.
CIN in kaynağı genelde bir enversiyon ya: The source of CIN is usually an inversion or upper-level subsidence warming. In Turkish summers, warm, dry mid-level air coming over the Mediterranean is a classic cap producer; it appears on soundings as distinct warming between 800–700 hPa.
CIN in tamamen yok olduğu yüzey sıcaklığ: Surface temperature at which CIN completely vanishes.
CIN negatif bir enerjidir; mutlak değeri: CIN is negative energy; it is referred to by its absolute value, but its sign must not be forgotten.
CIN yüksek diye şiddetli hava riski düşü: Severe weather risk is often deemed low simply because CIN is high; the most severe events frequently occur on days when high CIN breaks late in the day.
CIN çok küçükse: konveksiyon erken ve da: If CIN is very small: convection initiates early and scattered; because energy does not accumulate, cells remain weak.
CIN'i aşmanın yolları: yüzeyin ısınması,: Ways to overcome CIN: surface heating, low-level moisture increase, frontal or orographic lifting, upper-level cold advection.
CIN, kaldırılan paketin seçimine çok duy: CIN is highly sensitive to the choice of lifted parcel (SB/ML/MU yield different results).

Cephe bir çizgi değil, kalınlığı 50–200: A front is not a line, but a zone with a width of 50–200 km; the line drawn on the map is the WARM edge of this zone. The zone is tilted vertically because cold air, being denser, wedges underneath; warm air ascends over this wedge.

Cephe bölgelerinde Q vektörleri sıcak ha: In frontal zones, Q-vectors point toward the warm air; directly linked to frontogenesis.
Cephe geçişinde rüzgâr aniden döner, sıc: During a frontal passage, the wind shifts abruptly, temperature and dew point drop, and pressure begins to rise.
Cephe geçişinde çiy noktası ani düşer —: The dew point drops sharply during a frontal passage — the clearest sign of an air mass change.
Cephe geçişini sıcaklık düşüşüyle saptam: Detecting a frontal passage by the temperature drop is delayed; the earliest and most reliable signs are the veering of the wind and the sign change of the pressure tendency.
Cephe geçişinin en net imzası çiy noktas: The clearest signature of a frontal passage is the sudden drop in dew point; temperature sometimes responds slowly, but the dew point changes immediately.
Cephe her zaman siklonik kesme taşır: ce: A front always carries cyclonic shear: the wind veers (in the Northern Hemisphere) when crossing the front. A temperature difference carrying anticyclonic shear is not a front, so it is not analyzed.
Cephe katmanı + Adveksiyon: sıcak adveks: Front layer + Advection: warm advection and jet exit are regions of ascent.

Cephe kuşağında 150 km'de 6 K fark varsa: If there is a 6 K difference over 150 km in the frontal zone, |∇T| = 6/(1.5·10⁵) = 4·10⁻⁵ K/m.
Cephe kuşağında sıcaklığın 100 km'de 5 K: In a frontal zone where temperature changes by 5 K over 100 km, the gradient is large; in a homogeneous air mass, it is near zero.
Cephe kuşağında ve deniz meltemi sınırın: This term operates in the frontal zone and along the sea breeze boundary; it is the point-wise form of Bjerknes' theorem.
Cephe kuşağında |∇T| ≈ 5–10 K/100 km · o: In the frontal zone |∇T| ≈ 5–10 K/100 km · mid-latitude pressure gradient 1–5 hPa/100 km

Cephe sisi: sıcak cephe yağmurunun altın: Frontal fog: warm front rain saturating the cold air beneath it.

Cephe çizgileri yer haritasındakiyle ayn: Frontal lines use the same symbols as on surface charts: triangles represent cold fronts, semicircles warm fronts. Upper-level charts typically contain jet and tropopause information instead of fronts.
Cephe çizgisinde gradyan sıkışır; rüzgâr: At the frontal line, the gradient tightens; wind strengthens along the front. The two sides of the front are two different air masses.
Cepheler alçak merkezden çıkar: Fronts emanate from the low center

Cephenin hareketini, cepheye DİK rüzgâr: The movement of a front is determined by the wind component PERPENDICULAR to the front. When the flow on both sides becomes parallel to the front, the perpendicular component drops to zero and the front stalls. Its symbol on the chart illustrates this as well: triangles point in one direction, semicircles in the opposite direction.
Cepheye 30° açıyla esen 10 m/s rüzgârın: The perpendicular component of a 10 m/s wind blowing at a 30° angle to the front is 5 m/s; when this component approaches zero, the front is stationary.
Cepheyi yüzey haritasında bulmak için te: A single variable is not enough to identify a front on a surface chart. Four signatures are sought together: a sharp jump in temperature and dew point across a narrow zone, a cyclonic wind shift (sharp change in direction from left to right), a trough in the pressure field, and a sign change in pressure tendency. Relying solely on temperature differences can lead to mistaking land-sea contrast for a front.
Chunk boyutu bir ayar meselesidir: çok k: Chunk size is a matter of tuning: very small chunks increase scheduling overhead, while very large chunks increase peak memory usage. A good rule of thumb is 50–200 MB per chunk.

Because fluid very close to the surface has already lost energy to friction, it cannot overcome this adverse pressure gradient; it decelerates to a stop and begins to flow backward. Downstream of the separation point, flow detaches from the surface, leaving behind a low-pressure, turbulent wake.

Coriolis ihmal edilebildiğinde (küçük öl: When Coriolis can be neglected (small scale), curvature/centrifugal dominates → cyclostrophic. If PGF is zero, air traces a pure inertia circle with period 2π/f.

Coriolis kuvveti bu kalınlıkta önemsizdi: Coriolis force is negligible across this depth; wind direction does not veer with height, only its speed increases. Directional turning (Ekman spiral) begins above the surface layer.

Coriolis kuvvetinin hız büyüklüğünü deği: Assuming that the Coriolis force changes the speed. Since the force is perpendicular to velocity, it does not alter kinetic energy; it only deflects the direction.
Coriolis kuvvetinin ihmal edilebildiği k: The velocity at which the pressure gradient force alone provides the centripetal acceleration in small-scale rotations where the Coriolis force is negligible. Valid in regimes with very large Rossby numbers.
Coriolis kuzeye gidince büyür; bu küçük: Coriolis increases toward the north; this small variation leaves a tiny residual in geostrophic divergence.
Coriolis oku silindi; PGF ile merkezcil: Coriolis vector removed; PGF and centripetal term are left head-to-head.

Coriolis parametresi; gradyan rüzgârı de: Coriolis parameter; coefficient of the quadratic term in the gradient wind equation. Its ratio to centripetal acceleration yields the curvature Rossby number and determines which regime the balance approaches.
Coriolis parametresi; ölçek analizinde d: Coriolis parameter; sets the time scale of rotation as 1/f in scale analysis. Since it resides in the denominator of the Rossby number, the geostrophic approximation breaks down as it approaches zero.

Rate of change of the Coriolis parameter toward the north. When f is not held constant, geostrophic divergence is not strictly zero; a small residual of order −βv_g/f remains.
