Coriolis terimi fU ≈ 10⁻⁴·10 = 10⁻³ m/s²: Coriolis term fU ≈ 10⁻⁴·10 = 10⁻³ m/s²; acceleration U²/L ≈ 100/10⁶ = 10⁻⁴ m/s² → acceleration is 10 times smaller.
Coriolis terimi hıza DİK etki eder. Dik: The Coriolis term acts PERPENDICULAR to velocity. Being perpendicular, it does no work on the parcel and cannot change speed; it only turns direction. This property is why it generates no energy in the atmosphere yet organizes all large-scale circulation.
Coriolis term order of magnitude: f·V.
Coriolis terimi taşınımdan 10 kat, molek: The Coriolis term is 10 times larger than advection and 10¹³ times larger than molecular viscosity. This is why geostrophic balance is such a good approximation at synoptic scale and molecular viscosity is neglected.
Coriolis teriminin silindirik tabandaki: Deriving the components of the Coriolis term in a cylindrical basis and showing how the definition of Vθ re-emerges.
Coriolis ve merkezkaç birer kuvvet değil: Coriolis and centrifugal are not forces but acceleration corrections; seeking a reaction force to them is incorrect.

Coriolis −2Ω×V: perpendicular to both Ω and V.
Coriolis −fV n̂, basınç gradyanı −(1/ρ)∂: Coriolis −fV n̂, pressure gradient −(1/ρ)∂p/∂n; the n̂ component is the common source of the four wind balances.
Coriolis'e t̂ bileşeni vermek. Coriolis: Assigning a t̂ component to Coriolis. Coriolis is perpendicular to velocity; in natural coordinates, it is purely along the n̂ direction.
Coriolis'in %1'i: sinoptik ölçekte atılı: 1% of Coriolis: neglected at synoptic scale, retained in global models.
Coriolis'in ihmal edildiği küçük ölçekte: Balance between centrifugal and PGF at small scales where Coriolis is neglected.
Coriolis'in ihmal edildiği, basınç grady: Small-scale rotation where Coriolis is neglected and pressure gradient balances centrifugal force.
Coriolis'in kutupta değil ekvatorda \"en: Assuming Coriolis is "largest" at the equator rather than at the pole; Ω × r speed is large at the equator, but f (horizontal deflection) is zero at the equator.

Denge iklim duyarlılığı, zorlamayı sıcak: Equilibrium climate sensitivity is the coefficient converting forcing into temperature response: ΔT = λ·ΔF. λ is estimated to be approximately in the range of 0.5–1.2 K/(W/m²); most of the uncertainty comes from cloud feedback.
Denge kurulduğunda cismin sıcaklığı deği: When equilibrium is established, the body's temperature must not change: absorbed power = emitted power.
Denge kurulduğunda net kuvvet sıfırdır,: When equilibrium is established, the net force is zero; therefore, the parcel is unaccelerated and flows in a straight line parallel to the isobars. Denge kurulduğunda rüzgâr izobarları kes: When equilibrium is established, the wind does not cross isobars; in the Northern Hemisphere, low pressure remains on the left.
Denge sıcaklığı 255 K, gözlenen 288 K →: Equilibrium temperature 255 K, observed 288 K → greenhouse effect 33 K; equivalent by Stefan-Boltzmann ≈ 150 W/m².
Denge tanısaldır: rüzgârı verir ama zama: Balance is diagnostic: it gives the wind, but does not state how it evolves over time. To understand development, one must return to acceleration terms of order Ro (gradient wind, quasi-geostrophic theory).
Denge, düşey ivmenin yerçekimi yanında i: Balance holds at scales where vertical acceleration is negligible compared to gravity. It breaks down in severe convection (cumulonimbus core).

Denklem Newton'un ikinci yasasının akışk: The equation is the fluid form of Newton's second law: acceleration = pressure gradient force + viscous force + body forces. The material acceleration on the left-hand side contains the term ∂V/∂t + (V·∇)V; the second term is non-linear, and the entire difficulty of fluid mechanics stems from here.
Denklem Newton'un ikinci yasasının dönme: The equation is the rotational counterpart of Newton's second law: in linear motion "force = rate of change of momentum", in rotational motion "torque = rate of change of angular momentum". The air's rotational capital changes only if a torque is applied.
Denklem Newton'ın ikinci yasasının sürek: The equation is the continuum form of Newton's second law. The left-hand side is acceleration and consists of two parts: local change (∂V/∂t) and advection (V·∇V). The latter is NOT linear; this very term is the mathematical origin of turbulence, chaos, and the limit of predictability.
Denklem R ile çarpılıp sıfıra eşitlenir:: The equation is multiplied by R and set to zero: a = 1, b = fR, c = (R/ρ)∂p/∂n. V is the unknown; R, f, and gradient are read from the map.
Denklem ampiriktir; fiziksel temelli alt: The equation is empirical; its physically based alternative is the Green–Ampt approach.
Denklem aynı zamanda ω'yı teşhis etmenin: The equation is also the second way to diagnose ω (adiabatic method): temperature change and advection are measured, and the equation is solved for ω. Together with the kinematic method, they form the two source terms of the quasi-geostrophic omega equation.
Denklem bir tanı (diagnostic) aracıdır:: The equation is a diagnostic tool: it contains no time derivative and infers ω solely from the instantaneous fields. It has two classic forcing terms: the INCREASE of positive vorticity advection with height and thermal advection itself.
Denklem dört mekanizma sıralar: adveksiy: The equation lists four mechanisms: advection (transport of vorticity), stretching/divergence term (spin-up as the column stretches), tilting term (conversion of horizontal-axis rotation to vertical), and baroclinic (solenoid) generation.
Denklem kütle korunumunun havza ölçeğind: The equation is the watershed-scale form of mass conservation, and each term is expressed in the same unit (usually mm/year). To convert to volume, it is multiplied by the watershed area: 1 mm over 1 km² means 1000 m³.
Denklem sıcaklık adveksiyonunun kendisiy: The equation operates not with temperature advection itself, but with its VARIATION WITH HEIGHT; constant advection at a single level produces no tendency.
Denklem tarımsal su yönetiminin temelidi: The equation is the foundation of agricultural water management; its simplified form for a reference crop (12 cm grass) is used as ET₀ and multiplied by a crop coefficient to find the actual water requirement. A standard station already measures the meteorological inputs: net radiation, temperature, humidity, and wind.
Denklem yerel ve anlıktır: bir noktadaki: The equation is local and instantaneous: it connects three variables at a single point, without describing how they change over time. Evolution is provided by the system established together with hydrostatic balance, continuity, and the first law of thermodynamics.
Denklem, f'in enlemle değişmesiyle birle: When combined with the variation of f with latitude, the equation produces Rossby waves.
Denklem, radar sabitiyle (donanıma özgü: The equation enables direct calculation of Z by simplifying with the radar constant (the sum of hardware-specific terms). Calibration error converts directly into a dBZ shift and is carried from there into precipitation estimation.
Denklem, sıvı ve buhar fazlarının bir ar: The equation is derived from the condition that the free energy of both phases remains equal along the curve where liquid and vapor phases coexist in equilibrium (phase boundary). The result is a thermodynamic necessity rather than an empirical one: if latent heat is large, the phase boundary is steep, meaning saturation vapor pressure increases rapidly with temperature.
Denklemde ZAMAN TÜREVİ YOKTUR — bu onu t: There is NO TIME DERIVATIVE in the equation — this makes it diagnostic: if horizontal divergence is known for an instant, the variation of ω with pressure is known directly, without requiring integration in time. The term (1/ρ)Dρ/Dt in the Cartesian continuity equation disappeared on its own thanks to the simplification in Step 3. The kinematic ω method integrates this exact equation along p.

Denklemde nem açığı (eₛ − eₐ) kullanılır: Vapor pressure deficit (eₛ − eₐ) is used in the equation, not relative humidity; 60% relative humidity means very different deficits at 10 °C and 30 °C.
Denklemdeki R, evrensel gaz sabitinin (8: R in the equation is the universal gas constant (8.314 J·mol⁻¹·K⁻¹) divided by the average molar mass of dry air (28.96 g/mol): Rd = 8314/28.96 ≈ 287 J·kg⁻¹·K⁻¹. Since water vapor is lighter, its specific gas constant is larger: Rv ≈ 461.5 J·kg⁻¹·K⁻¹.

Denklemin bir başka sonucu: buz üstündek: Another consequence of the equation: because latent heat over ice (sublimation, Ls ≈ 2.83×10⁶ J/kg) is greater than latent heat of vaporization, the ice curve is steeper and lies below the water curve below 0 °C. The difference between the two curves is greatest around −12 °C, fueling rapid growth of ice crystals in mixed-phase clouds.
Denklemin en sık kullanılan özel hâli: P: The most commonly used special case of the equation: PGF = Coriolis.
Denklemin görünmeyen bir sınırı zayıflam: An unseen limitation of the equation is attenuation. Heavy precipitation, particularly in the X-band, shadows the region behind the beam, making cells that actually exist invisible. The effect is less in the C-band and negligible in the S-band; this is the primary rationale for radar band selection.
Denklemin gücü, basınç gradyan kuvvetini: The strength of the equation is that the pressure gradient force drops out entirely under barotropic conditions. That is why early numerical weather prediction models used the barotropic vorticity equation instead of the full primitive equations and still yielded meaningful results.
Denklemin her terimini adıyla okuyabilme: Being able to read every term of the equation by name is more valuable than memorizing it. The left-hand side is the rate of change of absolute angular momentum along the parcel. The first term on the right is the torque arising if there is an azimuthal pressure gradient around the ring — in a circularly symmetric ring this is zero. The second is the torque of friction; it is neglected in the free atmosphere. If both are zero, M IS CONSERVED, and this conservation is the sole foundation of the ring problem in #49.
Denklemin pratik zorluğu ET yi ölçmenin: The practical difficulty of the equation is the challenge of measuring ET; typically P and Q are measured and ET is obtained as a residual term. This means all measurement errors accumulate into ET — this is the most frequently overlooked point in watershed budget studies.
Denklemin sol tarafı hareketi izleyen tü: The left-hand side of the equation is the material derivative following the motion: it is computed on the model grid as ∂U/∂t + U·∇U; because U·∇U is non-linear, this is where the chaos limit of weather forecasting lies. On the right-hand side, only the pressure gradient is "forcing"; Coriolis deflects direction, gravity establishes the vertical, and friction dissipates energy.
Denklemin tanısal olduğunu ve düşey hız: To see that the equation is diagnostic and yields vertical velocity ω from horizontal divergence.
Denklemin taşkın açısından anlamı şudur:: The significance of the equation for flooding is this: surface runoff begins the moment rainfall intensity exceeds infiltration capacity. A short, intense downpour can produce far more runoff than a long, gentle rain, even if it yields less total water. This mechanism is called Hortonian overland flow and is especially dominant on arid, crusted, or impermeable surfaces.
Denklemin zayıf noktası zamanın bağımsız: The weak point of the equation is that time is the independent variable: even if rainfall stops, the formula indicates that infiltration continues to decrease, which is unphysical. Therefore, in intermittent rainfall, forms expressed in terms of cumulative infiltration are preferred.

It may dominate in the short term (a storm, a season); in the long-term average, it approaches zero and the equation simplifies to P = Q + ET. If groundwater is being over-extracted, ΔS is permanently negative, and this is the clearest warning the equation provides.

Determinant, birinci satırdaki her birim: The determinant is expanded for each unit vector in the first row by multiplying it with the remaining 2×2 minor when its row and column are removed. The sign pattern is (+, −, +): the middle term enters with a MINUS. This minus comes from the cofactor rule itself — not from physics — and when forgotten, the j component ends up with the opposite sign. Writing the pattern BEFORE the expansion prevents this error from the start.

Determinantı açınca üç bileşen çıkar; me: Expanding the determinant yields three components; meteorology retains only the vertical one (k̂·∇×V) and calls it ζ.
Determinantın j satırındaki eksi işareti: The minus sign in the j row of the determinant is where most points are lost in exams: the minus in −fu originates from there. Also, do not forget to translate the "deflection to the right" rule of thumb into actual directions: moving north deflects east, moving east deflects south, moving south deflects west, moving west deflects north.

Değer aralığı çok geniş olduğu için loga: Because the range of values is very wide, a logarithmic scale is used: dBZ = 10·log₁₀(Z). Thus, the scale spanning from 0.001 to 10⁷ is compressed between −30 and +70 dBZ. A 10-unit increase in dBZ corresponds to a 10-fold increase in Z.

Dört terim de ikinci mertebeden küçüktür: All four terms are second-order small (product of two small factors) — δβ δn and δn δs. This foreshadows why dividing by area ultimately yields a finite result.
Dört terim doğar. İlk ikisi ortak ∂p/∂r: Four terms arise. The first two share the common factor ∂p/∂r; the last two are identical in magnitude and OPPOSITE in sign. The entire secret of simplification lies in this opposite-signed identical pair.
Dört terim, ortak çarpanlarına göre iki: The four terms are separated into two groups based on their common factors. This grouping is not arbitrary: the resulting two parenthetical expressions are the exact radial and tangential components of the cylindrical equation of motion. They are arranged in the exact same rotation pattern as the initial velocity transformation (u = Vr cos θ − Vθ sin θ); therefore, extracting the equations in #46 reduces to a single multiply-and-add operation.
Dört terimli genel özdeşlik yazılır, son: The general four-term identity is written, then the fact that Ω is a CONSTANT vector is used: every derivative of a constant vector is zero, so ∇·Ω = 0 and (R·∇)Ω = 0. Two of the four terms thus vanish. Seeing which term drops out and why before memorizing the identity allows making the same elimination in similar calculations.
Dört çarpım terimi (∂v/∂x − ∂u/∂y)(∂u/∂x: The four product terms factor into (∂v/∂x − ∂u/∂y)(∂u/∂x + ∂v/∂y) = ζ ∇_H·V. The terms with f yield f ∇_H·V and v∂f/∂y = df/dt (f depends only on y, ∂f/∂t = ∂f/∂x = 0).

Dünya ile birlikte dönen bir noktanın hı: The velocity of a point rotating with the Earth is the cross product of the angular velocity vector and the position vector. This is the fundamental relation of rotating body kinematics and assumes that the Earth rotates as a solid body — an assumption that is exact for the sphere beneath the atmosphere. The objective is to take the curl of this field to find the Earth's own vorticity.
Dünya ile birlikte dönen yerel koordinat: Unit vectors of the local coordinate system rotating with the Earth. Viewed from the inertial frame, they are not constant; their time derivatives yield a cross product with Ω, which is the source of the additional term.
Dünya küresi üzerinde Ω, yerel eksen üçl: Ω on the terrestrial sphere, the local triad, and decomposition of Ω sin φ / Ω cos φ; f live.
Dünya merkezinden hava parseline çizilen: Position vector drawn from the center of the Earth to the air parcel. Its component perpendicular to the axis, R = r cos φ, determines the lever arm of the rotation-induced tangential velocity.
Dünya merkezinden İstanbul'daki parsele: Arrow drawn from the center of the Earth to the parcel in Istanbul.
Dünya yuvarlak olduğu için doğan sahte e: Spurious additional terms arising because the Earth is round; small but not zero.
Dünya üzerindeki bir noktanın hızı: dönm: Velocity of a point on Earth: rotation vector cross position vector.
Dünya Ω açısal hızıyla döner; dönen sist: The Earth rotates with angular velocity Ω; the acceleration observed in the rotating frame differs from that in the inertial frame by −2Ω × V.
Dünya'nın açısal hız vektörü; konum vekt: Earth's angular velocity vector; its cross product with the position vector yields the velocity of the rotating frame. Its magnitude is identical everywhere, but the rotation velocity decreases with latitude as a cosine.
Dünya'nın açısal hız vektörü; yerel kart: Earth's angular velocity vector; when decomposed into local Cartesian axes, only its northern and vertical components remain, while the eastern component is zero. All Coriolis components derive from this decomposition.
Dünya'nın açısal hız vektörünün yerel dü: Twice the local vertical component of the Earth's angular velocity vector; it is the sole parameter representing rotation in the horizontal equations of motion. It varies with the sine of latitude and vanishes at the equator.
Dünya'nın açısal hızı Ω = 2π/86164 s ≈ 7: Earth's angular velocity is Ω = 2π/86164 s ≈ 7.292·10⁻⁵ rad/s. The denominator is the sidereal day, not the solar day; using 24 hours introduces an error of three parts per thousand in Ω, which carries over into the calculation of f.
Dünya'nın açısal hızı; Coriolis terimind: Earth's angular velocity; appears to the first power in the Coriolis term and to the second power in the centrifugal term. Therefore, when the rotation rate changes, the two terms scale at different rates.
Dünya'nın dönme eksenine paralel, kuzeye: Angular velocity vector parallel to the Earth's axis of rotation, directed northward. Its magnitude is computed from the reciprocal of the sidereal day and is assumed constant throughout the atmosphere.
Dünya'nın dönme ekseninin yörünge düzlem: The 23.44° tilt of the Earth's axis of rotation from the normal to the orbital plane; the single primary cause of seasons.
Dünya'nın dönme hızı bir milyar yıl önce: Earth's rotation rate one billion years ago was 10% greater than today; centrifugal force was 21% stronger in that era.
Dünya'nın dönme hızı; parseli enleme bağ: Earth's rotation rate; carries the parcel eastward at a latitude-dependent speed.
Dünya'nın dönme oku; yerel eksenlerde ku: Earth's rotation vector; splits into two components in local axes: northward and upward.
Dünya'nın dönmesinden kaynaklanan sabit: The constant centrifugal component arising from Earth's rotation is incorporated into gravity. The "effective gravity" g we measure is the sum of true gravitation and this term; hence g is 9.780 m/s² at the equator, 9.832 m/s² at the pole, and the Earth is an oblate spheroid, not a perfect sphere.
Dünya'nın dönüşünü tek bir okla anlatan: The vector representing Earth's rotation with a single arrow: points upward from the pole.
Dünya'nın dönüşünün o enlemde ne kadar h: How strongly Earth's rotation is felt at that latitude.
Dünya'nın ekvatorda şişkin olmasının ned: The reason why the Earth bulges at the equator; incorporated into gravity.
The rotation readily imparted to the air by the Earth.

Dünya'nın kendi ekseni etrafındaki açısa: Earth's angular velocity about its own axis; defined relative to the sidereal day. It is the common factor of the Coriolis and centrifugal terms.
Arrow extending from the center of the Earth to the parcel.

Deflection of the wind by the Earth's rotation.

Düz (eğrilik etkisi olmayan) ve saf su y: Flat (without curvature effect) and pure water surface.

Düz bir su yüzeyi ile dengedeki buharın: The partial pressure of vapor in equilibrium with a flat water surface. It is a function of temperature alone; it does not depend on the moisture content of the air, its pressure, or the presence of other gases.
Düz izobarlar arasında rüzgâr izobara pa: Between straight isobars, the wind blows parallel to the isobars; the pressure gradient force and Coriolis balance each other exactly. This is the fundamental assumption of large-scale flow in the free atmosphere.
Düz kolon (h sabit), ıraksamasız akış: D: Flat column (h constant), non-divergent flow: D(ζ+f)/Dt = 0. Flow = constant westerly U + small perturbation (u', v'); non-divergent via perturbation streamfunction ψ': u' = −∂ψ'/∂y, v' = ∂ψ'/∂x. β-plane: f = f₀ + βy.

Düz su yüzeyi ile üstündeki buhar denged: A flat water surface and the vapor above it are in equilibrium: the number of evaporating and condensing molecules is equal. In thermodynamic equilibrium, the Gibbs free energies of the two phases are equal; when temperature changes, the equilibrium pressure also changes. The Clapeyron equation gives this variation in terms of latent heat and specific volume difference.

Düşey bileşen w yatay bileşenlerin yanın: The vertical component w is very small compared to the horizontal components (order of cm/s), but it determines cloud and precipitation formation. Its counterpart in pressure coordinates is the quantity ω (omega).
Düşey bileşeni ayıklamak için k̂ ile ska: A scalar product with k̂ will be taken to extract the vertical component. What GUARANTEES that two terms will vanish and one will survive are these three relations: unit vectors are mutually orthogonal (product is zero) and have unit magnitude (product is one). Without writing these relations, saying "the other two terms vanish" would be an assertion, not a justification.
Düşey bileşeni ayıklayıp ζ'yı tanımlamak: Extracting the vertical component and defining ζ; examining shear and curvature contributions.
Düşey bileşeni vortisite ζ; küçük pervan: Vertical component is vorticity ζ; the rotation of a small paddle wheel.
Düşey birim vektörle vektörel çarpım işl: Cross product operation with the vertical unit vector: rotates a horizontal vector 90° counterclockwise around the vertical axis without altering its magnitude. By directing the gradient parallel to the isobars, it yields the direction of the geostrophic wind.
Düşey boyutlu tek bir değişken `PLOT` ed: When a single variable with a vertical dimension is `PLOT`ted, Ferret places Z on the VERTICAL axis (profile convention). This behavior originates from ocean depth profiles and also yields the correct result in the atmosphere.
Düşey denklem: yalnız w'yu silindirikleş: Vertical equation: convert only w to cylindrical
Düşey difüzyonda K büyükse açık şema Δt: In vertical diffusion, if K is large, the explicit scheme requires Δt ≤ Δz²/(2K): Δz = 20 m, K = 50 m²/s → Δt ≤ 4 s.
Düşey eksen Pa birimindeyse `1000/pres`: If the vertical axis is in units of Pa, `1000/pres` becomes meaningless; the formula must be changed to `100000/pres` or the axis converted to hPa.
Düşey eksen dönüşümde hiç değişmedi: z h: The vertical axis did not change at all during the transformation: z is the same axis in both Cartesian and cylindrical systems. Therefore, the STRUCTURE of the equation remains unchanged; only the horizontal velocities in it are substituted from (3.72). The cylindrical set of motion consists of THREE equations, not two — writing the two horizontal ones and forgetting the vertical one is a common oversight.
Düşey eksen logaritmik basınç, yatay eks: The vertical axis is logarithmic pressure, and the horizontal axis has skewed temperature lines. Thanks to this skewness, dry adiabats, pseudoadiabats, and mixing ratio lines lie at clearly distinguishable angles from one another.
Düşey ekseni yükseklik yerine basınç yap: When the vertical axis is switched from height to pressure, horizontal derivatives gain a "correction term"; radiosondes already measure on pressure surfaces.
Düşey gelişimli Cu ve Cb tek başına bir: Vertically developed Cu and Cb are considered a category of their own because their base is low while their top reaches the tropopause. The anvil of a Cb forms when the updraft impinges on a stable layer and spreads horizontally, providing the first visual evidence that the storm has matured.
Vertical equation of motion: dw/dt = B.
Düşey hareket denkleminde ivme terimi, b: In the vertical equation of motion, the acceleration term is extremely small compared to the pressure gradient and gravity terms: while w ~ cm/s on the synoptic scale, dw/dt ~ 10⁻⁷ m/s², whereas g ~ 10 m/s². The two large terms cancel each other to within one part in a thousand; the remaining small difference drives vertical motion. Balance does not mean the absence of motion, but that motion is determined by this difference.
Düşey hareketi tek bir vektör alanının ı: Diagnostic tool free from ambiguity, giving vertical motion through the divergence of a single vector field.
Düşey hareketi, vortisite adveksiyonunun: Diagnostic equation calculating vertical motion from the vertical differential of vorticity advection and the Laplacian of temperature advection.
Düşey hareketin iki sinoptik kaynağını v: Yields the two synoptic sources of vertical motion: vertical differential of vorticity advection and temperature advection.
Düşey hız 1 cm/s mertebesindedir ve rady: Vertical velocity is of the order of 1 cm/s, and radiosondes measure with m/s precision — meaning it cannot be measured directly. Horizontal wind, however, is measured.
Düşey hız yataya göre bin kat küçük; o y: Vertical velocity is a thousand times smaller than horizontal; that is why the other two components are not useful on a synoptic chart.
Düşey hız yatayın binde biri: w'li terim: Vertical velocity is one-thousandth of the horizontal: terms with w are neglected for this reason.
Düşey hız ölçülemez (cm/s); süreklilik d: Vertical velocity cannot be measured directly (cm/s); it is deduced from the horizontal wind by integrating the continuity equation with respect to pressure.
Düşey hız, alttaki katmanın ortalama yat: Vertical velocity is the accumulation of the average horizontal divergence of the layer below along pressure; the kinematic method diagnoses the unmeasurable from what is measured.
Düşey hızı doğrudan ölçmek zordur; bu de: It is difficult to measure vertical velocity directly; through this equation, it is calculated from the horizontal wind field.
Düşey hızın hareketi izleyen türevi; düş: Material derivative of vertical velocity; measures the departure from hydrostatic balance in the vertical momentum equation. It is eight orders of magnitude smaller than gravity on the synoptic scale, while on the convective scale it is observed as buoyancy.
Düşey ivme, basınç gradyanının ve yerçek: Vertical acceleration is one ten-thousandth compared to the pressure gradient and gravity; the two balance each other.
Düşey ivme, g ve basınç gradyanı yanında: Vertical acceleration is negligible compared to g and the pressure gradient (|dw/dt| ≪ g).
Düşey ivmenin ihmal edilip düşey denklem: Neglect of vertical acceleration, reduction of the vertical equation to pressure-weight balance, and the simplifications this brings.
Düşey kesme iki bilgiyi birden taşır: hı: Vertical shear carries two pieces of information at once: speed difference and direction difference. Since velocity is always tangential (Step 1), the component of velocity along the path of integration on these edges is zero — t̂·n̂ = 0. Eğri izobarlarda merkezcil ivme dengeye: In curved isobars, centripetal acceleration enters the balance; the speed is obtained from a square root, and the signs determine which root is physical.

Typical meteorological use: extracting the hull of a specific cloud water content value or a 40 dBZ reflectivity surface.

Ferret komut hataları Python istisnası f: Ferret command errors do not raise Python exceptions — if you do not check the return value of `pyferret.run`, the script finishes "successfully" but nothing has been computed.
Ferret tarayıcıda koşmaz; sağdaki çizim: Ferret does not run in the browser; the plot on the right is the equivalent of the same field in YolHava's mini engine — same data, same 60 m ladder, different plotter. The equivalent of Ferret's `SET REGION` command in the mini engine is `set lev` + the map's own viewport.
Ferret, NOAA/PMEL’de okyanus-atmosfer ve: Ferret was developed at NOAA/PMEL for ocean-atmosphere data, and its defining feature is "axis algebra": when specifying a variable, you state in square brackets what to do on which axis — such as `t[l=1:120@ave]`. Average, integral, maximum, regridding are all expressed in this transformation (`@`) language; you can perform chained calculations without generating intermediate files. PyFerret calls the same engine from Python and returns the array as numpy.
Ferret, iki boyutlu kalan ifadeyi otomat: Ferret automatically places the remaining two-dimensional expression onto the correct axes: X horizontal, T vertical. Moreover, there is no need to specify "plot this as Hovmöller"; the plot emerges from which axes have survived.
Ferret’in dönüşüm dilini öğrenmek: bir e: Learning Ferret's transformation language: averaging an axis with a single bracket expression and generating anomalies.
Ferret’in eksen cebrini korurken sonucu: Retaining Ferret's axis algebra while extracting the result into Python as a numpy array — combining the best of both worlds.
Ferret’in temel iş akışını kurmak: dosya: Establishing Ferret's basic workflow: load the file, select the region, plot the derived variable, overlay contours.
Ferret’te \"bölge\" (region) kavramı mer: In Ferret, the concept of "region" is central: you define it once, and all subsequent expressions are evaluated within it. This avoids having to write slices repeatedly.
Ferret’te `@` ile başlayan dönüşümler bi: In Ferret, transformations starting with `@` "consume" an axis: `@AVE` averages, `@SUM` sums, `@MAX` takes the maximum, `@DIN` integrates over depth/height, `@DDC` computes the centered derivative.
Ferret’te `LET` tanımı tembeldir: `theta: In Ferret, the `LET` definition is lazy: `theta` is not an array, but a rule. The `/Z=850` qualifier is applied to the rule at plot time and only that level is computed — very memory efficient.
Ferret’te `[z=a:b]` bir dilim değil, bir: In Ferret, `[z=a:b]` is not a slice, but an axis subset expression and can be embedded within a `LET` rule; this allows reusing the same rule with different intervals.
Ferret’te eksen sırası X,Y,Z,T sabittir: In Ferret, the axis order X,Y,Z,T is fixed, but the order in the file may differ; Ferret matches by axis NAME, and non-standard names may require `DEFINE AXIS`.
Ferret’te çizim türünü komut değil, haya: In Ferret, the surviving axes determine the plot type, not the command — this is the language's most consistent design decision, and once learned, it speeds you up considerably.

Fikir doğdu; dengesiz başlangıcın yıkıcı: The idea was born; the destructiveness of an unbalanced initialization was recognized
Fikir moleküler ortalama serbest yol ben: The idea is an analogy to the molecular mean free path: an eddy travels a distance ℓ, then mixes with its environment. With this assumption, K ≈ ℓ²·|∂U/∂z| or K ≈ ℓ·√e can be written; thus the closure problem is reduced to choosing a single length scale.
Fizik aynıdır; sistem seçimi hangi terim: The physics is the same; the choice of system determines which terms appear simple. In exams, the answer to "why isobaric?" is density; the answer to "why natural?" is curvature.
Fizik modelinin ürettiği arşiv, öğretmen: The archive produced by the physics model became the teacher
Fizik olarak: rüzgâr hızı 850’den 300’e: Physically: wind speed systematically increases from 850 to 300 (thermal wind). You can see this increase at a single glance in the panel — reading the vertical structure without having to make a vertical cross-section.
Fizik yasaları eylemsiz çerçevede yazıld: Since physical laws are formulated in an inertial frame, conservation expressions are built on η. In barotropic, non-divergent flow, η is conserved along a parcel: Dη/Dt = 0.
Fizik yasaları sistem için yazılır (kütl: Physical laws are written for a system (fixed mass), whereas engineering works with a control volume (fixed in space). The theorem bridges the two: rate of change in the system = accumulation inside the control volume + net outflow through the surfaces.
Fiziksel bir bağıntı, birim seçiminden b: A physical relationship must be independent of the choice of units. This requirement implies that variables can only combine into dimensionless groups. The theorem counts how many such groups exist: subtract the number of independent fundamental dimensions from the number of variables.
Fiziksel okuması momentum akısıdır: τ =: Its physical interpretation is momentum flux: via the relationship τ = ρ·(momentum flux), its unit can be written as both Pa and kg·m⁻¹·s⁻². The wind transferring momentum to the surface and the surface exerting a frictional force on the wind are two sides of the same coin.
Fiziksel okuması çok basittir: bir zaman: Its physical interpretation is very simple: in one time step, the air parcel travels **more than one cell**
Fiziksel okuması şudur: paket yükselirke: Its physical interpretation is this: as the parcel ascends, it expands because ambient pressure drops; the work of expansion is drawn from its internal energy, so it cools. There is no heat loss, energy has merely changed form. Therefore, if the parcel descends back, it returns to the same temperature — the process is reversible.
Fiziksel olarak hızlı derinleşme, üst se: Physically, rapid deepening occurs when upper-level divergence (mostly the left exit region of the jet and positive vorticity advection) evacuates the column. Latent heat release over the sea and a strong baroclinic zone (cold air over a warm ocean current) fuel this process; that is why bombs predominantly develop over the oceans during winter months.
Fiziksel taşınma mesafesi u·Δt, hücre ge: The physical transport distance u·Δt must not exceed the cell width Δx.
Fiziksel yorum sezgiseldir: şema bir nok: The physical interpretation is intuitive: if the scheme computes the new value at a point solely from its neighbors, the domain of dependence of the true solution must also remain within this neighborhood. Otherwise, the scheme never sees the information determining the solution and becomes unstable.
Fiziksel zincir şöyle işler: üst seviyed: The physical chain works as follows: the air column beneath an upper-level divergent region loses mass, surface pressure drops, the falling pressure induces convergence, convergence increases relative vorticity via vertical stretching, and rotation intensifies. This self-sustaining cycle is halted only by friction and occlusion.
Fonksiyon tanımı. `local` değişkeni fonk: Function definition. `local` confines the variable to the function; otherwise you pollute the rest of the script.
Fonksiyonun iki uç davranışı vardır. Uzu: The function exhibits two limiting behaviors. At long wavelengths (microwave), the exponential term is expanded in a series and radiance becomes linear with temperature (Rayleigh–Jeans); this is why the relationship between radiance and temperature is straightforward in passive microwave satellites. At short wavelengths, the exponential term dominates and radiance is highly sensitive to temperature.
Formül yaklaşıktır; tam biçim T_LCL yi a: The formula is approximate; the exact form requires T_LCL via a separate relation and introduces a correction on the order of 0.5%.
Formül üç şeyi tartar. f dönmeyi (dönme: The formula weighs three things. f represents rotation (without rotation this instability does not occur), |∂V/∂z| represents vertical shear (which, via thermal wind, is horizontal temperature gradient itself), and N represents static stability (stable air suppresses vertical motion). The 0.31 coefficient arises from the eigenvalue problem of the theory.
Formülde mutlaka Pa; hPa ile çalışırsan: Must be Pa in the formula; if working with hPa, multiply by 100.
Formüle geçmeden önce hangi harfin ne ol: Before moving to the formula, we specify what each letter represents.
Formülü \"A yerine hız\" ve \"A yerine m: Apply the formula twice by substituting "velocity for A" and "absolute velocity for A": the first gives the velocity transformation, the second gives the acceleration transformation. In exams, this chain is most often requested.
Formülü sayılarla deniyoruz: hiç büzülme: Testing the formula with numbers: if it does not contract at all, it should yield zero — and it does.
Formülün doğru okunduğunu kanıtlamanın e: The fastest way to verify that the formula is read correctly is two limiting cases. (1) Straight but sheared flow: Rs → ∞, curvature term is zero; only −∂V/∂n remains — the case at the flank of the jet axis. (2) Solid-body rotation, shear-free flow: ∂V/∂n = 0, only V/Rs remains. In the real atmosphere both coexist and often have opposite signs.
Formülün girdisi Kelvin ve hPa'dır. Biri: The inputs to the formula are Kelvin and hPa. Mixing up units is a silent error: if you input Celsius, the result "runs" but is physically meaningless.
Formülün paydasındaki Lv²ws/(RdT²) terim: The Lv²ws/(RdT²) term in the denominator of the formula comes from the Clausius–Clapeyron slope: it measures how rapidly the saturation mixing ratio decreases as temperature falls, i.e., how much water condenses per unit cooling.
Fortran dizileri sütun-öncelikli (column: Fortran arrays are column-major: the innermost loop must be over the FIRST index (i). If written in reverse, you will slow down 3–5 times due to cache misses.
Fortran dizileri sütun-öncelikli, NetCDF: Fortran arrays are column-major, whereas NetCDF is defined as row-major (C order). Therefore, a variable appearing as `t(time, level, latitude, longitude)` in CDL is read as `t(lon, lat, lev, time)` in Fortran — the index order is REVERSED.
Fortran programı 41 milyon nokta için sq: The Fortran program distributes the sqrt(u²+v²) calculation across cores for 41 million points and measures the elapsed time. There is no OpenMP in the browser;
Fortran programı `where (ws >= 30.0) jet: The Fortran program constructs a mask with `where (ws >= 30.0) jet = ws`; because Fortran cannot be compiled in the browser, the same concept
Fortran programı kendi ürettiği kare lek: The Fortran program applies a five-point Laplacian stencil to a square patch it generates. The plot on the right shows the same operator
Fortran tarayıcıda derlenmez. Soldaki pr: Fortran cannot be compiled in the browser. The program on the left computes the advection term in 1 dimension on a ridge it generated;
Fortran'ın diğer dillerden ayrıldığı ası: This is where Fortran truly distinguishes itself from other languages: arrays are a "first-class" type. The expression ws = sqrt(u*u + v*v) is written the same way even for a field of one million points.
Fotovoltaik ve konsantre güneş sistemler: Photovoltaic and concentrated solar power systems are sensitive to this distinction: concentrating systems can only use the direct component, whereas flat panels utilize the entire global radiation. This distinction is also made in en-route insolation forecasts.
Fotoğraf değişmiyorsa film de aynı yolu: If the photograph does not change, the film follows the same path.
Fr < 1 ise akışın engeli aşacak enerjisi: If Fr < 1, the flow lacks the energy to overcome the obstacle: air pools in front of the mountain, flows around the sides, producing blocking and channeled winds. If Fr > 1, the flow passes over the top, leading to mountain waves, rotors, and katabatic acceleration downstream.
Fr = 0,50 ile akış engellenir: hava dağı: With Fr = 0.50, flow is blocked: air cannot cross the mountain, pools upstream of the ridge, and deflects around the sides. At 25 m/s, Fr = 1.25; air crests the ridge, initiating mountain waves and foehn.
Fr ≈ 1 civarı en ilginç bölgedir; hidrol: Around Fr ≈ 1 is the most interesting regime; transitions resembling hydraulic jumps, strong downslope winds (bora, foehn-type accelerations) are generated here. The same mountain behaves entirely differently depending on the season with differing N.
Frekans diliyle yazılırsa f_d = Δφ/(2πΔt: In terms of frequency, f_d = Δφ/(2πΔt) → f_d = −2v_r/λ.
Frekans kayması biçimi: f_d = −2 v_r / λ: Frequency shift form: f_d = −2 v_r / λ
Frekans tabanlı tepe (Bν) farklı bir sab: The frequency-based peak (Bν) is determined by a different constant; the two do not denote the same physical point.
Frekans tabanında hesaplarsanız: tepe 0,: If calculated on a frequency basis: the peak shifts to 0.88 μm — same spectrum, different definition.
Frekans yerine PERİYOT ekseni: meteorolo: PERIOD axis instead of frequency: in meteorology, saying "24-hour peak" is much more readable than "1.157×10⁻⁵ Hz".
Frontogenez cephenin varlığıyla karıştır: Frontogenesis is often confused with the presence of a front; F is a RATE OF CHANGE, a strong front can persist even with zero F.
Frontogenez için deformasyonun tek başın: For frontogenesis, the presence of deformation alone is not sufficient: the angle between the isotherms and the axis of dilatation must be less than 45°. If the angle is greater than 45°, deformation pushes isotherms APART (frontolysis). Most exam questions focus on this angle condition.
Frontogenez mekanik olarak termal rüzgâr: Frontogenesis mechanically disrupts thermal wind balance; to restore balance, the atmosphere induces a narrow vertical circulation (ascent on the warm side, subsidence on the cold side). This is why the frontal precipitation band is located on the warm edge of the front and remains narrow.
Frontogenez yalnız yüzey haritasında ara: Frontogenesis is often thought to be sought only on surface charts; the strongest signal is usually in the 850–700 hPa layer.
Frontogenez, denge bozulduğu için enine: Because balance is disrupted, frontogenesis generates a transverse circulation cell: ascent on the warm side, subsidence on the cold side.
Frontogenez, kendi ageostrofik sirkülasy: Frontogenesis induces its own ageostrophic circulation: a narrow, upright cell with ascent on the warm side and subsidence on the cold side. This circulation is why the precipitation band along the front is so narrow and intense; the Sawyer–Eliassen framework quantifies this.
Fumigation: the most dangerous. Plume that fanned overnight suddenly mixes downward in the morning as the mixed layer grows and reaches the plume level. Ground-level concentrations can increase tenfold within a few minutes. Lofting is the opposite: the source is above the stable layer, smoke spreads upward, and the ground level remains clean.
Fumigation'ı akşam saatlerine yerleştirm: Placing fumigation in the evening hours is a common mistake; the phenomenon occurs in the morning as the layer grows.
Föhn yalnız sıcaklık artışı değildir; ku: Föhn is not just a temperature rise; drying and wind gusts are also characteristic.
Föhn ısınmasının tamamını gizli ısıya ba: Attributing all of föhn warming to latent heat; air descending from a stable layer can warm even without precipitation.
Fırlatma yönünü döndür: sapma hep hıza d: Rotate the launch direction: deflection is always perpendicular to velocity and to the right (NH).
Fırtına hücrelerinin altındaki çöküntü (: Downburst gusts beneath storm cells may be underrepresented in the model.
Fırtına içinde 30 m/s yükseliş 5 dakikad: If an ascent of 30 m/s is gained in 5 minutes within a storm, the acceleration is 0.1 m/s²; this is of an order that violates the hydrostatic assumption.
Fırtına organizasyonu doğrudan kesmeye b: Storm organization depends directly on shear. With 0–6 km shear, single-cell storms are expected below 10 m/s, multicell storms between 15–20 m/s, and a supercell environment above 20 m/s. Low-level shear (0–1 km), on the other hand, determines whether rotation will reach the ground.
Fırtınadan yere çarparak yatayda yayılan: A severe downdraft that strikes the ground from a storm and spreads horizontally, hazardous to aviation.
Fırtınaların çekirdeğindeki ekstra kaldı: The extra buoyancy in storm cores comes from this latent heat released during saturated ascent; this is also why the saturated adiabatic lapse rate is smaller than the dry rate.
The amount of energy in the storm's reservoir.
Fırtınanın kuramsal en yüksek yukarı hız: The theoretical maximum updraft speed of the storm.
Fırtınanın merkezinden ne kadar uzaktası: How far you are from the center of the storm.
Velocity commensurate with the storm's fuel.
Fırtınanın yakıtı: pozitif kaldırma alan: The storm's fuel: positive buoyancy area.
Fθ = −10⁻⁴ m/s² ile 6 saatte teğetsel hı: With Fθ = −10⁻⁴ m/s², tangential velocity decreases by about 2.2 m/s in 6 hours.
Fθ = −10⁻⁴ m/s² ve R = 500 km: moment −5: Fθ = −10⁻⁴ m/s² and R = 500 km: torque −50 m²/s², reduces M by 1.8·10⁵ m²/s per hour.
Fᵈ = ½·ρ·Cᵈ·A·V² bağıntısı hızın karesiy: The relation Fᵈ = ½·ρ·Cᵈ·A·V² shows the increase with the square of velocity: if velocity doubles, drag quadruples. The same relation is used in wind load calculations, raindrop terminal velocity, and aerosol transport.
G = Rn nin %10 u, Bowen oranı B = 0,5: G = 10% of Rn, Bowen ratio B = 0.5
G terimi gün ortalamasında küçüktür (Rn: The G term is small on a daily average (5–15% of Rn) but important in the diurnal cycle: heat stored during the day is released back at night, slowing the excessive cooling of the surface. Over water surfaces, G is very large because energy mixes into depth; therefore, the diurnal variation of sea surface temperature does not exceed 0.5 K.
G, bitki örtüsü sık olduğunda R_n'in %5': G drops to 5% of R_n when vegetation is dense; applying a ratio calibrated for bare soil to a forest is incorrect.
G, gündüz yüzeyden aşağı (pozitif), gece: G is directed downward from the surface during the day (positive) and upward from below at night. Soil acts as an energy reservoir: it gives back at night what it receives during the day, thereby dampening the diurnal temperature range.
GDAL GRIB2’yi de raster olarak okur: ban: GDAL also reads GRIB2 as a raster: number of bands, dimensions, projection, and the description of each band are printed.
GDAL ile GeoTIFF ve PNG üretilir; sayısa: GeoTIFF and PNG are generated with GDAL; a single-point value is printed for numerical verification.
GEO 35 786 km, tekrar 5–15 dk, piksel 1–: GEO 35,786 km, repeat 5–15 min, pixel 1–3 km · LEO 700–850 km, 2 passes/day, pixel 0.25–1 km
GEO görüntüsündeki yüksek enlem bulutlar: Reading the size of high-latitude clouds directly from a GEO image; the oblique view causes severe distortion.
GEO uydunun bir tam turu 23 saat 56 daki: One full orbit of a GEO satellite takes 23 hours 56 minutes; therefore, it appears stationary relative to the Earth's surface.
GFS 0.25° GRIB2; `g2ctl` + `gribmap` ile: GFS 0.25° GRIB2; a descriptor file (`gfs_20240115.ctl`) generated with `g2ctl` + `gribmap`. Variable name `hgtprs` (geopotential height at pressure levels, m).
GFS 0.25°, 1000–150 hPa arası tüm basınç: GFS 0.25°, all pressure levels between 1000–150 hPa: `tmpprs`, `ugrdprs`, `vgrdprs`.
GFS boylamı 0–360 olarak yayınlar. rotat: GFS publishes longitude as 0–360. rotate() shifts the axis to −180..180; if not done, the Turkey bounding box returns empty.
GFS boylamı 0–360'tır; -small_grib 25:45: GFS longitude is 0–360; -small_grib 25:45 works, but -small_grib -10:5 returns empty. For western longitudes, write in the format 350:365.
GFS dosyaları çevrim saatinden 3–5 saat: GFS files are completed 3–5 hours after the cycle run time. Requesting a step that has not been published yet returns 403/404; this is why it is important for the script to exit early with curl -f.
GFS'in 0–360 boylam kuralı en sık tökezl: GFS's 0–360 longitude rule is the most common stumbling block: western Europe is in the 350–360 range, writing −10 yields no results.
GRIB dosyaları tek bir NetCDF serisine ç: GRIB files are converted into a single NetCDF series.
GRIB'i hemen NetCDF'e çevirmek yaygın bi: Converting GRIB immediately to NetCDF is a common habit but not always correct: file size increases and some of GRIB's level/step metadata may be lost. It is better to finish filtering and cropping in GRIB and then convert.
GRIB2 bağımsız mesajların art arda dizil: GRIB2 is a format where independent messages are concatenated sequentially: each message carries its own header and compressed field. Therefore, cutting and pasting a file from the middle yields a valid GRIB.
GRIB2 dosyası bağımsız mesajların art ar: A GRIB2 file consists of independent messages concatenated sequentially. This structure makes cutting a chunk from the middle of the file into a separate file VALID — this is the entire basis of partial downloading.
GRIB2 dosyasının envanterini çıkarmak: Extracting the inventory of a GRIB2 file
GRIB2 tek bir dosyada farklı seviye tipl: GRIB2 can contain different level types, different step types, and different time types in a single file. Because cfgrib cannot fit these into a single cube, providing a filter is mandatory.
GRIB2'nin sıkıştırması **kayıplıdır** ve: GRIB2's compression is **lossy**, and this is an intentional design. Packing scales values
GRIB’den tek değişkeni ayıklamak: Extracting a single variable from GRIB
GRIB’in içinde ne var öğrenmek: Finding out what is inside GRIB
Gauss tepesinin genişliği dx'in 2–3 katı: If the width of the Gaussian peak is smaller than 2–3 times dx, the grid cannot resolve it; attribute the result to resolution, not the scheme.
Gaz katmanları için doğrudan uygulanmaz;: Not directly applicable to gas layers; they are selective emitters (see Planck, Beer–Lambert).
Gazlar yalnız kendi enerji seviyelerine: Gases only absorb photons matching their own energy levels; therefore, the absorption spectrum consists of discrete bands. Water vapor has strong bands at 6.3 μm and 2.7 μm, carbon dioxide at 15 μm and 4.3 μm, and ozone at 9.6 μm and in the ultraviolet.
Gece 150 m'de fanning yapan duman, sabah: Smoke fanning at 150 m at night produces a short-lived peak at ground level in the morning when the mixed layer exceeds 150 m.
Gece G işaret değiştirir (topraktan yüze: At night, G reverses sign (from soil toward the surface); continuing with the same sign disrupts the balance.
Gece K düşerse (0,1 m²/s): Ek 10⁻³'e ine: If K drops at night (0.1 m²/s): Ek decreases to 10⁻³, the layer thins, and its upper part decouples from friction.
Gece akı negatiftir ve L pozitif olur: k: At night, the flux is negative and L becomes positive: stable conditions. In neutral conditions, |L| becomes very large.
Gece açık, rüzgâr 2 m/s, T−Td akşam 3 K: If the night is clear, wind is 2 m/s, and T−Td is 3 K in the evening, the temperature drops to the dew point toward morning, producing radiation fog.
Gece boyunca 8 saatte 6 K ışınımsal soğu: Radiative cooling of 6 K over 8 hours overnight: J/c_p = −6/28800 = −2.1·10⁻⁴ K/s, meaning J = −0.21 W/kg.
Gece bulut örtüsü sera etkisini artırır;: Cloud cover at night enhances the greenhouse effect; cooling is 5–8 K less compared to a clear night.
Gece bulutluysa aşağı akı yüksek olur ve: If it is cloudy at night, the downward flux is high and the surface cools very little; on a clear and dry night, the downward flux decreases, net loss increases, and the risk of radiative inversion and frost arises.
Gece haritasında vadi tabanları çevresin: On the night map, valley floors appear colder than their surroundings → inversion.
Gece kararlı tabaka 60 m ise yüzey tabak: If the nocturnal stable layer is 60 m, the surface layer is only ~6 m; a 10 m measurement may no longer satisfy the "constant flux" assumption.
Gece kararlı tabakada K çöker: gerilme y: In the nocturnal stable layer, K collapses: stress is trapped at the surface, and the air above decouples from friction and accelerates (low-level jet).
Gece mekanizması şudur: gün batımından s: The nocturnal mechanism is as follows: after sunset, the surface cools, a stable layer forms, and the air above decouples from friction. As soon as friction is removed, the flow accelerates toward geostrophic balance, but due to inertia it overshoots the balance and exceeds the geostrophic wind speed (inertial oscillation). Peak values are observed between midnight and the early morning hours.
Gece rüzgârın her zaman zayıfladığı sanı: It is commonly thought that wind always weakens at night; while it weakens at the surface, it can double 500 m above.
Gece rüzgârının \"dinmesi\" yalnızca yüz: The "calming" of nocturnal wind applies only to the surface; 200 m above, the wind frequently increases.
Gece sıcaklık düştükçe es küçülür ve RH: As temperature drops at night, es decreases and RH rises; if it reaches 100% toward morning, fog or dew forms.
Gece yalnız IR yayılır: E = ε σ T⁴ = 0,9: Only IR is emitted at night: E = ε σ T⁴ = 0.99 × 5.67×10⁻⁸ × (263)⁴ ≈ 268 W/m².
Gece yüzey enversiyonu 100–400 m kalınlı: Nocturnal surface inversion: 100–400 m thickness, 2–10 K strengthening
Gece yüzeyin radyasyonla soğuması sonucu: A shallow and stable bottom layer with suppressed turbulence, formed as a result of radiative cooling of the surface at night.
Gece yüzeyin ışınımla hızla soğuması son: A stable layer where temperature increases with height near the ground, resulting from rapid radiative cooling of the surface at night.
Gece: L pozitif, karışım bastırılır: Night: L is positive, mixing is suppressed
Gecikme süresi ile toplanma zamanı eş an: Lag time and time of concentration are not synonymous; roughly, the relation tₗ ≈ 0.6·tᶜ is used.
Gelişen bir orta enlem alçağında 500 hPa: Reaches 2·10⁻⁴ s⁻¹ at 500 hPa in a developing mid-latitude low; on the order of twice f.
Gelişmenin üç şartı birlikte aranır: yüz: The three conditions for cyclogenesis are sought together: a baroclinic zone at the surface (energy source), an upper-level shortwave trough carrying positive vorticity advection (divergence generator), and low-level warm advection (mechanism sustaining ascent). If one of these is missing, development does not start or remains short-lived.
Genel biçimi ∂ρ/∂t + ∇·(ρV) = 0'dır. Sık: Its general form is ∂ρ/∂t + ∇·(ρV) = 0. Under the incompressible approximation, it reduces to ∇·V = 0: flow contracting in one direction must expand in another.
Genel kuralı yazıp, Dünya'nın dönme hızı: We write the general rule and eliminate two terms because the Earth's rotation rate is constant.
Genel özdeşlikte A yerine parselin konum: In the general identity, we substitute the parcel's position vector for A. The derivative of position is velocity: absolute velocity in the inertial frame, relative velocity (with respect to the Earth) in the rotating frame.
Genellikle 850–700 hPa arasında bulunan,: A warm layer typically found between 850–700 hPa that temporarily suppresses convection.
Genellikle gece, 300–1500 m arasında olu: A narrow and fast wind maximum typically forming at night between 300–1500 m.
Genellikle günde dört kez yayımlanır ve: It is usually issued four times a day and covers a 24- or 30-hour period. Its coverage is roughly an 8 km radius from the aerodrome reference point; therefore, it is not a regional forecast, but a runway-focused product.
Genellikle ilerleyen bir yay yankısı ail: It typically develops in the form of a progressive bow echo family. For sustenance, it requires high CAPE along the path of the line, mid-level dry air (for evaporative cooling), and deep shear of 15–25 m/s. During the warm season, it frequently occurs along the fast westerly flow on the northern periphery of a ridge ("ring of fire").
Geniş bant (0,3–3 μm) ölçüm; spektral ay: Broadband (0.3–3 μm) measurement; spectral detail is averaged.
Geniş bir sıcaklık merdiveni: yerde +20: A broad temperature gradient: +20 °C at the ground, dropping down to −60 °C at the tropopause.
Geniş ve düzgün alan = cephe (stratiform: Broad and uniform area = frontal (stratiform) precipitation; small and dotted = convective cell.
Genişletilmiş düzenli ifade: tek geçişte: Extended regular expression: extracts three variables simultaneously in a single pass.
Genişleyen parsel iş yapar, iç enerjisi: The expanding parcel does work, its internal energy decreases; with hydrostatic dp = −ρg dz, α ρ = 1 simplifies. A constant number: 9.81/1004.
Genişleyen parsel seyrelir; büzülen yoğu: An expanding parcel rarefies; a contracting parcel densifies.
Genişlik 100–300 km · içindeki |∇T| 5–15: Width 100–300 km · internal |∇T| 5–15 K/100 km · wind increase aloft 30–60 m/s
Genişliği üç şeye bağlıdır: örneklem büy: Its width depends on three things: sample size, variability of the data, and the chosen confidence level. If the sample size quadruples, the interval is halved — this square-root relationship explains why the returns from collecting more data diminish rapidly.
Genoa siklonu: R = 500 km, ∂p/∂n = −4 hP: Genoa cyclone: R = 500 km, ∂p/∂n = −4 hPa/100 km, ρ = 1.2, f = 10⁻⁴ → V = −25 + √(625 + 1667) = 22.9 m/s (would be 33 m/s if geostrophic).
Genoa siklonunda R ≈ 500 km: 100 km yol: In a Genoa cyclone, R ≈ 500 km: 0.2 rad (11°) turning per 100 km of path.
GeoTIFF’e çevirme; `-b 1` tek bandı alır: Conversion to GeoTIFF; `-b 1` extracts a single band.
Geometri: küçük yayı açıya bağla: Geometry: link small arc to angle
Geometrik olarak karşılaşan iki damladan: The fraction of two geometrically colliding droplets that actually coalesce.
Geometrik yükseklikle farkı troposferde: Its difference from geometric height is less than 1% in the troposphere; therefore, it is considered the same in practice.

Its difference from geometric height is small in the troposphere: on the order of a few tens of meters at 10 km. In contrast, for the upper atmosphere and thick layers, the difference accumulates and cannot be neglected.
Geopotansiyel yükseklik ile geometrik yü: Geopotential height and geometric height are often thought to be equal; the difference is small, but by definition they are distinct.
Gerekli durgunluk 3–7 gün · yüzey ısı ak: Required stagnation 3–7 days · surface heat flux 50–600 W/m² · domain size > 1000 km
Gerekli düşey hız 0,5–3 m/s · yakınsama: Required vertical velocity 0.5–3 m/s · convergence on the order of 10⁻⁴ s⁻¹ · outflow boundary speed 10–20 m/s
Geri dönen güç antende: Pr = [Pt G/(4πr²: Returned power at the antenna: Pr = [Pt G/(4πr²)] · ηV · [G λ²/(4π)] · (1/4πr²).
Geri dönüş 600 μs sonra geldiyse mesafe: If the return arrives after 600 μs, distance = 3·10⁸·600·10⁻⁶/2 = 90 km.
Geri çağırıcı mekanizma β'dır: kuzeye sa: The restoring mechanism is β: as a parcel deflects northward, its f increases, its relative vorticity decreases to conserve absolute vorticity, and the flow curves back southward. The result is a persistent wave pattern on the midlatitude westerly flow.
Gerilme deformasyonu ∂u/∂x − ∂v/∂y, kaym: Stretching deformation is given by ∂u/∂x − ∂v/∂y, and shearing deformation by ∂v/∂x + ∂u/∂y. Their resultant defines a magnitude and an axis orientation: the axis of dilatation. A square air parcel deforms into a rhombus in this flow.
Gerilme deformasyonu, eksenleri koordina: Stretching deformation is the classic "four-lobed" flow whose axes coincide with the coordinate axes: stretching along east-west, contraction along north-south. Shearing deformation is the same thing rotated by 45°. Both are different perspectives of the same phenomenon; therefore, rather than individually, the vector magnitude D is meaningful.
Gerilme, K-kuramıyla τ = ρK·∂V/∂z biçimi: Stress is related to the mean shear via K-theory as τ = ρK·∂V/∂z.
Gerilme, kuvvet gibi vektörel değil tens: Stress is a tensorial quantity rather than a vector like force: the surface it acts on and the direction of action must be specified separately. τₓₓ is the normal component perpendicular to the surface (pressure-like), while τₓᵩ is the tangential (shear) component.
Geriye PGF ile Coriolis kalır ve büyüklü: What remains are PGF and Coriolis, and their magnitudes balance: (1/ρ)∂p/∂n = f·V.
Geriye mutlak vortisitenin materyal deği: What remains is the material rate of change of absolute vorticity: D(ζ+f)/Dt.
Geriye tek bilinmeyenli, χ = ∂Φ/∂t için: What remains is an elliptic equation with a single unknown for χ = ∂Φ/∂t.
Geriye yalnız PGF ile merkezcil ivme den: What remains is only the balance between PGF and centripetal acceleration: V²/R = (1/ρ)∂p/∂n.
Geriye yalnız ω'yı içeren bir eliptik de: What remains is an elliptic equation containing only ω.
Germe (ıraksama) terimi: yatay yakınsama: Stretching (divergence) term: horizontal convergence elongates the column, increasing absolute vorticity. It is the dominant term in synoptic development.
Germe terimi h'nin değişimine dönüşür; i: The stretching term transforms into the change in h; two logarithmic derivatives appear side by side.
Germe terimi sürekliliğe bağlanınca bir: When the stretching term is linked to continuity, a conservation law emerges: a column descending a mountain stretches and spins; air moving north gains f and loses ζ.
Stretching term: as the column stretches, η increases.
Germe, eğme/bükme ve solenoid terimlerin: Naming the stretching, tilting/twisting, and solenoidal terms.
Gerçek Dünya küresi + bulut kabuğu; taba: Real Earth globe + cloud shell; base is determined by LCL, top by instability.
Gerçek `_FillValue` denetimi yapılmıyor;: No real `_FillValue` check is performed; in masked fields such as moisture/precipitation, −32767 values distort the average. In production, mask with `nf90_get_att(..., '_FillValue', fv)`.
Gerçek adveksiyon denkleminde her dalga: In the true advection equation, every wavelength is advected at the same speed. In the discrete scheme, phase speed becomes dependent on wavelength: long waves propagate almost correctly, while short waves propagate systematically slower. A two-grid-interval wave (2Δx) does not propagate at all in the centered difference scheme — its phase speed is zero.
Gerçek atmosfer tam ıraksamasız değildir: The real atmosphere is not purely nondivergent. Therefore, wind is separated via Helmholtz decomposition into rotational (ψ) and divergent (χ, velocity potential) components. In midlatitudes, the rotational component dominates; in the tropics, the divergent component gains prominence.
Gerçek atmosferde K sabit değildir; bu y: In the real atmosphere, K is not constant; therefore, measured profiles deviate from the ideal spiral, showing smaller angles.
Gerçek aylık ortalamanın %95 olasılıkla: The true monthly mean is said to lie between 17,2 and 19,6 °C with 95% probability. It is not possible to reliably distinguish a 1 °C climate difference with this sample.
Gerçek buhar basıncının, düz su yüzeyi ü: Ratio of actual vapor pressure to saturation vapor pressure over a flat water surface. If equal to one, there is saturation; if greater than one, there is supersaturation; it is relative humidity without the percentage sign.
Gerçek cisimler siyah değildir; ölçülen: Real bodies are not blackbodies; measured radiance is εBλ(T). Therefore, if ε is unknown, Tb turns out lower than the true temperature. In sea surface temperature products, ε and atmospheric correction are applied together.
Gerçek dönüm 1950'de geldi. Jule Charney: The real turning point came in 1950. The team led by Jule Charney, the first numerical forecast on ENIAC
Gerçek gözlemde spread nedir?: What is spread in real observations?
Gerçek gözlemle model farkını gör: See the difference between actual observations and the model
Gerçek hızın ölçülebilir aralığı aşması: The wrapping of the value to the other end of the interval when the actual velocity exceeds the measurable range.
Gerçek karşılığı: 500 hPa haritasında 54: Real-world equivalent: the packing of contours between 5400 m and 5880 m on a 500 hPa chart is precisely this slope. GrADS bir programlama dili değil, bir ız: GrADS is not a programming language, but a gridded-data console. You describe the data with a descriptor file (.ctl), then set up the window (lat/lon/lev/t) and enter `d <expression>`. Its power lies here: the moment you write the expression, derivatives, curl, divergence, and time averages are calculated — without producing intermediate files. In this section, we construct the classic six synoptic analysis maps.

Katı cisim dönmesi bir sınır durumudur v: Solid-body rotation is a limiting case and is used as a benchmark: the vorticity of an actual flow is compared to the vorticity of a solid body rotating at the same angular velocity. The inner core of a tropical cyclone is close to this condition (V ∝ r), whereas its outer region, by contrast, is nearly irrotational with V ∝ 1/r.

Katı cisim dönmesinin tanımı: her nokta: Definition of solid-body rotation: every point rotates with the same angular velocity, hence tangential velocity is DIRECTLY proportional to radius. Air near the center moves slowly, distant air moves fast, but angular velocity is the same everywhere. There is no radial velocity; the ring neither contracts nor expands.
Katı cisim gibi dönen akışkanın açısal h: Angular velocity of fluid rotating as a solid body. In this regime, tangential velocity is directly proportional to radius, and vorticity equals 2ω regardless of position.
Katı dönmede vortisite açısal hızın iki: In solid-body rotation, vorticity is twice the angular velocity; the vertical component of Earth's vorticity is f, and absolute vorticity becomes ζ + f.

In the reverse case (warm air over a cold surface), the base becomes stable, vertical mixing ceases, and modification takes days.

Kenarları δx, δy, δz olan sonsuz küçük k: The mass contained in an infinitesimal control volume with sides δx, δy, δz. In the Lagrangian view, this mass is conserved as the parcel moves; the continuity equation is the differential expression of this conservation.

Kesme vektörel tanımlıdır: 10 m/s güneyb: Shear is defined vectorially: between 10 m/s southwest and 10 m/s northwest there is no speed difference, but shear is not zero. This distinction is decisive in severe weather forecasting.
Kesme vortisitesi: hızın akışa dik yönde: Shear vorticity: contribution arising from the cross-flow variation of velocity. It has a negative sign because the normal unit vector is taken perpendicular to the left of the flow.

Kirchhoff ilkesi gereği ε aynı zamanda s: By Kirchhoff's law, ε is also the absorptivity. Therefore, a low-emissivity surface both emits less and absorbs less, thus keeping its temperature more independent of its surroundings.
Kirchhoff ilkesine göre denge durumunda: According to Kirchhoff's law, at equilibrium, the absorptivity of a body at a given wavelength equals its emissivity. A good absorber is a good emitter: this is why water vapor both absorbs and emits at 6.2 μm, enabling the water vapor channel to work.
Kirchhoff yasasına göre iyi yayan iyi so: According to Kirchhoff's law, a good emitter is a good absorber: ε = a. Therefore, the absorption and emission behavior of a surface is defined by the same value.
Kirleticinin atmosferden çıkışı ise çöke: A pollutant exits the atmosphere via deposition and chemical transformation. Dispersion models therefore derive transport and dilution from meteorology, and the sink term from chemistry and surface properties.
Kirleticinin yağışsız yolla yüzeye tutun: Attachment of pollutant to the surface by non-precipitating means (dry) or scavenging by precipitation to the ground (wet).

Klasik araç buharlaşma tavasıdır: günlük: The classical instrument is the evaporation pan: the daily drop in water level is read. However, because the pan absorbs heat from its sides and bottom, it measures higher than actual lake evaporation; it is corrected with a pan coefficient (typically 0.7).
Klasik biçim dq = du + p dα (iç enerji a: The classical form dq = du + p dα (internal energy increase + work done) is not very useful in the atmosphere because an air parcel shares its pressure, not its volume, with its surroundings. When enthalpy h = u + pα is defined and substituted, the form written with pressure change is obtained, and all terms turn into measurable quantities (T, p).
Klasik kök formülünü uyguluyoruz; iki kö: We apply the standard quadratic formula; two roots emerge.
Klasik omega denkleminin iki terimi tek: The two terms of the classical omega equation are reduced to a single term, −2∇·Q. This eliminates the problem of term cancellation: Q-vector convergence implies ascent, divergence implies subsidence. Being readable at a single glance is the reason for its preference in synoptic practice.

Kontrol hacmi hareket ediyorsa yüzey akı: If the control volume is moving, relative velocity must be used in the surface flux; writing absolute velocity is a common mistake.
Kontrol hacmi ile sistem karıştırılır; s: Control volume is confused with a system; mass is constant in a system, while mass can change in a control volume.
Kontrol hacmiyle çalışmak, içeride ne ol: Working with a control volume allows deducing results by accounting for boundary fluxes without knowing what happens inside. Computing the force produced by a nozzle does not require solving the complex internal flow; inlet and outlet momentum fluxes suffice.
Kontrol kutusunun alt ve üst yüzü arasın: Pressure difference between the bottom and top faces of the control box; it replaces the vertical edge length in isobaric coordinates. Due to hydrostatic balance, a pressure layer corresponds directly to a mass layer.
Kontur aralığı — alışılmış seçimler ve s: Contour interval — customary choices and reasons
Kontur seviyeleri `set clevs` ile kodun: Contour levels were provided manually using `set clevs`, as in the code's np.arange(4800, 6060, 60) line.
Kontur seviyelerini otomatik bırakmak (c: Leaving contour levels automatic (contourf(...,20)) produces different intervals on each map; the field "flickers" in time-series animations. Always specify levels manually.
Kontur sıklığından okunan hız; kıvrım he: Speed read from contour packing; curvature not accounted for.
Kontur çizgisini bilgisayar nasıl bulur?: How does a computer find a contour line? The answer is the **marching squares** algorithm. The grid is divided into four-cornered cells; for each corner, the question "is the value above the threshold?" is asked. Four corners, four binary answers: 2⁴ = 16 possible cases. Each case uniquely determines which edges the contour line intersects the cell through — except for two cases.
Kontur çizgisinin köşeli değil yumuşak g: This is the only reason the contour line appears smooth rather than jagged: the intersection is not rounded to the corner, but interpolated along the edge.
Kontur çizgisinin sıklığı doğrudan grady: The packing of contour lines is directly the magnitude of the gradient. As the distance between two lines narrows, the gradient increases; you locate the jet stream on the map where the lines pack together. This is the greatest advantage of contour display over color fill: the gradient is not apparent in color fill, but emerges naturally from line density.
Konturların ekvatora doğru sarktığı, sik: An upper-level pattern where contours sag toward the equator, featuring cyclonic curvature and producing ascent ahead of it.
Konturların kutba doğru çıkıntı yaptığı,: An upper-level pattern where contours bulge poleward, featuring anticyclonic curvature and subsidence.
Konturların sıklığı yine rüzgâr hızıdır: Contour packing is again wind speed, and because there is no friction aloft, the geostrophic approximation works much better. At 500 hPa, wind blows almost parallel to the contours and can be estimated directly from the contour interval.
Konum vektörü; merkezkaç teriminin tek d: Position vector; it is the sole variable in the centrifugal term. Because it is independent of velocity, even a stationary parcel experiences centrifugal acceleration.
Konum vektörünün dönme eksenine dik bile: The component of the position vector perpendicular to the axis of rotation; this is the true lever arm of centrifugal acceleration. It decreases with the cosine of latitude and becomes zero at the pole.
Konum vektörünün ıraksaması, üç koordina: The divergence of the position vector is the sum of the derivatives of the three coordinates with respect to themselves, each yielding 1: result 3. In the second term, when the operator is applied to R, each component selects its counterpart, leaving Ω itself. Both are short derivations, but if skipped, the resulting "3 − 1" difference appears out of thin air.
Konum, hız, hatta rüzgâr vektörü: kural: Position, velocity, even the wind vector: the rule applies identically to all.
Konumlandırma formülü (plotting position: The plotting position formula places observations along the return period axis. Gringorten is less biased than Weibull for the Gumbel distribution and makes interpreting the plot easier.
Konumsal argüman yoksa varsayılan kullan: If no positional argument is provided, the default is used; the script can be called both manually and from cron.
Konumun değişimi hızdır; iki gözlemci ik: The change in position is velocity; two observers see two velocities.
Konumun türevi hızdır: The derivative of position is velocity
Konveksiyon üç bileşen ister: nem, karar: Convection requires three ingredients: moisture, instability, and lift. The first two prime the environment, the third initiates the event. If there is no trigger in a primed environment, the day passes cloud-free; this is the most common source of forecast errors.
Konveksiyon şeması, kararsız bir sütunu: The convection scheme stabilizes the grid average by triggering an unstable column and redistributing heat and moisture vertically.
Konveksiyon şemasının açık/kapalı olması: Whether the convection scheme is on/off
Konvektif açıdan enversiyon CIN üretir;: From a convective standpoint, an inversion produces CIN; it inhibits storm development until breached, and when breached, the accumulated energy is released explosively.
Konvektif bir merkezde χ tepesi büyürse:: If the χ peak grows in a convective center: strong upper-level divergence and an expansive cloud shield.
Konvektif bulutlar genelde tropopozda ya: Convective clouds typically spread at the tropopause to take an anvil shape; very severe cells briefly overshoot above it.
Konvektif bulutta taban, yükselen paketi: In a convective cloud, the base is the LCL level where the rising parcel reaches saturation and is well estimated by the surface temperature-dew point spread. Therefore, on humid days the base is low, and on dry days it is high.
Konvektif hücrede: ω onlarca Pa/s: In a convective cell: ω tens of Pa/s
Konvektif katsayıyla (300, 1,4): 50 dBZ: With convective coefficient (300, 1.4): 50 dBZ → R = (10⁵/300)^0.714 = 333^0.714 ≈ 55 mm/h
Konvektif ortamda 0–6 km derin kesme fır: In a convective environment, 0–6 km deep shear determines storm type: below 10 m/s single-cell, 10–20 m/s multicell, above 20 m/s supercell. 0–1 km shallow shear is an indicator of tornado potential. The same CAPE value produces completely different storms under different shear.
Konverjans (negatif ıraksama): hava topl: Convergence (negative divergence): air converges, forced to rise.
Konverjans ayrıca vortisiteyi güçlendiri: Convergence also intensifies vorticity: as a rotating air column contracts horizontally, it spins up due to conservation of angular momentum. This is the intensification mechanism of storm mesocyclones and tropical cyclone cores.
Konverjans bölgesinde ω < 0: hava yüksel: In the convergence zone, ω < 0: air rises.
Konverjans: oklar merkeze toplanıyor, ır: Convergence: arrows converge to the center, divergence is negative (blue).
Konverjansın nerede olduğu kadar hangi s: Where convergence occurs is just as important as at what level it occurs. If low-level convergence + upper-level divergence coexist, ascent can be sustained throughout the column; if the two do not have opposite signs at the respective levels, the motion decays quickly.
Konveyör kuşakları sabit boru gibi düşün: Conveyor belts are often thought of as stationary pipes; however, these are streamlines defined relative to the moving system, not relative to the ground reference frame.
Koordinat sistemi fiziği değiştirmez; ha: The coordinate system does not change the physics; it changes which term is visible and which measurement is directly usable.
Koordinatları geri takar. Bir sonraki sa: Reattaches coordinates. `_Wrap` in the next line is only meaningful after this.
Korelasyon nedensellik değildir; ayrıca: Correlation is not causation; furthermore, high r can conceal bias — a model that is systematically 5 K too warm can yield a perfect correlation.
Korunacak şeyi — kütleyi — parsel boyutl: Conservation cannot be applied without expressing the conserved quantity — mass — in terms of parcel dimensions. A control box with sides δx, δy, δz is selected; the mass inside is density times volume. Currently, the expression contains both ρ and δz; both are quantities we do not want in isobaric coordinates.
Korunan büyüklüklerde (D/Dt = 0) yerel d: For conserved quantities (D/Dt = 0), local change reduces entirely to advection: ∂θ/∂t = −V·∇θ. This is why isentropic analysis is so powerful in adiabatic flow.
Korunum yasaları daima materyal türevle: Conservation laws are always written with the material derivative because physics acts on the parcel: Dθ/Dt = 0 in adiabatic motion, DPV/Dt = 0 in frictionless flow. But we take measurements with fixed stations and fixed grid points; that is why we must convert the equation to the ∂/∂t form every time.
Korunumlu olduğu için θ, hava kütlelerin: Because it is conserved, θ is the right tool for tracking air masses: temperature drops with altitude, while θ remains constant throughout the same air mass.
Koruyucu (conservative) yöntem alan inte: The conservative method preserves the area integral. It is mandatory for quantities with meaningful budgets such as precipitation, radiative flux, and mass; especially when regridding to a coarser grid.

Koşullu kararsızlık tam da bu iki oran a: Conditional instability lives precisely in the range between these two rates: a layer where Γs < Γ < Γd is stable for an unsaturated parcel and unstable for a saturated parcel. Most thunderstorms worldwide are born in this "conditional" regime; the trigger is responsible for lifting the parcel above the LCL.
Koşulu, mutlak vortisitenin enleme göre: Its condition is that the meridional gradient of absolute vorticity changes sign (Rayleigh-Kuo criterion). In sharply sheared flows such as jets, this condition can be satisfied and the flow spontaneously meanders and breaks into eddies.

K² büyük olması dalganın \"keskin\" olma: A large K² means the wave is "sharp". Why long waves are quasi-stationary and short waves are rapidly propagating is contained within this single term.
Köhler denkleminin eğrilikten gelen ve d: The part of the Köhler equation originating from curvature that increases the saturation ratio. It is inversely proportional to radius; therefore, as the droplet grows, its contribution decreases rapidly and is negligible for large droplets.

Köhler eğrisi, bir çözelti damlasının de: The Köhler curve gives the supersaturation at which a solution droplet remains in equilibrium; once the critical supersaturation is exceeded, the droplet activates and turns into a cloud droplet.

Köhler eğrisinin tepesine karşılık gelen: The radius corresponding to the peak of the Köhler curve; a droplet exceeding this continues to grow spontaneously.

In the case where it is negative, THERE IS NO real velocity SOLUTION — the pressure gradient limit of the anticyclonic branch originates from here.

N² işaretiyle üç rejim ayrılır: N² > 0 k: Three regimes are distinguished by the sign of N²: N² > 0 stable (parcel oscillates, waves propagate), N² = 0 neutral, N² < 0 unstable (parcel escapes, convection initiates). Evaporation of falling precipitation cools the air and makes it heavier; this cold air hitting the ground spreads out to produce the cold pool and gust front. Olgun hatlarda radar görüntüsü yay biçim: In mature lines, the radar image assumes an arc shape (bow echo).
