Yükselen hava paketi genişler ve genişle: A rising air parcel expands and does work as it expands; because its energy is expended as work, its temperature drops. This is cooling even though no heat is released to the outside.
Yükselen hava paketinin kazanabileceği t: The total buoyant energy a rising air parcel can gain — fuel for the storm.
Yükselen hava soğutur, çöken ısıtır; ne: Rising air cools, subsiding air warms; by how much? By S_p.
Yükselen hava sütunu bu yatay tüpü yakal: When the rising air column tilts this horizontal tube upward, the axis of rotation turns vertical and abruptly transforms into relative vorticity. This is precisely the birth of the mesocyclone in supercells; then the stretching term takes over and intensifies it.
Yükselen havanın ne kadar hızlı soğuyaca: The number that tells how quickly rising air will cool.
Yükselen her kilometrede 10 °C soğuma; t: 10 °C cooling for every kilometer risen; the limit of the thermal bubble.
Yükselen kuru havanın her kilometrede ka: How many degrees rising dry air cools per kilometer.
Yükselen paket kuru adyabatik hızla (yak: While a rising parcel cools at the dry adiabatic rate (about 9.8 K/km), the dew point drops by about 1.8 K/km. Since the difference is about 8 K/km, each 1 K difference at the surface corresponds to about 125 m of height. In aviation, the equivalent is approximately a 400-foot base for every 1 °C difference.
Yükselen paketin sıcaklığının çevreye eş: The level where the rising parcel's temperature equals the environment, and buoyancy ceases.
Yükselen parsel soğurken e_s düşer; e on: As the rising parcel cools, e_s drops; when e equals it, cloud forms (LCL).
Yükselen parsel ve LCL: kuru adyabatik s: Rising parcel and LCL: dry adiabatic cooling and saturation level
Yükselen termikler tepede durmaz, atalet: Rising thermals do not stop at the top; due to inertia, they overshoot into the stable layer and entrain warmer, drier air as they fall back. This "entrainment" process feeds the layer from above and pushes the boundary layer top upward step by step.
Yükselirken doygun adyabatik (≈6 K/km) s: Air that cools moist adiabatically (≈6 K/km) while ascending sheds its moisture; while descending, it warms dry adiabatically (9.8 K/km). The difference causes the air to descend warmer than it started.
Ascent brings clouds, subsidence brings clear skies.
Yükseliş hızlarının mertebesi küçüktür a: The magnitude of ascent rates is small, but the effect is large: an ω of 5 μbar/s corresponds to a vertical velocity of about 5 cm/s, lifting air roughly 2 km in 12 hours. If saturation is reached, this means widespread cloud and precipitation.
Yükselme hızı arttıkça doygunluk aşımı a: As the ascent rate increases, supersaturation increases, and smaller, less soluble nuclei are also activated. This is why droplet concentration increases in strong convective updrafts.
Yükselme yavaş olduğu için (birkaç cm/s): Because ascent is slow (a few cm/s), precipitation is light but long-lasting; it wets an area 300–500 km wide for 6–12 hours. Total precipitation is often greater than that of a cold front, only its intensity is lower.
Yükselme, bulut ve yağış beklenir: Ascent, clouds, and precipitation are expected
Yükseltilen bir paketin doygunluğa ulaşt: The level where a lifted parcel reaches saturation, that is, where the cloud base forms.
Yüzdelik tabanlı eşik (95. yüzdelik) mut: The percentile-based threshold (95th percentile) adapts to climate compared to an absolute threshold (e.g., 35 °C): the same code yields meaningful results for both Antalya and Erzurum.
Yüzdelik tablosu (`90% 95% 99% 99.9%` ka: Percentile table (mm corresponding to `90% 95% 99% 99.9%`), followed by threshold exceedance summary (`esik 38.4 mm | 31 asim | yilda ~1.0 gun | ort. fazlalik 14.2 mm`)
Yüzey 0–25 m/s · 850 hPa 5–30 m/s · 250: Surface 0–25 m/s · 850 hPa 5–30 m/s · 250 hPa jet 30–80 m/s
Yüzey 1 K ısınsaydı: 4 × 390/288 = 5,4 W: If the surface warmed by 1 K: it would emit 4 × 390/288 = 5,4 W/m² more
Yüzey 2 °C, 100 m'de 8 °C ise tersinme g: If surface is 2 °C and 8 °C at 100 m, inversion strength is 6 K/100 m; in the exact opposite direction of the dry adiabatic (−0,98 K/100 m).
Yüzey 280–310 K · 500 hPa 300–320 K · tr: Surface 280–310 K · 500 hPa 300–320 K · rapidly increases above the tropopause
Yüzey Lambert benzeri (her yöne eşit yan: The surface is assumed to be Lambertian (reflecting equally in all directions); for water and snow, this is a coarse assumption.
Yüzey Rüzgârı ile 850 hPa Rüzgârını karş: Compare Surface Wind with 850 hPa Wind; at the surface, direction turns toward the low.
Yüzey akışı 19. dakikada başlar; bir saa: Surface runoff begins at minute 19; of the one-hour precipitation, 26.2 mm infiltrates the soil and 3.8 mm turns into runoff.
Yüzey akışı: R = i − f(t) (i > f iken): Surface runoff: R = i − f(t) (when i > f)
Yüzey akışının havza çıkışına ulaşma sür: The time for surface runoff to reach the catchment outlet is a catchment characteristic independent of the rainfall itself. This distinction is the most fruitful idea in hydrology: input (effective rainfall) and system response (catchment) are modeled separately and combined using the unit hydrograph.
Yüzey alçak basınç merkezinin doğması ya: Genesis of a surface low-pressure center or significant deepening of an existing center.
Yüzey alçağı 500 hPa çukurunun 500 km do: If the surface low is 500 km east of the 500 hPa trough, the system is developing; if the two centers are stacked, deepening has ended.
Yüzey alçağı: alttaki konverjans (∇·V <: Surface low: convergence below (∇·V < 0) increases η → cyclone deepens. Divergence aloft exhausts air, surface pressure falls, convergence increases: feedback.
Yüzey alçağının üstündeki yakınsama bölg: In the convergence zone above the surface low, this term deepens the system.
Yüzey analizi tek başına yeterli değildi: Surface analysis alone is not sufficient: the same surface pattern can develop entirely differently depending on upper-level support. Therefore, analysis is always read vertically alongside 850, 700, 500, and 250 hPa charts.
Yüzey buz olursa: doyma basıncı düşer, a: If the surface is ice: saturation vapor pressure drops, and the same e means a higher saturation ratio (Bergeron process).
Yüzey cephesinin tam üstünde jet aranır;: Looking for the jet directly above the surface front; however, the jet core is 200–500 km on the cold side of the front.
Yüzey daha sıcak/nemli: CAPE büyür → dah: Surface is warmer/more humid: CAPE increases → stronger updraft, hail/tornado risk.
Yüzey enerji dengesini yaz: R_n − G = H: Write surface energy balance: R_n − G = H + λE.
Yüzey gerilimi enerjisini damla oluşum e: Adding surface tension energy to droplet formation energy to find the equilibrium radius.
Yüzey gerilimi saf su değeri; organik ma: Surface tension is the pure water value; if organic matter is present, it decreases and activation becomes easier.
Determined by surface tension and temperature.
Yüzey gerilmesi 0,01–1 Pa · fırtınada >: Surface stress 0,01–1 Pa · in storms > 2 Pa
Yüzey gri cisim: ε dalga boyundan bağıms: Surface is a gray body: ε is assumed independent of wavelength.
Yüzey güneşle ısındığında oluşan termikl: Thermals formed when the surface is heated by the sun extend from the bottom to the top of the layer and mix it on the order of minutes. The result is seen in the vertical profile: θ is nearly constant (neutral stratification), as is the mixing ratio. In other words, if you see a vertical θ line on a sounding, you are looking at the mixed layer.
Yüzey haritasında çiy noktası çizgileri,: On a surface chart, dew point contours show air mass boundaries more sharply than temperature: a dryline is precisely defined as a dew point front and is where severe convection is triggered.
Yüzey ihmal edilebilir kalınlıkta bir ar: The surface is assumed to be an interface of negligible thickness; therefore, energy cannot accumulate there, and incoming and outgoing must balance. The power of the equation comes from this: if three of the four terms are known, the fourth can be calculated.
Yüzey ile hava arasında sıcaklık farkı y: Heat flux transported by turbulent eddies through the temperature difference between the surface and the air.
Yüzey ile toprağın derinlikleri arasında: Heat flux conducted between the surface and deeper soil layers.
Yüzey istasyonları ve yağış ölçerler ise: Surface stations and rain gauges are used for the calibration of radar precipitation products. Here too lies a representativeness problem: the gauge sees a 200 cm² point, while the radar cell sees a 1 km² volume. For this reason, comparisons are made not with individual values, but with long-term statistics.
Yüzey izotermleriyle cephe aramak; kıyı-: Searching for fronts using surface isotherms; coastal-land and elevation differences produce false gradients resembling fronts.
Yüzey kabuklanırsa ya da betonlaşırsa: f: If the surface crusts over or becomes paved: fc collapses, and the same rainfall generates many times more runoff.
Yüzey kayma gerilmesinin hız birimine çe: The surface shear stress converted to velocity units; a scale for the intensity of boundary layer turbulence.
Yüzey konverjans çizgisi 10⁻⁴ s⁻¹ · sino: Surface convergence line 10⁻⁴ s⁻¹ · synoptic low center 2–5·10⁻⁵ s⁻¹
Yüzey kurursa: LE düşer, H artar, yüzey: If the surface dries: LE drops, H increases, surface and 2 m temperatures rise rapidly.
Yüzey kuvvetlerini gerilme tensörüyle if: Express surface forces with the stress tensor; under the Newtonian fluid assumption, this is separated into pressure and viscous parts.
Yüzey merkezinin yukarıdaki çukurla çakı: Coincidence of the surface center with the upper trough is mistaken for the "strongest moment"; on the contrary, this is a sign that development has ended.
Yüzey nemi artarsa: θe yükselir, konvekt: If surface moisture increases: θe rises, convective potential and CAPE increase.
Yüzey paketini LCL'ye kadar kuru adyabat: Lifting the surface parcel along the dry adiabat to the LCL, then along the moist adiabat is the standard reading.
Yüzey pürüzlüyse (K↑): kesme açısı büyür: If the surface is rough (K↑): cross-isobar angle increases → more convergence into the low.
Yüzey rüzgârı alçak basınca doğru saptığ: Because the surface wind deflects toward low pressure, net convergence occurs at the cyclone center. Conservation of mass pushes this air upward through the top of the boundary layer: a vertical velocity of the order of w_E ≈ ζ_g·D/2 is generated.
Yüzey rüzgârı jeostrofiğin karada %40–60: Surface wind is 40–60% of geostrophic over land, 60–80% over sea
Yüzey rüzgârının izobarları keserek alça: The angle at which the surface wind crosses the isobars toward low pressure; varies with roughness and stability.
Yüzey rüzgârının sürtünmeyle izobarı kes: Surface wind crossing isobars due to friction and flowing into the low: crossing the isobar ∂p/∂s < 0, the parcel accelerates but friction decelerates it.
Yüzey soğuması ile hava soğuması aynı hı: Surface cooling and air cooling do not occur at the same rate; 2 m temperature can remain several kelvins higher than the surface temperature.
Yüzey sıcaklığı bilinmediği için doyma b: Since surface temperature is unknown, linearize saturation vapor pressure around air temperature: slope Δ.
Yüzey sıcaklığını denklemlerden ele ve λ: Eliminate surface temperature from the equations and solve for λE — the result is in Penman-Monteith form.
Yüzey tabakasında iki ölçek vardır: meka: There are two scales in the surface layer: mechanical production (u*³) and buoyancy production/consumption (heat flux).
Yüzey tabanlı CAPE ile karışık tabaka CA: Surface-based CAPE and mixed-layer CAPE values differ; which one is used should be specified.
Yüzey tayfsal olarak seçici ise (düşük ε: If the surface is spectrally selective (low ε(IR), high a(visible)), it warms — this is the design principle of solar collectors.
Yüzey tek katmanlı (\"büyük yaprak\") ka: The surface is assumed to be single-layered ("big leaf").
Yüzey yataydır. Eğimli yüzeyler için eği: The surface is horizontal. For sloping surfaces, slope and aspect angle are also taken into account.
Yüzey çiy noktası 2 K artarsa: CAPE tipi: If the surface dew point increases by 2 K: CAPE typically increases by 200–400 J/kg; moisture is the most sensitive input.
Yüzey ölçümleri paketin gerçek kaynağını: Surface measurements represent the true source of the parcel (misleading if a shallow mixed layer is present).
Yüzey ısı akısı 250 W/m² ise giriş bölge: If the surface heat flux is 250 W/m², the flux at the entrainment zone is taken as ≈ −50 W/m².
Yüzey ısınması/soğuması yanıltır. ~1,5 k: Surface warming/cooling can be misleading. At ~1.5 km, the air mass appears clearer.
Yüzey ısınıp Γ dikleşirse: kararsızlık →: If the surface warms and Γ steepens: instability → thunderstorm.
Yüzey ısınırsa: paket eğrisi sağa kayar,: If the surface warms: the parcel curve shifts right, negative area shrinks, CIN decreases.
Yüzey ışınımla soğur, hemen üstündeki ha: The surface cools by radiation, the air immediately above it cools by contact and weak turbulence; the air aloft is little affected. Consequently, a strongly stable layer several tens to several hundreds of meters thick forms above the ground.
Yüzey-500 hPa arası ortalama yakınsama 2: Mean convergence between surface and 500 hPa is 2·10⁻⁵ s⁻¹
Yüzey: 960–1050 hPa · 500 hPa yüksekliği: Surface: 960–1050 hPa · 500 hPa height: ~5500 m · 250 hPa: ~10.5 km
Yüzeyde 1,2 kg/m³, 500 hPa'da yaklaşık 0: 1.2 kg/m³ at the surface, approximately 0.7 kg/m³ at 500 hPa: the same pressure gradient yields greater acceleration aloft.
Yüzeyde 160°'den 10 m/s, 700 hPa'da 240°: 10 m/s from 160° at the surface, 20 m/s from 240° at 700 hPa: 80° clockwise veering, i.e., distinct warm advection.
Yüzeyde 180°/5 m/s, 1 km'de 240°/20 m/s: If 180°/5 m/s at the surface and 240°/20 m/s at 1 km, the vector difference is approximately 17 m/s; this is strong shear for 0–1 km.
Yüzeyde 30 °C olan hava 2 km'ye çıkınca: Air that is 30 °C at the surface drops to 10 °C when lifted to 2 km; this is why the summit of Mount Uludağ is cool on a summer afternoon.
Yüzeyde 300 K olan paketle karşılaştır:: Compare with a parcel at 300 K at the surface: 314.8 > 300 → layer is dry stable
Yüzeyde 300°'den 12 m/s, 700 hPa'da 250°: 12 m/s from 300° at the surface, 22 m/s from 250° at 700 hPa: 50° backing, cold advection.
Yüzeyde 305 K olan θ, 1500 m'ye kadar 30: If θ, which is 305 K at the surface, remains 305±0.5 K up to 1500 m, the mixed layer depth is 1500 m.
Yüzeyde 5 m/s güney, 6 km'de 30 m/s batı: 5 m/s southerly at the surface, 30 m/s westerly at 6 km: vector difference magnitude ≈ 30.4 m/s → supercell environment.
Yüzeyde 5 m/s güneybatılı, 500 hPa'da 45: 5 m/s southwesterly at the surface, 45 m/s westerly at 500 hPa: |V_T| ≈ 41 m/s, direction almost due west.
Yüzeyde 6 °C, 100 m'de 11 °C ölçülürse 1: If 6 °C is measured at the surface and 11 °C at 100 m, there is a +5 K/100 m inversion in the 100 m stable layer.
Yüzeyde T_d = 16 °C olan hava 1500 m'ye: Air with T_d = 16 °C at the surface drops to 16 − 1.8·1.5 = 13.3 °C when rising to 1500 m; since the parcel's temperature is also 13.3 °C, it saturates right there.
Yüzeyde akış izobarı keser (sürtünme), 8: At the surface, flow crosses isobars (friction); above 850 hPa, it flows nearly parallel.
Yüzeyde fark büyükse sürtünme, eğri izob: If the difference is large at the surface, friction is involved; if there is a difference along curved isobars, the gradient wind is involved.
Yüzeyde gerçek rüzgâr jeostrofikten ~%30: At the surface, the actual wind is ~30% slower than geostrophic and blows toward the low crossing isobars at 15–30°.
Yüzeyde güneyli, 500 hPa'da batılı: sıca: Southerly at the surface, westerly at 500 hPa: warm air advection (WAA).
Yüzeyde hava toplanıyorsa yukarı gitmek: If air converges at the surface, it must go upward.
Yüzeyde kuzeyli, üstte batılı: soğuk adv: Northerly at the surface, westerly aloft: cold air advection (CAA).
Yüzeyde rüzgâr bir noktaya toplanıyorsa: If surface wind converges to a point (convergence), air escapes upward: cumulus formation.
Yüzeyde rüzgâr izobarı 25° keserek esiyo: At the surface, the wind blows crossing isobars at 25°, while at 850 hPa it is nearly parallel. Why?
Yüzeyde rüzgâr jeostrofik yönle yaklaşık: At the surface, the wind makes an angle of approximately 45° with the geostrophic direction (in the ideal solution); with height, the angle closes and speed approaches geostrophic.
Yüzeyde rüzgârın izobarı 20–30° keserek: The reason why the surface wind crosses isobars at 20–30° to flow into the low.
Yüzeyde soğuma çok daha hızlıdır. Açık,: Cooling at the surface is much faster. On a clear, dry, and calm night, the surface can lose 2–4 K per hour; because downward longwave flux is low and turbulent mixing is absent.
Yüzeyde sürtünme dengeyi bozar: rüzgâr i: At the surface, friction disrupts the balance: wind turns toward low pressure, crossing isobars by 25–35° over land and 10–20° over sea. This crossing toward the low center produces convergence, hence ascent; in an anticyclone, the opposite occurs and subsidence is observed.
Yüzeyde sürtünme nedeniyle siklona doğru: Due to friction at the surface, there is an inflow of 1–3 m/s toward the cyclone; this inflow feeds the ascent.
Yüzeyde sürtünme rüzgârı yavaşlatır, Cor: At the surface, friction slows the wind, Coriolis decreases, and balance is disrupted → flow curves toward low pressure. At the height where friction ends, flow approaches geostrophic.
Yüzeyde tipik büyüklük 10⁻⁴ m/s²; Coriol: Typical magnitude at the surface is 10⁻⁴ m/s²; approaches the same order of magnitude as Coriolis acceleration (10⁻³ m/s²).
Yüzeyde yüksek θe dili (nemli-sıcak hava: A surface tongue of high θe (warm-moist air corridor) is the fuel source for most severe weather events.
Yüzeyde ρ = 1,225 kg/m³: ∂p/∂z = −12,0 P: At the surface ρ = 1.225 kg/m³: ∂p/∂z = −12.0 Pa/m; at 5.5 km with ρ = 0.7 it becomes −6.9 Pa/m, dropping by about half.
Yüzeydeki konverjans tek başına yağış ga: Surface convergence is often mistakenly assumed to guarantee precipitation; without moisture and instability, only a cloud boundary forms.
Yüzeydeki sıcaklık ile çiy noktası farkı: Practical estimation of convective cloud base from surface temperature and dew point spread.
Yüzeydeki yakınsama ile üst seviyedeki ı: The coupling of low-level convergence and upper-level divergence is the fundamental mechanism of cyclogenesis.
Yüzeyden 500 hPa'ya konverjans −10⁻⁵ s⁻¹: If convergence from surface to 500 hPa is −10⁻⁵ s⁻¹, then ω(500) ≈ 500 hPa × 10⁻⁵ = 0.5 Pa/s: 5 cm/s ascent, sufficient for stratiform precipitation.
Yüzeyden aşağı inildikçe önce doymamış (: Descending from the surface, first comes the unsaturated (vadose) zone, then the water table, then the saturated zone. The water table is the surface where pore pressure equals atmospheric pressure; this is the free water level observed in a well.
Yüzeyden buharlaşma ile bitki terlemesin: The sum of surface evaporation and plant transpiration.
Yüzeyden buharlaşma olursa: w artar, LCL: If evaporation from the surface occurs: w increases, LCL lowers, cloud base drops.
Yüzeyden kaldırılan bir hava paketinin d: The height at which an air parcel lifted from the surface saturates and forms a cloud base is proportional to the surface temperature–dew point depression.
Yüzeyden kaldırılan paket, LFC ye varana: A parcel lifted from the surface is usually colder than its environment until reaching the LFC; this region is the negative area on a Skew-T. CIN is the magnitude of that area and its sign is meaningful: energy is not gained, but expended. The triggering mechanism (front, breeze boundary, mountain, daytime heating) must foot this bill.
Yüzeyden salınan bir maddenin türbülansl: The highest level to which a substance released from the surface can disperse by turbulence; volume scale for pollution calculations.
Yüzeyden yukarı 300–500 W/m² · atmosferd: Upward from surface 300–500 W/m² · downward from atmosphere 200–400 W/m² · net loss 30–100 W/m²
Yüzeyden yukarı ok saat yönünde dönüyors: If the arrow turns clockwise upward, warming is on the way.
Yüzeyden yükselen termiklerin potansiyel: The daytime layer where thermals rising from the surface make potential temperature and moisture nearly uniform in the vertical.
Yüzeyden zorla yükseltilen bir parselin: The height at which a parcel forcibly lifted from the surface reaches saturation. Because the temperature and dew point closing rate is 8 K/km, it occurs at approximately 125 times the initial depression in meters and determines the flat base of cumulus clouds.
Yüzeye gelen kısa dalga akısını K↓ ile g: Denote incoming shortwave flux at the surface by K↓.
Yüzeye gelen net enerji, bileşenlerinin: Net energy incoming to the surface, most of its components increase with temperature; the sum is linearized as ≈ a + b(T̄ − T₀).
Yüzeye giren ve yüzeyden çıkan bütün kıs: The algebraic sum of all shortwave and longwave fluxes entering and leaving the surface.
Yüzeye teğet yönde etki eden birim aland: Force per unit area acting tangentially to the surface; a measure of momentum transfer between adjacent fluid layers.
Yüzeye ulaşan kısa dalga, güneş diskinde: Shortwave radiation reaching the surface is the sum of two components: direct radiation from the solar disk and diffuse radiation scattered from the entire sky.
Yüzeye ulaşan çap, erime katmanının kalı: The diameter reaching the surface also depends on the depth of the melting layer. If the freezing level is high, small stones melt on the way down; therefore, both strong updraft and a relatively low freezing level favor large hail in summer. A diameter of 2 cm and above is considered "severe".
Yüzeye yakın adyabatik yükselmede her 10: In adiabatic ascent near the surface, every 10 hPa pressure drop corresponds to ≈ 0.82 K cooling.
Yüzeye yakın girdaplarla karışım: Mixing with eddies near the surface
Yüzeye yakın her 100 m yükselişte basınç: Near the surface, pressure drops ≈ 12 hPa for every 100 m ascent; around 5 km, ≈ 190 m is needed for the same drop.
Yüzeye yakın katmanda sürtünme rüzgârı y: In the layer near the surface, friction slows the wind; Coriolis force of the decelerated wind decreases and cannot balance the pressure gradient force. Result: wind turns toward low pressure, crossing isobars.
Yüzeye yakın katmanda türbülanslı karışı: The effect of turbulent mixing in the layer near the surface that slows motion and disrupts balance.
Yüzeye yakın konverjans, havayı yukarı ç: Low-level convergence forces air upward because there is nowhere to go downward. Therefore, surface convergence lines (sea breeze front, outflow boundary, dryline) are the most reliable triggers of convection.
Yüzeye yakın ℓ = κ·z alınır: girdap yerd: Near the surface ℓ = κ·z is assumed: an eddy can grow larger the farther it is from the ground. Aloft, it is limited by layer depth; typical form is 1/ℓ = 1/(κz) + 1/ℓ₀.
Yüzeyi sıfır kalınlıkta bir arayüz kabul: Assume the surface is an interface of zero thickness: no energy can accumulate within it.
Heat the surface: positive area grows.
Yüzeyin kazandığı net radyasyon, duyulur: Net radiation gained by the surface is partitioned into sensible heat, latent heat, and ground heat flux.
Yüzeyin net enerjisini havayı ısıtmakla: Summarizes in a single number how the surface partitions its net energy between heating the air and evaporating water.
Yüzeyin sürtünme, ısıtma ve nemlendirme: The lowest atmospheric layer where the effects of surface friction, heating, and moistening are felt on a one-hour timescale.
Yüzey–700 hPa katmanında ortalama konver: Mean convergence in the surface–700 hPa layer is −2×10⁻⁵ s⁻¹ → ω(700) = 300 hPa × (−2×10⁻⁵) = −0.6 Pa/s ≈ 6 cm/s ascent: stratiform precipitation.
Yüzey–700 hPa katmanında ortalama −2·10⁻: Surface–700 hPa layer mean −2·10⁻⁵ s⁻¹: ω(700) = 3·10⁴ Pa · (−2·10⁻⁵) = −0.6 Pa/s.
Yıllık ET = 520 mm, ΔS = +30 mm (yeraltı: Annual ET = 520 mm, ΔS = +30 mm (groundwater recharge)
Yıllık en büyük değerler bağımsız ve ayn: Annual maximum values are independent and identically distributed.
Yıllık olaylar bağımsızdır; kümelenme (a: Annual events are independent; if clustering (consecutive wet years) exists, the risk is greater than calculated.
Yıllık ortalama akış katsayısı (Q/P) ile: Annual mean runoff coefficient (Q/P) and event-based C are not the same quantity; the former is typically smaller because it also includes evaporation. Confusing them biases water yield calculations.
Yılın günü (doy) ekseni artı yıl bazlı r: The day of year (doy) axis plus year-based coloring overlays years of different lengths (leap years) with a slight shift; the 1–365 range is practically sufficient.
Z = 55 dBZ, ZDR = 0,1 dB, ρHV = 0,93 ve: Z = 55 dBZ, ZDR = 0.1 dB, ρHV = 0.93 and temperature −5 °C → likely hail category.
Z = a R^b , tipik: Z = 200 R^1,6: Z = a R^b , typical: Z = 200 R^1.6
Z = Σ D⁶ tanımı Rayleigh rejiminde geçer: The definition Z = Σ D⁶ holds in the Rayleigh regime and is extremely sensitive to large drops due to the sixth power. A single 2 mm drop yields a signal equivalent to 64 drops of 1 mm. Therefore, radar can overestimate precipitation when observing a small number of large drops.
Z = Φ/g₀ ile tanımlanır ve g₀ = 9,80665: Defined as Z = Φ/g₀, where g₀ = 9.80665 m/s² is a constant. Thus, the value turns out very close to meters, while the variation of gravity with latitude is automatically accounted for.
Z altıncı, R ise yaklaşık 3,67. momentti: Z is the sixth moment and R is approximately the 3.67th moment; there is no single universal relationship between the two. The relation can only be established under an assumption about drop size distribution, so the coefficients vary depending on precipitation type.
Z aralığı 10⁻³ ile 10⁷ arasında değişir:: The Z range varies between 10⁻³ and 10⁷: seven orders of magnitude.
Z değeri çisentide 1, iri dolu taşında 1: Z value can be 1 in drizzle and 10⁷ mm⁶/m³ in large hailstones; seven orders of magnitude cannot fit onto a single color scale. The logarithmic transformation reduces this range to between −30 and +75 dBZ, and each 10 dBZ represents a tenfold increase in Z.
Z ile R arasındaki bağıntının değişken o: Here lies the root cause of the variable relation between Z and R: the same rain rate can be produced by a few large drops or many small drops, but the sixth moment Z differs vastly between the two.
Z profilinden türetilir; dolu teşhisinde: Derived from the Z profile; used in hail identification.
ZAMAN ortalaması — her noktada zaman boy: TIME average — averages over time at each point, result is still a map (climatological field)
ZDR (diferansiyel yansıtırlık), yatay ve: ZDR (differential reflectivity) is the ratio of power in horizontal and vertical channels in dB and measures hydrometeor oblateness. Because large raindrops flatten as they fall, ZDR rises to 1–4 dB; spherical hail and randomly oriented snow are around 0 dB.
ZDR tek başına değil, yansıtırlık (dBZ),: ZDR is not read alone, but together with reflectivity (dBZ), correlation coefficient (ρHV), and differential phase (KDP). Hydrometeor classification algorithms use this quartet together.
ZDR: yağmur 0,5–4 dB, dolu ≈ 0 dB, kar 0: ZDR: rain 0.5–4 dB, hail ≈ 0 dB, snow 0–0.5 dB · KDP: 0–10 °/km · ρHV: rain > 0.98, debris < 0.8
Zaman aralığı (`[l=...]`) gömülü veride: The time range (`[l=...]`) was dropped because it corresponds to all time steps in the embedded data; in a real setup, it determines which months/years to average.
Zaman biriminin kendisini okuyup basıyor: We read and print the time unit itself: the reference date varies from file to file (1900, 1970, 1800...).
Zaman biriminin metnini okuyup basıyoruz: We read and print the text of the time unit: the epoch (origin) is not the same in every file.
Zaman ekseni NetCDF'te \"birim + dönem\": The time axis is stored in NetCDF as "unit + epoch". Assuming the epoch instead of reading it from the file is a classic mistake that shifts dates by years.
Zaman ekseni boyunca ortalama: tek bir a: Average along the time axis: only a single field remains.
Zaman ekseni düzensizse (eksik adımlar): If the time axis is irregular (missing steps), Ferret will still plot it, but the vertical axis will be misleading; verify the step interval before reading speed from the slope.
Zaman indeksi 1 = dosyadaki ilk adım (an: Time index 1 = first step in the file (analysis time).
Zaman kaydırıcısını oynat: bandın hareke: Move the time slider: the movement direction of the band gives the direction of the system.
Zaman kaydırıcısını oynat; kesikli çizgi: Move the time slider; the dashed line shows the future of the system.
Zaman kaydırıcısını son gözlem saatinin: Move the time slider past the last observation time. Check whether the transition from observation to forecast is visually marked — if it is not marked, this is a lack of integrity.
Zaman kaydırıcısını öğleden sonraya al;: Move the time slider to the afternoon; is CAPE peaking?
Zaman kaydırıcısının tasarımı da bilgi t: The design of the time slider also conveys information. Place a thin strip above the slider to show data density: which hours have data, which do not, and where the model changes. Make the play/pause button accessible via keyboard. Most importantly: display the selected time in NUMERICAL format and in the local time zone as well — an interface that only displays “T+18” tells a non-expert user nothing.
Zaman ortalaması: sekiz alandan tek alan: Time average: only a single field remains from eight fields.
Zaman serilerinde ardışık bağımlılık var: If there is serial dependence in time series, the effective sample size is smaller than the actual n.
Zaman serisi analizinde ilk iş veriyi ta: In time series analysis, the first step is to place the data onto a complete axis. Missing rows are not "absent" but "unknown"; asfreq makes this distinction visible.
Zaman serisi süzme ve güç spektrumu — gü: Time series filtering and power spectrum — separating the diurnal cycle
Zaman türevinde merkezi fark (leapfrog): Centered difference in time derivative (leapfrog) produces a computational mode; even and odd steps decouple, requiring a filter.
Zaman türevini al ve hareket denklemini: Take the time derivative and substitute the equation of motion.
Zaman ölçümü çift duyarlıklı olmalı: tek: Timing measurement must be double precision: second resolution is insufficient in single precision.
Zamana göre sıralı gözlem dizisi ve bu d: A chronologically ordered sequence of observations and its smoothing using a moving window average.
Zamanlama omp_get_wtime ile yapılmalıdır: Timing should be done with omp_get_wtime. cpu_time sums the time spent by all cores; as you parallelize, it appears as though it is "slowing down".
Zamanlama tablosunu düzenler. Beş alan s: Edits the schedule table. The five fields are, respectively, minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week.
Zamanı göstermenin iki temel stratejisi: There are two fundamental strategies for displaying time: mapping time to time (animation) or mapping time to space (side-by-side frames, placing on an axis). Animation shows motion but makes comparison impossible — human working memory cannot retain the previous frame completely. Mapping to space facilitates comparison but loses the sense of motion.
Zayıf yönü bağımlılıktır: model sürümü d: Its weakness is dependency: when the model version changes, the relationship established in the past breaks down, and performance degrades until MOS is retrained. In addition, the statistical relationship loses its validity in extreme events never seen in the training data; in rare events, MOS systematically suppresses extreme values.
Zayıflığı düzensiz ızgaralarda ve karmaş: Its weakness arises in irregular grids and complex boundaries. The finite volume method is preferred in these cases because it naturally preserves conservation, and the finite element method because it adapts to complex geometry.
Zengin daha zengin olur: büyük damla dah: The rich get richer: a large drop falls faster, collects more, and grows even larger.
Zenit açısı 60° ise yatay yüzeye düşen d: If the zenith angle is 60°, direct flux incident on a horizontal surface is reduced to cos60° = 0.5 times that of normal incidence.
Zenit açısı ile yükseklik açısı (elevasy: Zenith angle and elevation angle are complementary to each other: θ_z = 90° − h. Confusing the two reverses the flux.
Zenit açısı, güneş ışınıyla yerel düşey: Zenith angle is the angle between the solar ray and the local vertical: θz = 0 means the sun is directly overhead, θz = 90° means the sun is on the horizon. The beam incident on a horizontal surface narrows by cos θz — which is why the same sun heats much less in winter and during morning hours. The reason for the temperature difference is not the Earth–Sun distance, but almost entirely this cosine factor.
Zincir kuralı: dw/dt = w dw/dz → w dw =: Chain rule: dw/dt = w dw/dz → w dw = B dz.
Zincir kuralı: zaman türevini yol türevi: Chain rule: convert time derivative to path derivative
Zincir kuralında yalnız ∂p/∂r yolunu yaz: Writing only the ∂p/∂r path in the chain rule and omitting the ∂p/∂θ path. In a circularly symmetric field, the second term is indeed zero, but if there is no symmetry (which is the case in real cyclones), the equation becomes incorrect.
Zincirin her halkasında hangi hata doğar: What error arises at each link of the chain
Zincirleme. İşlemler **sağdan sola** uyg: Chaining. Operations are applied **from right to left**: first the variable is selected, then the box is cropped, and finally the average is taken. It is much faster because no intermediate files are written.
Zincirleme: model koşusu başarıyla biter: Chaining: if the model run completes successfully, post-processing starts automatically. The way to set up the pipeline in SLURM.
Zonal APE ≈ 4·10⁶ J/m² · girdap kinetik: Zonal APE ≈ 4·10⁶ J/m² · eddy kinetic energy ≈ 7·10⁵ J/m² · conversion 2–3 W/m²
Zonal dalga sayısı: birim uzunluğa düşen: Zonal wavenumber: number of waves per unit length, 2π/Lx. Because its square is in the denominator of the phase speed formula, long waves propagate westward faster.
Zorlama ile gerçekleşen sıcaklık değişim: Forcing and realized temperature change are not the same thing; the thermal inertia of the ocean delays the response by decades.
Zorlama tipik olarak −0,2 ile −1,5 Pa/s: Forcing typically produces ω between −0.2 and −1.5 Pa/s
Zorlama, tepkiden ayrılmış bir \"girdi\": Forcing is an "input" metric decoupled from the response. Surface temperature is held fixed, allowing only the stratosphere to thermally readjust; thus, different agents can be compared on a common scale.
Zorlanmış yükseliş, kararsızlık olmasa b: Forced lifting can produce condensation even without instability. Therefore, orographic precipitation can be both convective and stratiform and operates largely independent of stability.
Zorluğu işleme adımlarındadır: koordinat: The difficulty lies in the processing steps: coordinate rotation (zeroing the mean vertical velocity), density corrections, gap filling of missing data, and compensation for high/low frequency losses. A 10–20% difference often arises between raw covariance and final flux.

import numpy as np # Kose sirasi: 0=(i,j: import numpy as np # Kose sirasi: 0=(i,j) 1=(i+1,j) 2=(i+1,j+1) 3=(i,j+1) # Kenar k, k. kose ile (k+1)%4 kosesini birlestirir. # Her durum icin cizilecek kenar CIFTLERI: KENARLAR = { 1: [(3, 0)], 2: [(0, 1)], 3: [(3, 1)], 4: [(1, 2)], 5: [(3, 0), (1, 2)], # belirsiz eyer 6: [(0, 2)], 7: [(3, 2)], 8: [(2, 3)], 9: [(2, 0)], 10: [(0, 1), (2, 3)], # belirsiz eyer 11: [(2, 1)], 12: [(1, 3)], 13: [(1, 0)], 14: [(0, 3)], } KOSELER = [(0, 0), (1, 0), (1, 1), (0, 1)] def _kenar_noktasi(k, i, j, x, y, v, duzey): """k numarali kenarin uzerinde kontur duzeyinin gectigi noktayi bulur.""" a, b = k, (k + 1) % 4 dia, dja = KOSELER[a] dib, djb = KOSELER[b] t = (duzey - v[a]) / (v[b] - v[a]) px = x[i + dia] + t * (x[i + dib] - x[i + dia]) py = y[j + dja] + t * (y[j + djb] - y[j + dja]) return (px, py) def marching_squares(z, duzey, x, y): """z[j, i] izgarasi icin 'duzey' konturunun parcalarini dondurur.""" parcalar = [] ny, nx = z.shape for j in range(ny - 1): for i in range(nx - 1): v = (z[j, i], z[j, i + 1], z[j + 1, i + 1], z[j + 1, i]) if np.isnan(v).any(): continue durum = 0 for k in range(4): if v[k] >= duzey: durum |= 1 << k if durum == 0 or durum == 15: continue # hucre tamamen ustte ya da altta if durum in (5, 10): # EYER: merkeze bakarak karar ver merkez = 0.25 * (v[0] + v[1] + v[2] + v[3]) ortaUstte = merkez >= duzey if (durum == 5 and ortaUstte) or (durum == 10 and not ortaUstte): durum = 15 - durum # baglantiyi ters cevir for (ka, kb) in KENARLAR[durum]: parcalar.append((_kenar_noktasi(ka, i, j, x, y, v, duzey), _kenar_noktasi(kb, i, j, x, y, v, duzey))) return parcalar if __name__ == '__main__': x = np.linspace(-5, 5, 81) y = np.linspace(-5, 5, 81) X, Y = np.meshgrid(x, y) Z = np.exp(-(X**2 + Y**2) / 4) - np.exp(-((X - 3)**2 + Y**2) / 2) for duzey in (-0.4, -0.2, 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6): p = marching_squares(Z, duzey, x, y) print('duzey %+.1f -> %d parca' % (duzey, len(p)))
import numpy as np def _ornekle(alan, x,: import numpy as np def _ornekle(alan, x, y, px, py): """alan[j, i] izgarasindan (px, py) noktasini iki-dogrusal ara degerle okur.""" i = int(np.clip(np.searchsorted(x, px) - 1, 0, len(x) - 2)) j = int(np.clip(np.searchsorted(y, py) - 1, 0, len(y) - 2)) tx = (px - x[i]) / (x[i + 1] - x[i]) ty = (py - y[j]) / (y[j + 1] - y[j]) return ((1 - tx) * (1 - ty) * alan[j, i] + tx * (1 - ty) * alan[j, i + 1] + (1 - tx) * ty * alan[j + 1, i] + tx * ty * alan[j + 1, i + 1]) def akim_cizgisi(u, v, x, y, p0, h=0.1, en_fazla=500): """Alan ZAMANDA DONDURULMUS kabul edilir: bu bir akim cizgisidir, yorunge degil.""" def V(q): return np.array([_ornekle(u, x, y, q[0], q[1]), _ornekle(v, x, y, q[0], q[1])]) p = np.array(p0, dtype=float) yol = [tuple(p)] for _ in range(en_fazla): if not (x[0] <= p[0] <= x[-1] and y[0] <= p[1] <= y[-1]): break k1 = V(p) hiz = np.hypot(k1[0], k1[1]) if hiz < 1e-6: break # duragan nokta: cizgi burada biter k2 = V(p + 0.5 * h * k1) k3 = V(p + 0.5 * h * k2) k4 = V(p + h * k3) p = p + (h / 6.0) * (k1 + 2 * k2 + 2 * k3 + k4) yol.append(tuple(p)) return yol if __name__ == '__main__': x = np.linspace(-10, 10, 101) y = np.linspace(-10, 10, 101) X, Y = np.meshgrid(x, y) u = -Y # saat yonunun tersine donen basit girdap v = X yol = akim_cizgisi(u, v, x, y, (4.0, 0.0), h=0.05, en_fazla=800) print('nokta sayisi:', len(yol)) print('baslangic:', yol[0], ' bitis:', yol[-1])

K, hPa theta = tk * (p0 / p) ** kappa end function theta elemental real function theta_e(tk, p, r) real, intent(in) :: tk, p, r ! r: mixing ratio (kg/kg) theta_e = theta(tk, p) * exp(lv * r / (cp * tk)) end function theta_e end module termo program sondaj use termo implicit none integer, parameter :: n = 6 real :: p(n), tk(n), r(n), th(n), the(n) integer :: k p = [1000.0, 925.0, 850.0, 700.0, 500.0, 300.0] tk = [ 291.2, 286.4, 281.9, 272.1, 254.3, 228.6] r = [0.0110, 0.0092, 0.0074, 0.0040, 0.0011, 0.0001] th = theta(tk, p) ! elemental: array in, array out the = theta_e(tk, p, r) print '(A)', ' p T theta theta_e' do k = 1, n print '(F8.1,F8.2,F9.2,F10.2)', p(k), tk(k), th(k), the(k) end do if (any(th(2:n) - th(1:n-1) < 0.0)) then print *, 'WARNING: theta decreases with height -> statically UNSTABLE layer' else print *, 'theta increases with height -> statically stable' end if print '(A,F7.2,A)', 'surface-500 hPa theta_e difference: ', the(5) - the(1), ' K' end program sondaj

program advect1d implicit none integer,: program advect1d implicit none integer, parameter :: nx = 201, nt = 400 real, parameter :: dx = 5.0e3, uadv = 10.0, dt = 200.0 real :: q(nx), qn(nx), x, cfl integer :: i, n cfl = uadv * dt / dx if (cfl > 1.0) then print *, 'CFL =', cfl, ' > 1 -> kararsiz; dt kucult' stop 1 end if do i = 1, nx ! baslangic: Gauss tepesi x = real(i - 1) * dx q(i) = exp(-((x - 200.0e3)**2) / (2.0 * (50.0e3)**2)) end do do n = 1, nt ! zaman dongusu qn(1) = q(1) - cfl * (q(1) - q(nx)) ! dongusel sinir do i = 2, nx qn(i) = q(i) - cfl * (q(i) - q(i-1)) ! upwind (uadv > 0) end do q = qn end do open(unit=10, file='advect_out.txt', status='replace') do i = 1, nx write(10,'(F12.1,1X,F10.6)') real(i-1)*dx, q(i) end do close(10) print '(A,F6.3,A,F8.5,A,ES12.4)', 'CFL=', cfl, ' maks=', maxval(q), & ' integral=', sum(q)*dx end program advect1d
program diffuse2d implicit none integer,: program diffuse2d implicit none integer, parameter :: nx = 101, ny = 101, nt = 5000 real, parameter :: dx = 10.0e3, dy = 10.0e3, kdif = 2.0e4 real :: t(nx,ny), tn(nx,ny), dt, r, err integer :: i, j, n dt = 0.2 * min(dx*dx, dy*dy) / kdif ! stability: r <= 1/4 r = kdif * dt / (dx*dx) print '(A,F9.1,A,F6.3)', 'dt = ', dt, ' s r = ', r t = 260.0 ! background (K) t(40:60, 40:60) = 290.0 ! hot spot do n = 1, nt tn = t do j = 2, ny-1 do i = 2, nx-1 t(i,j) = tn(i,j) + r * ( tn(i+1,j) + tn(i-1,j) & + tn(i,j+1) + tn(i,j-1) - 4.0*tn(i,j) ) end do end do t(1,:) = t(2,:); t(nx,:) = t(nx-1,:) ! zero flux (Neumann) boundary t(:,1) = t(:,2); t(:,ny) = t(:,ny-1) err = maxval(abs(t - tn)) if (err < 1.0e-6) exit end do print '(A,I6,A,ES10.3)', 'step = ', n, ' last change = ', err print '(A,F8.3,A,F8.3)', 'min = ', minval(t), ' max = ', maxval(t) print '(A,F10.4)', 'mean (conserved) = ', sum(t) / size(t) open(11, file='diffuse.bin', form='unformatted', access='stream') write(11) t close(11) end program diffuse2d

program omp_ws use omp_lib implicit none: program omp_ws use omp_lib implicit none integer, parameter :: nx = 1440, ny = 721, nz = 40 real, allocatable :: u(:,:,:), v(:,:,:), ws(:,:,:) real(kind=8) :: t0, t1 real :: gmax integer :: i, j, k allocate(u(nx,ny,nz), v(nx,ny,nz), ws(nx,ny,nz)) call random_number(u); u = u * 60.0 - 30.0 call random_number(v); v = v * 60.0 - 30.0 t0 = omp_get_wtime() !$omp parallel do collapse(2) schedule(static) default(shared) private(i) do k = 1, nz do j = 1, ny do i = 1, nx ws(i,j,k) = sqrt(u(i,j,k)**2 + v(i,j,k)**2) end do end do end do !$omp end parallel do t1 = omp_get_wtime() gmax = -1.0 !$omp parallel do collapse(2) reduction(max:gmax) do k = 1, nz do j = 1, ny gmax = max(gmax, maxval(ws(:,j,k))) end do end do !$omp end parallel do print '(A,I4)', 'threads : ', omp_get_max_threads() print '(A,F8.3,A)', 'time : ', t1 - t0, ' s' print '(A,F8.2)', 'max speed : ', gmax print '(A,F8.2)', 'serial check : ', maxval(ws) deallocate(u, v, ws) end program omp_ws
program read_t500 use netcdf implicit no: program read_t500 use netcdf implicit none character(len=*), parameter :: fname = 'era5_pl_20260115.nc' integer :: ncid, vid, did, nlon, nlat, nlev real, allocatable :: t(:,:,:), lev(:) real :: sf, ao integer :: k call chk( nf90_open(fname, nf90_nowrite, ncid) ) call chk( nf90_inq_dimid(ncid, 'longitude', did) ) call chk( nf90_inquire_dimension(ncid, did, len=nlon) ) call chk( nf90_inq_dimid(ncid, 'latitude', did) ) call chk( nf90_inquire_dimension(ncid, did, len=nlat) ) call chk( nf90_inq_dimid(ncid, 'level', did) ) call chk( nf90_inquire_dimension(ncid, did, len=nlev) ) allocate(lev(nlev), t(nlon, nlat, nlev)) call chk( nf90_inq_varid(ncid, 'level', vid) ) call chk( nf90_get_var(ncid, vid, lev) ) call chk( nf90_inq_varid(ncid, 't', vid) ) call chk( nf90_get_var(ncid, vid, t, start=[1,1,1,1], count=[nlon,nlat,nlev,1]) ) if (nf90_get_att(ncid, vid, 'scale_factor', sf) /= nf90_noerr) sf = 1.0 if (nf90_get_att(ncid, vid, 'add_offset', ao) /= nf90_noerr) ao = 0.0 t = t * sf + ao call chk( nf90_close(ncid) ) k = minloc(abs(lev - 500.0), dim=1) print '(A,I5,A,I5,A,I4)', 'grid: ', nlon, ' x ', nlat, ' x ', nlev print '(A,F6.0,A,F7.2,A,F7.2)', 'level ', lev(k), ' hPa: min ', & minval(t(:,:,k)), ' max ', maxval(t(:,:,k)) deallocate(t, lev) contains subroutine chk(st) integer, intent(in) :: st if (st /= nf90_noerr) then print *, 'netCDF error: ', trim(nf90_strerror(st)) stop 2 end if end subroutine chk end program read_t500

Çapraz çarpımın türevi çarpım kuralına u: The derivative of the cross product follows the product rule: (dΩ/dt) × r + Ω × (dr/dt). Since Ω is constant, the first part is zero; dr/dt is velocity U in the rotating frame. The velocity derivative in the rotating frame is written in meteorology as DU/Dt (acceleration following the motion).
Çarp-topla hamlesinden sonra θ-türevli t: After the multiply-and-add step, the θ-derivative terms form identical pairs with opposite signs and cancel out; only a single clean term remains.
Çarpanlar sadeleştirilir; faz hızı c = ν: Factors are simplified; phase speed c = ν/k. The second term is always directed westward (negative): Rossby waves propagate westward RELATIVE to the mean flow; as the wave lengthens (k decreases), its westward speed increases. c = 0 stationary wave: L_s = 2π√(U/β).
Çarpanları birleştirince merkezcil ve me: Combining the factors made the centripetal and metric terms naturally visible.
Çarpanın (ζ + f) olması kritik bir ayrın: The factor being (ζ + f) is a critical detail: even if relative vorticity is zero, stretching is effective thanks to f. That is, a calm but convergent air column can generate a cyclone solely from Earth's rotation. This is why distance from the equator is required for tropical cyclone genesis.

If the ring's radius changes over time, dR/dt is the radial velocity itself; therefore, the second term is precisely the missing piece of the product rule. Here, the metric term emerges not as a "correction", but as a natural component of the total derivative.

Ölçüt enleme göre normalize edilir: 60°: The criterion is normalized by latitude: a 24 hPa drop in 24 hours at 60° latitude is taken as the threshold; at other latitudes, the threshold is scaled by the factor sin(φ)/sin(60°). At 40° latitude, the threshold is approximately 17.8 hPa/24 h, and at 45°, it is 19.6 hPa/24 h. This scaling comes from the variation of the Coriolis parameter with latitude.
Ölçüt neden enleme normalize edilir? Der: Why is the criterion normalized by latitude? The deepening rate scales with the Coriolis parameter; the same dynamical process produces a larger pressure drop at higher latitudes. By taking sin 60° as a reference, systems at different latitudes are made comparable.
Ölçüt tanımsaldır, fiziksel bir eşik değ: The criterion is conventional, not a physical threshold; there is no qualitative difference between 23 hPa and 24 hPa.
Ölçüt yereldir; tüm sütunun davranışını: The criterion is local; it describes that specific layer, not the behavior of the entire column.
Ölçüt, kaldırma ivmesinin işaretinden çı: The criterion is derived from the sign of the buoyant acceleration. While the parcel cools at Γd (if unsaturated) or Γs (if saturated), the environment cools at Γ. If the environment cools faster than the parcel, the rising parcel remains warmer than the environment at every step and accelerates ascent: instability. If the environment cools slowly, the parcel quickly falls below the environmental temperature and is pushed back: stability.
Ölçütü hasarın devamlılığıdır: hasar izi: Its criterion is the continuity of damage: the length of the damage path must exceed approximately 650 km, wind reports exceeding 26 m/s (50 kt) must be aligned continuously along the path, and at least a few values exceeding 33 m/s must be included among them. A single strong wind event is not a derecho; continuity is required.

If the two bottom rows are swapped, the cross product changes sign — but since it is set to zero, the result is not affected in this special case; nonetheless, the habit must be established correctly.

φ = 45°'de tan φ/a = 1/6,37·10⁶ = 1,57·1: At φ = 45°, tan φ/a = 1/6.37·10⁶ = 1.57·10⁻⁷ m⁻¹; at φ = 70°, 4.31·10⁻⁷ m⁻¹, which is 2.7 times larger.

If the pattern moves in the direction of flow (at angle γ) with speed c, the trajectory is FLATTER (R_t > R_s): the answer to the question of which R to use in calculating the gradient wind is the TRAJECTORY curvature; the streamline curvature read from the chart must be corrected.
ψ rüzgâr yönü açısıdır. Parseli izlerken: ψ is the wind direction angle. The amount by which a parcel's direction changes as it is tracked (total derivative) comes from two distinct causes: (1) the pattern itself is changing with time — the local term ∂ψ/∂t; (2) the parcel has moved to a location where the direction is already different — the advection term V ∂ψ/∂s. The only source of difference between trajectory curvature and streamline curvature is the first term; in steady flow it is zero and the two curvatures coincide.
ψ zamana hem doğrudan (∂ψ/∂t) hem de par: ψ depends on time both directly (∂ψ/∂t) and indirectly through the parcel's position. The chain rule sums both dependencies: the rate of change of each coordinate with time multiplied by the rate of change of ψ with respect to that coordinate.
ψ'nin diferansiyelini genel kuralla da y: We also write the differential of ψ using the general rule; now we can compare the two expressions.
ψ'nin var olması bir ayrıcalıktır, kural: The existence of ψ is a privilege, not a rule. In divergent flow (convergence, ascent), the exact differential condition is not satisfied and a single streamfunction cannot be written; the flow is then partitioned into ψ (rotational part) and velocity potential χ (divergent part). The precipitation-producing part is precisely the part that cannot be written with ψ.
ψ'nin çukurları (Laplasiyen pozitif) sik: Troughs of ψ (positive Laplacian) cyclonic vorticity.
ψ'yi ıraksamalı akışa uygulamak: tanım y: Applying ψ to divergent flow: the definition is valid only when ∇·V = 0.
ψ, dinamik meteorolojinin \"sıkıştırılmı: ψ is the "compressed" language of dynamic meteorology: one unknown instead of two (u, v). ω bilinmeyeni iki denklem arasından elen: The unknown ω is eliminated between the two equations (one is differentiated with ∂/∂p and added to the other).
ω ile w arasındaki bağ hidrostatikten: ω: The link between ω and w comes from hydrostatics: ω = −ρgw. The signs are opposite: ω is negative for ascending air; the rule "negative omega = precipitation" comes from here.
ω işareti karıştırılır: basınç koordinat: The sign of ω is confused: in pressure coordinates, NEGATIVE ω indicates ascent, because pressure decreases going upward.
ω işareti ters okunur; negatif ω YÜKSELİ: The sign of ω is read backwards; negative ω is ASCENT, often mistaken as "minus = downward" due to its name.
ω'lu iki terim (α/c_p − ∂T/∂p)ω olarak b: The two terms with ω combine as (α/c_p − ∂T/∂p)ω; the term in parentheses equals −(T/θ)∂θ/∂p via potential temperature (Intermediate Step #6). In a stable atmosphere S_p > 0: ascending air (ω < 0) creates local cooling.
ω'nın işaretini karıştırmak: yükseliş ω: Confusing the sign of ω: ascent is ω < 0; when S_p > 0, S_p ω < 0 = cooling.
ω'yı \"basıncın zamanla değişimi\" sanma: Mistaking ω for "the rate of change of pressure with time". In an isobaric system, p is a coordinate; Dp/Dt is the derivative of vertical displacement, i.e., vertical velocity.
ω, düşey hızın basınç koordinatındaki ha: ω is vertical velocity in pressure coordinates; ω<0 means ascent. Ascent cools and condenses → clouds/precipitation; subsidence warms and dries → clear skies.

∂θ/∂z artarsa: katman daha kararlı olur,: If ∂θ/∂z increases: the layer becomes more stable, vertical mixing weakens, pollutants accumulate at the surface.
